ABOUT EDITED
EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power.
By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation.
At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised.
We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best.
As an Account Manager, you will have the most senior relationship between EDITED and our customer. You will get to manage the accounts for the world's leading brands like Boohoo, Puma and high-end luxury brands, too. You will be the advocate for their needs inside our business.
You'll become a true product expert; that means understanding every feature of EDITED and the methodology behind it, as well as being able to introduce and explain it to a wide range of users. You'll be speaking to our clients every day by email, phone and in person, so you’ll need an intrinsic understanding of retail to build strategic relationships and speak knowledgeably about the issues they face.
OUR EXPECTATIONS FOR YOUR POSITION:
- Own the health and growth of your portfolio. Your primary measure of success is retention and expansion.
- Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and manage the full proposal and contract process through to close.
- Own the end-to-end renewal process from data analysis and proposal development through contract execution. Identifying and capturing expansion opportunities.
- Leverage usage data and trends to proactively identify opportunities and get ahead of renewal risks.
- Develop success plans for each customer that define critical success factors, success metrics, potential risks, and clear recommendations.
- Drive product adoption across all accounts in your portfolio.
- Cultivate executive, mid-level, and project relationships across a diverse customer base, turning customers into long-term champions of our brand.
- Build multi-threaded relationships across each account, with particular focus on senior and executive stakeholders.
- Identify client risk signals, both through in-person engagement and usage data, and proactively communicate them to your manager.
- Lead regular progress reviews with customers, including quarterly business reviews and monthly check-ins. This includes clear communication through in-person, zoom/teams, email and PPT presentations.
- Serve as a credible advocate for our products, with a strong understanding of how retailers and brands operate.
- Maintain rigorous documentation of account activity, processes, and customer interactions.
- Clearly articulate product positioning, use cases, and value to a range of stakeholders.
Requirements
- 3+ years working in B2B SaaS Account Management or Head Office Retail
- Expert technical competence and enthusiasm (understanding of SaaS software or technology and AI competency)
- Proven success in growing existing accounts and relationships
- Ideally, proven ability to manage 20 accounts.
PERKS & BENEFITS
- Enhanced parental leave policy
- 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)Stock options scheme
We do not use AI to source, screen, evaluate, or make decisions about candidates - every hiring decision is made by our team. We use Ashby, our applicant tracking system, which includes AI-assisted interview notetaking and automation for scheduling interviews and sending routine emails. These tools support our hiring process but do not make hiring decisions. We aim to be an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

THE ROLE
Retailers and brands use EDITED's market data to make pricing, assortment and trading decisions. More of them now want that data inside their own systems, through our API and our MCP server, which lets their AI tools query EDITED directly. So the person evaluating us is often a Head of Data, an Engineering lead or an Ecommerce tech lead, as well as the commercial buyer.
We're hiring a Technical Account Executive to win those accounts. You'll report to our CRO and join a small new logo team.
This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying sales role. You find the opportunities, run them and close them. It isn't pre-sales or Sales Engineering. What makes it different is that you can hold your own with a technical buyer on the first call and still take a commercial deal all the way to signature.
You don't need to know retail yet. We'll teach you. You do need to know how to sell B2B SaaS and close.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Build and run outbound into target accounts, including technical people who ignore a standard commercial pitch
- Run discovery with commercial and technical stakeholders to understand the problem they're solving and how our data would fit into their stack
- Walk a prospect's Data or Engineering lead through how our API and MCP server work, and know when to bring in product for deeper questions
- Write and present proposals that make the commercial case and the technical case in the same deal
- Negotiate and close, working with legal, finance and P&E on contracts
- Forecast your pipeline accurately and keep the CRM up to date
- Build relationships with senior and technical decision-makers in each account
WHAT YOU'LL NEED
- 4 + years in a full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales role, winning new logos yourself. Pre-sales, Sales Engineering or solutions consulting experience on its own isn't enough for this role.
- A track record against quota you can talk through in numbers: targets, attainment, deal sizes and sales cycles
- Experience closing deals of $200,000 + ACV with mid-market and enterprise organisations, with several stakeholders and a procurement process
- Experience selling technical products, such as APIs, data platforms, analytics or BI tools, developer tools or AI/ML products
- Confidence in technical conversations about integrations, APIs, data pipelines or agentic AI tooling. You don't need to write code. You do need to understand how the pieces connect and keep control of the conversation when the questions get specific.
- Strong commercial judgement. You qualify hard, you know where a deal really stands, and you can explain why in a forecast call.
- Clear writing and presenting for commercial and technical audiences
- Willingness to travel
NICE TO HAVE
- Experience selling to retailers, brands or ecommerce teams
- Experience where Data, Engineering or Product teams were your main buyer
What We Offer You As A Technical Sales Executive
We value our team and to attract exceptional people, we offer an excellent package! This year, we were recognised as one of the top companies to work for in the UK.

- 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)
- Healthcare via SimplyHealth Cash Plan
- You can utilise our flexible working policy to ensure you can work around your schedule

- Employee Referral Programme

What most search consultants earn in a year, our consultants earn on a single mandate.
To enable our stage of hyper growth and ambitious future plans, we are searching for an Executive Search Consultant to join our high performing Milton Keynes team.
If you want to accelerate your earnings, career trajectory and personal growth, keep reading.
Who We Are & Why This Role Exists
We are an Executive Search firm operating at the sharpest end of quant, finance and technology recruitment.
Five years ago, we entered one of the most competitive markets in the world with no brand, no inherited clients and no right to win.
Today, we consistently outperform firms with decades of heritage.
The numbers:
- $400k-500k+ average production per head
- $100k-700k fee mandates
- Multiple seven-figure billers
We didn’t win by luck. We won by building a platform that compounds performance: combining process, pressure and execution. Now, we’re scaling that platform further and giving you the chance to join.
From day one, you’ll have access to:
- Elite hedge fund and quant tech clients with live search mandates
- A warm desk with active accounts and established candidate networks
- Six-figure fee mandates
- Mentorship from multi six figure and seven figure billers
- A search environment built for depth and precision, not volume
- Proven execution frameworks to accelerate credibility in a new market
You are not being asked to “build a desk over time.” You are stepping into a platform where you are expected to perform immediately.
About the Role
As an Executive Search Consultant, you’ll take ownership of retained and contingent search mandates focused on the global hedge fund and quant technology markets.
This isn’t about starting from zero.
You’ll inherit an established platform built over five years, giving you access to elite clients, live search mandates and a proven track record from day one.
You’ll manage the full search lifecycle: headhunting, candidate assessment and close. As an extension of our elite clients internal teams, you will act as a trusted advisor to both clients and candidates throughout.
You’ll be supported to:
- Build credibility quickly with senior stakeholders in a new market
- Run structured, retained search processes for elite funds
- Identify and secure world-class quant and technology talent
- Operate with rigor, discretion and commercial focus
All within a system designed to accelerate your success, not slow it down.
About You
You are an experienced search professional who has already proven you can deliver and now want to operate at a higher level.
You will likely:
- Have executive search or retained search experience
- Have managed full search mandates end-to-end, from brief to placement, not just candidate delivery
- Have a track record of consistent billings and client retention
- Be experienced in headhunting, market mapping and closing senior talent
- Have built strong, consultative client relationships
- Have successfully entered new markets or built credibility quickly
- Be ready to join the highest performing Quant search team
Backgrounds could include: Finance, Medical, Legal / HR / Compliance, Professional services.
US market experience is a plus — but not essential.
If you want to play a different sport than the other search firms locally and are ready to out-earn, out-perform and out-grow anything you’ve experienced before, apply now.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/dweet/f677e35b-b540-494.description_excerpt:
Valentino, the renowned Italian luxury fashion house, is seeking temporary Sales Advisors to join their London retail team. As a Sales Advisor at Valentino, you will play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional customer service and driving sales growth.
In this position, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with a passionate and talented team, as well as work closely with customers to understand their needs and provide personalised product recommendations. Your main responsibilities will include assisting customers in finding the perfect womenswear.
At Valentino, we believe in investing in our employees' growth and development. As a Sales Advisor, you will have access to training programs and mentorship opportunities that will help you enhance your skills and advance within the company.
What sets this role apart is the chance to be part of an iconic brand that is globally recognised for its elegance and craftsmanship. Join us at Valentino and be part of an inspiring journey where your passion for fashion meets limitless potential for career growth.
Responsibilities
- You will provide exceptional customer service by assisting customers in finding and selecting the right products.
- We expect you to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and loyalty to the brand.
- You shall stay up-to-date with current fashion trends, product knowledge, and industry developments to effectively advise and guide customers.
- We expect you to achieve and exceed sales targets by actively promoting and selling Valentino products.
- You will handle cash transactions accurately and efficiently, including processing payments and issuing receipts.
- We expect you to participate in inventory management activities, such as receiving and organising merchandise, conducting stock checks, and maintaining display areas.
- You shall play an active role in visual merchandising, ensuring that products are attractively displayed and the store's aesthetic is maintained.
- We expect you to contribute to a positive work environment by collaborating with team members and supporting colleagues when needed.
Requirements
- You must have excellent communication skills to effectively interact with customers and provide exceptional service.
- You should be knowledgeable about current fashion trends, designers, and luxury brands to assist customers in making informed purchasing decisions.
- You must possess strong sales skills and a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
- You should have a passion for fashion and an eye for aesthetics to create visually appealing displays that showcase our products.
- You must be a team player who can collaborate with colleagues to achieve common goals and contribute to a positive work environment.
- You should be highly organised and detail-oriented to accurately process transactions, manage inventory, and maintain store cleanliness.
- You must be able to adapt quickly to changing situations and customer demands, demonstrating flexibility and problem-solving skills.
- You should have strong product knowledge and the ability to engage customers in meaningful conversations to promote brand loyalty and drive sales.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/evervault/e2438d17-c576.description_excerpt:
About Evervault
Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.
Role Overview
You’ll own how the world understands the way customers use Evervault and how they get the most from it. You’ll turn product and customer insight into things we ship: customer stories, tools, reports, courses and community. You’ll join our Fuel team, working closely with product marketing, content and design. Our CEO, Shane, is heavily involved, from brainstorming ideas to being the face and voice of what we produce.
What You’ll Be Doing
- Talking to customers regularly, hunting for interesting stories and creative ways to tell them
- Becoming the expert on the business models and customer types we serve, and how each uses Evervault
- Working with customer success and solutions engineering to add colour to our target segments
- Getting into the weeds with product and engineering to connect customer needs to what’s technically possible
- Shipping across formats: blogs and social posts, but also customer workshops, video learning modules, or benchmark tools built on the payment data we see
Requirements
- 3+ years of work experience, ideally in product, product marketing, development, technical writing or solutions engineering
- Technically competent: a computer science or engineering background, or hobby developer experience
- Exceptional written and spoken English
- You think like a journalist: you ask naive questions without embarrassment until you get an answer that’s actually interesting
- Highly creative: you know what to say and how to say it in a way that stands out
Nice to Have
- Knowledge of payments, fintech or developer tools
- Experience creating video, workshops or interactive content
- You’ve built small tools or demos with code
This Might Not Be for You If…
- You only want to write: we expect you to explore new formats, not just blog posts
- You want a pure engineering role: this is about understanding customers and telling their stories
- You’d rather work from a brief: you’ll find the stories yourself by talking to customers
- You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday
Compensation, Benefits & Why Join
- Stock options with an extended exercise window
- Private health insurance
- Generous vacation and flexible working hours
- Catered lunch in our London office
- A big say in how the Evervault story is told after our $25m Series B
Interview Process
1. Recruiter screen
2. Hiring manager interview
3. Founder Interview
4. Take-home task & Presentation
5. References and offer
Location
This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas.
Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.

- Manage process of re-pricing and monitoring back-book customers
- Own the requirements for our enablement tooling and work with our development team to ship it.
- Run profitability monitoring across business units and markets, and lead the re-pricing of back-book merchants where margins are too low
- Develop pro-active strategies to re-price merchants as part of the growth strategy
- Support Business Units to win complex deals, RfP’s and negotiations
- Enable and coach business units to sell payments profitably. Most are new to payments, so expect to run training, build playbooks and templates, and develop local champions.

- Deep, hands-on knowledge of payments economics: interchange, scheme fees, IC++ versus blended. You spot the opportunities in a cost overview and are up to date with pricing strategies of the competition
- AI native. You already use AI tools to be more efficient and enhance your contribution
- Significant experience in a commercial pricing role within a high transaction volume business, ideally in payments

- Experience in a fast-paced start-up or scale-up environment
- Comfort with data tools (SQL, Tableau, Power BI or similar)

- Take projects from early exploration through to reliable deployment
- Apply high standards for architecture, code quality, evaluation and research practices

- You enjoy working closely with product, design and the analysts who use what you build, translating their feedback into technical decisions
- You're energised by hands-on work with model serving (small models and LLMs), agent orchestration and retrieval systems
- You care about engineering fundamentals: writing code that's clean and maintainable, not just code that works
- You are comfortable with a fast-paced environment and clear ownership
WHERE THIS ROLE CAN TAKE YOU
- This role positions you at the frontier of applied AI for high-stakes decision-making, giving you the chance to help shape production agentic systems that influence real geopolitical and organisational outcomes.
- Depending on your interests, this role can open paths into specialised domain AI, technical leadership and lasting impact in the decision-intelligence space.
REQUIREMENTS
Due to the nature of our work and the clients we support, applicants must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand.

- Some hands-on experience with model serving (small models and LLMs), agent orchestration or retrieval systems
- Developing rigour in evaluation and benchmarking, with support from senior engineers
- Strong engineering fundamentals: ability to write clean, maintainable code
- Comfort with a fast-paced environment and clear ownership of well-defined work
- Exposure to modern coding agents and interest in effective workflows
Desirable
- Early-stage start-up experience
- Building agentic tools and harnesses
- Working on domain-specific modelling problems
- Clear writing, systematic thinking and strong communication
INTERVIEW PROCESS
- Initial Intro Interview - 30 Minutes
- Technical Assessment - 45 minutes
- System Design Assessment - 45 minutes
- Founder interview - 30 Minutes

- Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

- Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

ABOUT FREETRADE
Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.
We’re changing that.
We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.
2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.
This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.
Freetrade Engineers play a pivotal role in developing and maintaining a robust, scalable platform used by thousands daily. We tackle big technical challenges, drive innovation, and build solutions that make a real impact.
Here, your code doesn’t just run - it powers the decisions of investors across the UK.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to play a pivotal role in our engineering team. In this position, you'll lead the end-to-end delivery of complex, impactful features, showcasing a passion for independent problem-solving and a drive to scale our next-generation, user-focused product.
Our philosophy on hiring
We hire for engineering excellence, not just a specific list of keywords. Our interview process is language-agnostic; we care about your ability to solve complex problems, design scalable systems, and write clean code in whichever language you’re most comfortable with.
Our stack
Once you join, you’ll be working primarily with TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL on GCP. We don’t expect you to be an expert in these on Day 1, but we do look for engineers who are excited to master this stack and contribute to its evolution.
What you’ll do
- Lead features from initial design and development through to post-production and validation.
- Level up the team through technical workshops, pair programming, and active mentorship.
- Define and uphold company-wide standards for code reviews and engineering best practices.
- Act as a senior escalation point for high-priority issues and participate in our on-call rotation.
- Conduct technical interviews to identify and hire top-tier engineering talent.
- Constantly evaluate the tech landscape to improve our development processes and tools.
About you
- Involve others in design decisions and delegate responsibility to help your squad grow.

About this role
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer (f/m/x) to strengthen our cloud and platform foundations, empowering teams to build, deploy, and operate software solutions.
In this role, internally titled Infrastructure Engineer IV, you’ll work at the core of cloud infrastructure, developer experience, and reliability. You’ll design scalable and secure systems on AWS, evolve our Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices, and champion automation, observability, optimization, and continuous improvement.
Your first major area of ownership will be the infrastructure behind AI-powered capabilities at Eye Security: building the secure, observable, and cost-controlled environment that takes agents and LLM-backed services from prototype to production. This is your starting point, not the permanent boundary of the role — over time, you’ll work across our wider cloud platform, developer experience, reliability, and infrastructure strategy.
This is a platform and infrastructure engineering role, not an ML research or applied science position. You will not train or fine-tune models, build feature pipelines, or work as a prompt engineer. We also don’t expect you to have worked with every AWS AI service listed below — strong platform fundamentals and real experience bringing AI-powered systems into production matter more than familiarity with specific services.
What you will do
- Design, build, and maintain highly scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure on AWS.
- Lead our Infrastructure-as-Code practices using Terraform, including reusable modules and deployment patterns.
- Build the deployment patterns, workload identity, access controls, and operational guardrails required to run agents and LLM-backed services in production, covering tool access, secrets, data handling, service quotas, and cost.
- Evolve our monitoring and observability strategy using tools such as Grafana and Sentry, including distributed tracing across agent and tool calls, usage and cost attribution, and failures that are semantic rather than operational.
- Establish practical ways to evaluate non-deterministic behaviour and catch regressions before and after deployment.
- Continuously improve automation, deployment pipelines, system reliability, performance, and technical debt.
- Mentor mid-level engineers and share knowledge through documentation, reviews, and technical discussions.
- Communicate clearly about technical trade-offs, timelines, and priorities, ensuring alignment with product and engineering goals.
- Balance multiple priorities and adapt effectively in a fast-changing scale-up environment.
What you need
- 6+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or related fields, with significant experience in AWS.
- Strong expertise in AWS, Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD systems, and observability.

This is a high impact, visible role. As our Strategy & Operations Manager, you'll support the CEO & COO and augment their capacity by taking on problems to solve that are critically important to how we build all aspects of GetGround. Some weeks that means building the model that decides whether we enter a new market. Others it means untangling why a core funnel is leaking, or writing the board paper, or problem solving what seems like the impossible task. You'll be in a role that will require you to use your expert communication skills, analytical mindset, commercial accumen and intellect to support in propelling us through our next stage of growth.
What you'll do
- Own the CEO & COO’s highest-priority problems end to end, usually two or three at a time, each lasting anywhere from a fortnight to a quarter. You'll define the question, do the analysis, form a view, get buy-in, and see it through to execution.
- Do the analysis yourself. You'll pull the data, build the model, and stress-test your own conclusions before anyone else does. We don't have an army of analysts for you to delegate to, and we like it that way.
- Turn strategy into things that ship. You will be accountable for shipping these initiatives, creating impact and own the result.
- Prepare the CEO & COO for the rooms that matter, board meetings, investor conversations, partnership negotiations. You'll shape what gets said.
- Spot what nobody is looking at. A good Founder Associate brings problems to the CEO & COO as often as they receive them.
What we are looking for
- Agency and resilience
- A unwavering work ethic and desire to scale a business
- 2 to 5 + years in strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, or an operating role at a high-growth startup.
- Strong commercial judgement. You can look at a messy situation, work out which two numbers actually matter, and be roughly right quickly rather than precisely right too late.
- You write and communicate difficult concepts and topics in simple, clear terms and to an expert level.
- You can influence without authority
- High tolerance for ambiguity and pace. Priorities shift. Projects get killed. If that sounds exhausting rather than energising, this isn't the role.

- Exposure to fintech or regulated financial services
- Experience taking something from zero to one inside an existing company

We're hiring a hands-on Finance Business Partner to own day-to-day finance across a growing, multi-entity proptech group. You'll run the core finance engine which includes payroll, payments, reconciliations, month-end and statutory compliance. You’ll be tasked with improving it with automation so it can scale without extra headcount.
This is a broad role with real ownership. One day you might be closing out an audit, the next you're redesigning how customer refunds are paid or building a reconciliation that saves the team hours every week. The group spans UK and overseas entities, including subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Philippines and Dubai, and some products are FCA-regulated. You'll work closely with sales, support, property management and our external accountants and auditors.
Key responsibilities:
Statutory accounts, audit and group reporting
- Prepare trial balances and management accounts for each entity, including overseas subsidiaries, and support group consolidation under FRS 102.
- Handle intercompany balances, FX translation and acquisition accounting for new or restructured entities.
- Own the audit process: prepare PBC lists, answer auditor queries and manage the group and subsidiary audits from start to finish.
- Track Companies House filing deadlines, audit exemptions and accounting reference date changes so no entity falls overdue.
- Assist in the preparation of VAT returns, R&D tax credit claims and other statutoring filings such as PSA and P11D.
Payroll and Benefits
- Oversee monthly payroll and payslip queries with our external accountants
- Calculation and oversight of variable commission to the sales team
- Manage share scheme compliance, including EMI notifications and annual returns.
- Run employee expenses through Xero Expenses and keep the VAT treatment correct so input VAT is reclaimed.
Payments, cash and reconciliations
- Run weekly payment runs, including customer refunds and supplier payments
- Reconcile bank, Stripe and CRM data; resolve unmatched receipts
- Raise invoices to developers and customers, track and pay corresponding invoices to partners and agents.
- Oversee landlord rent collection and payouts for our L&M arm, including statements and discrepancy resolution.
- Manage credit control, including uncollectible invoices and failed subscription payments.
Revenue and commercial controls
- Reconcile deal revenue, agent fees and customer incentives in HubSpot against finance records.
- Own subscription billing policy in Stripe, including the approval process for discounts and fee waivers.
- Run spend analysis across vendors and flag cost trends
Systems, process and special projects
- Automate and document manual finance workflows (Slack, Google Sheets, Zapier, Count)
- Write and maintain finance guidance for the wider team, such as expenses and subscription policies.
Financial Tool You’ll Use:
- Xero
- Joiin
- Stripe
- HubSpot
- Count.io http://Count.io
- Google Sheets,
- Notion, and automation tools such as Zapier.
ABOUT YOU
- CA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified (or qualified by experience), with 3+ years in finance, ideally including time in practice.
- Solid UK GAAP (FRS 102) knowledge, including consolidation and intercompany.
- Strong Excel skills: building clean, formula-driven reconciliations and models others can follow.
- Confident working with large datasets from multiple sources (bank exports, Stripe, CRM): cleaning and joining them, spotting patterns and anomalies, and turning them into clear insights.
- Clear, concise communication with non-finance colleagues, and comfort working in a fast-moving startup.
- A process-improvement mindset. you question how things are done, document what you build, and use AI and automation to make finance work faster and more accurate.
WHY JOIN US?
- Real scope - you’ll sit close to leadership, your work directly supports the company’s growth
- Build, don't just maintain. We run on modern tools and actively use automation and AI, and we want you to push that further.
- Close collaboration with Sales, Operations, People and our product teams
- A fast-scaling business with genuine opportunities for progression
- High autonomy paired with strong strategic influence

We’re looking for a Legal Counsel to join GetGround’s Legal, Risk & Compliance team, giving practical, commercially minded legal and regulatory advice as we scale.
You’ll advise on commercial contracts, product questions, partnerships, regulatory matters and disputes, and work on projects that strengthen the function as the business grows. You’ll be a trusted partner to teams across GetGround and a key part of how we manage risk day to day.
THE OPPORTUNITY
GetGround operates at the intersection of fintech, proptech and wealthtech. We have £2Bn+ in assets on platform, 30,000+ users across 70 countries, and a portfolio of regulated products spanning mortgages, property management, and investment tools. We are the first end-to-end real estate investment offering, making the dream of owning property accessible to everyone, globally. We're building the future of asset ownership and in doing so, helping to address wealth inequality.
As we continue to grow, our legal, risk and compliance needs are growing with us. You'll play a central role in keeping the business legally sound, moving quickly, and operating with integrity. This would be a great opportunity for a lawyer who wants to work on genuinely varied, interesting matters in a collaborative and supportive environment, with opportunities to learn and grow
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
COMMERCIAL AND CONTRACTS
- Draft, negotiate and close a wide range of commercial agreements, including supplier and vendor contracts, SaaS and technology agreements, and professional services agreements
- Advise on GetGround’s customer-facing terms, including customer T&Cs, product terms and terms of use, keeping them clear, compliant and commercially sensible
- Support negotiations on strategic partnership, referral, distribution and white-label deals that open new revenue lines
- Maintain and improve contract templates, negotiation playbooks and fallback positions so teams can close routine deals without legal bottlenecks
- Advise on contractual risk, including liability caps, indemnities, warranties, data protection terms and service levels
CORPORATE, FUNDRAISING AND M&A
- Support equity and debt fundraising end to end: term sheets, investment agreements, disclosure, due diligence and completion
- Draft and maintain shareholders’ agreements, articles of association, share option schemes (including EMI) and other share arrangements
- Manage corporate governance and company secretarial work, including board and shareholder meetings, resolutions, statutory registers and Companies House filings
- Lead or support M&A activity, from diligence and deal structuring through SPA negotiation, completion and integration
- Keep the business investor-ready, with a clean data room and well-ordered corporate records
- Manage external counsel on major transactions, keeping scope, cost and timelines tight
IP, PRODUCT AND REGULATORY
- Negotiate IP licensing deals, both in-licensing and out-licensing, including software, data and API licences
- Protect and grow GetGround’s IP, including trade marks and IP terms in employment and contractor agreements
- Provide legal input on new product features, customer journeys and platform changes
- Work with Compliance on contracts and communications touching FCA-regulated activity, including critical outsourcing, introducer arrangements and Consumer Duty
- Advise on data protection and privacy, including UK GDPR, data sharing and AI-related terms
ABOUT YOU
You’re a UK qualified solicitor with 2+ years PQE in commercial and corporate law, gained in private practice, in-house, or both. You bring:
- A strong track record negotiating complex commercial contracts, including supplier agreements, customer and product terms, NDAs and partnership deals
- Hands-on corporate experience across fundraising, shareholders’ agreements, share schemes, governance and M&A
- Experience drafting and negotiating IP licences
- Experience in technology and financial services, and a good understanding of how FCA regulation applies to fintech products
- A growth mindset: you see legal as a way to unlock deals, weigh risk against commercial reward, and give clear recommendations, not just legal analysis
- Confident negotiation and stakeholder management skills, building trust with counterparties, investors and senior leaders
- Excellent drafting skills and a high level of attention to detail
- Comfort working independently, owning your workload and keeping deals moving
- A collaborative approach and genuine interest in the business, not just the legal matters
Highly desirable:
- In-house experience at a fast-growing fintech, ideally through a Series A or later round
- Experience with property, mortgage or investment products
- Buy-side M&A experience or integrating an acquired business
- Experience setting up contract management tools, self-serve templates or legal automation

Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.
We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.
Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.
About the role
As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for growing the customer base and closing net-new logos for Infisical’s platform. We are building the #1 open-source security infrastructure stack, and you will play a defining role in growing it as the first AE in the DACH region!
You will be working closely with our CEO and the rest of the team on:
- Understanding and demonstrating our products to prospects.
- Developing, managing, and closing business within accounts in our enterprise accounts segment.
- Driving the sales cycle from prospect to close and ensuring adoption and consumption of our products.
- Collaborating with the engineering team to define customer requirements and communicate timelines.
- Identifying current customers with upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
- Using innovative sales tools to map, prospect, follow and close your accounts.
Overall, you’re going to be one of the defining pieces of our team as we scale to thousands of customers over the next 18 months.
Requirements
- Experience selling software to a technical audience (bonus: knowledge and experience with open source, security, and/or infrastructure sales).
- Demonstrated experience in scaling sales operations from the ground up, including setting up sales processes, CRM systems, and building a sales team.
- Credibility, and ability to craft compelling cases for change.
- Experience in navigating multi-stakeholder sales (e.g., IC engineer, director, executive leadership).

- Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript (3+).
- Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.
- A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.
- Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

- Previous founder or startup experience.

- Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

About this Team

Our Recruiting team is the gateway connecting exceptional humans to meaningful, high-impact work. We’re a close-knit, mission-driven crew that takes pride in thoughtful, relationship-first hiring. We partner deeply with teams across OpenAI to find, engage, and support the people who will shape the future of AI.
Our Go-to-Market (GTM) team is scaling rapidly to bring OpenAI’s products to customers and partners around the world. GTM hiring at OpenAI focuses on building a world-class team across Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Technical Solutions.
About this Role
We’re looking for an experienced GTM Recruiter to help build some of the most critical teams at OpenAI across Technical Solutions and Sales.
This is a high-impact role where you’ll operate as a strategic talent partner not just executing searches, but shaping how we attract, assess, and hire exceptional GTM talent globally. You’ll own searches end-to-end, working closely with senior stakeholders to define hiring strategies, navigate complex markets, and deliver outstanding outcomes.
You’ll report to the regional recruiting lead and collaborate closely with global recruiting, People, and business leadership to scale our GTM organisation in a thoughtful, high-quality way.
Your responsibilities
- Own end-to-end hiring for GTM roles, from scoping and calibration through to offer and close.
Partner closely with senior business leaders to deeply understand team needs, define hiring strategies, and translate business priorities into actionable talent plans.
- Build and execute proactive, data-informed sourcing strategies to attract high-calibre and diverse talent across competitive markets.
- Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, driving alignment, challenging assumptions, and maintaining a consistently high hiring bar.
- Deliver an exceptional candidate experience, ensuring every interaction reflects OpenAI’s values and mission.
- Navigate complex, global hiring environments by partnering with People, Legal, and Compensation to ensure consistency, fairness, and compliance.
- Continuously improve recruiting processes, identifying bottlenecks and implementing scalable solutions to increase quality and velocity.
- Bring market intelligence and insights to stakeholders, influencing hiring decisions and shaping talent strategy.
We’re seeking:
- 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in-house at high-growth or high-bar environments.
- Proven track record of hiring for GTM functions (e.g. Sales, Technical Solutions, RevOps, Partnerships, User Ops).
- Strong talent judgment, you can assess both experience and potential, and consistently raise the bar.
- Comfortable operating as a strategic partner, influencing senior stakeholders and navigating ambiguity.
- Highly execution-oriented, with the ability to run multiple complex searches simultaneously without sacrificing quality.
- Skilled in building pipelines from scratch, especially in competitive or emerging talent markets.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across regions and cultures.
- Data-informed and structured in your approach, using insights to guide decisions and improve outcomes.
- Experience with modern recruiting tools (e.g. Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter) and a mindset for leveraging new technologies.

About this Team
At OpenAI, we’re here to do something extraordinary: build safe AGI that benefits everyone. That mission demands people who are not just brilliant but also deeply aligned with our values. Our Recruiting team is the gateway connecting exceptional humans to meaningful, high-impact work. We’re a close-knit, mission-driven crew that takes pride in thoughtful, relationship-first hiring. Our mission requires a team that represents a diversity of perspectives, voices, and experiences.

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.
The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programmes that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring an FTC B2B Influencer Marketing Lead, EMEA to build and scale OpenAI’s influencer marketing capability across knowledge workers (KW), business decision-makers (BDMs), and developer audiences.
You will own the strategy and hands-on delivery across multiple European markets (working closely with in-market comms & marketing team), with the UK, France, and Germany as the first priorities. You will develop local creator networks, translate regional and global priorities into market-relevant programmes, and build a portfolio that balances sustained creator relationships with high-impact moments around products, campaigns, and events.
This is a zero-to-one builder role as much as an ecosystem and operating-model role. - Build an always-on creator portfolio alongside launch, event, and campaign activations, choosing the right mix of tutorials, product demonstrations, thought leadership, executive content, social posts, newsletters, podcasts, video, and community formats.
- Work with existing influencer and marketing agencies to raise the quality and pace of delivery. Identify capability gaps and lead the selection, onboarding, and management of new specialist agencies, including developer-native and market-specific partners.
- Partner closely with our media agency to build paid amplification strategies for high-performing creator content, including audience targeting, usage rights, creator whitelisting where appropriate, testing, optimisation, and clear organic-versus-paid performance readouts.
- Partner with our Performance Marketing and Growth teams to develop bespoke influencer content that drives measurable performance and business growth.
- Operationalise the end-to-end influencer process across intake, creator discovery, due diligence, brand-safety review, scopes of work, contracting, approvals, disclosure and compliance, content calendars, asset management, localisation, paid rights, and post-campaign learning.
- Set programme and campaign goals upfront. Build a measurement framework that connects creator activity to meaningful audience and business outcomes rather than relying on vanity metrics.
- Define and report a balanced scorecard by audience and objective, including qualified reach, audience relevance, engagement quality, content completion and saves, traffic, product education, developer activation, adoption signals, and pipeline influence where measurement is appropriate.
- Establish regular reporting and performance reviews with clear recommendations on which creators, formats, platforms, markets, and investments to scale, improve, or stop.
- Manage budgets, agency scopes, creator fees, usage rights, and production investment, making disciplined trade-offs and improving efficiency over time.
- Partner with Product Marketing, Developer Marketing and Relations, Comms, Creative, Legal, Privacy, Brand, Media, regional marketers, and GTM teams to ensure content is technically accurate, locally relevant, compliant, and useful to the audience.
- Bring creator and community insight back into OpenAI, helping teams understand emerging voices, platform shifts, audience questions, content opportunities, and risks across the European influencer ecosystem.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- OpenAI has a strong, trusted network of B2B and developer creators across Europe, with meaningful depth in the UK, France, and Germany.
- Priority creators progress from individual activations into sustained, mutually valuable partnerships, supported by curated programmes and experiences that increase trust, product understanding, and advocacy over time.
- Developer influencer marketing becomes a repeatable growth and education channel, supported by a healthy pipeline of credible creators and technically valuable content.
- Teams and agencies use a clear, efficient operating model with defined ownership, faster approvals, strong compliance, reusable tools, and fewer one-off processes.
- Organic creator programmes and PHD-led paid amplification work as one system, with transparent performance, learning, and investment decisions.
- Leadership has a reliable view of goals, spend, creator health,…

We are growing and looking for ambitious talent to help us democratise retail investing across the UK.
THE ROLE
The Investa app was installed over 1,000 times within the first 24 hours of our priority access launch and we’re now looking for a high-impact Senior Software Engineer to join our founding engineering team as we scale.
You will have extensive commercial experience designing, building and maintaining systems used in critical services or those handling significant volumes of activity.
You will play a crucial role in building key parts of our platform and apps, ensuring the robustness, scalability, and security of our systems.
If you’re passionate about building best-in-class products to tackle complex challenges and you excel in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.
WHAT THE ROLE INVOLVES
- Founding Team Ownership: Designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable services by joining our founding team of 4 engineers. Working directly with the founders with zero middle-management red tape, you won’t just pull tickets from a backlog - you will actually own your work end-to-end, see your code ship, and see its immediate impact on users.
- Building the Engineering Culture: Joining our founding engineering team means you are actively building our engineering culture, not just stepping into one. You will have a direct voice in shaping how we collaborate day-to-day, how we learn from each other, and how we preserve a friendly, agile, and tight-knit environment as we grow.
- Full-Stack Versatility & Growth: Hands-on Building: Writing high-quality, secure code for our FCA-regulated platform. You’ll navigate our stack to ship features that delight users. Driven by our fast-paced environment, you will have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone and get hands-on with the wider technical stack, levelling up your skills significantly faster than in a traditional, highly specialised role.
- System Design & Architectural Influence: Partnering directly with the CEO and Principal Engineers to tackle complex systems design and actively shape our evolving architecture. Your technical perspective will give you a strong voice in our high-level design choices. You will have true design ownership over the specific services and systems you build, ensuring they remain robust, secure, and performant as we scale.
- Technical Excellence: Maintaining a high bar for code quality, testing, and documentation. You’ll participate in (and drive) meaningful code reviews.
- System Integrity: Monitoring and improving system reliability, ensuring our trading platform is always "always-on."
- Production Support: Root-causing real-time production issues; we all take pride in the stability of what we ship.
YOUR BACKGROUND
- Coding: You are a "doer." You love shipping code, crave the responsibility that comes with joining a founding team, and are comfortable driving tricky engineering problems forward with high autonomy and support from the team.
- Adaptable & Impact-Driven: Technical Depth: You have +5 years experience in software engineering, specifically building and maintaining production-grade distributed systems. You are a flexible engineer who is excited to jump in wherever the business actually needs you most to solve interesting problems across the board. You are proficient in at least one or two modern languages (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, etc.) and have experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
- Pragmatic Mindset: You balance structural integrity with contextual relevance, ensuring we don't just build the "perfect" system, but the right system for our current needs.
- Collaborative Spirit: You enjoy working in a tight-knit team, giving/receiving candid feedback, and contributing to a culture of shared learning.
- First-Principles Thinker: You don’t just follow patterns; you understand why they exist. You can pick up new technologies or domains (like complex options Greeks) quickly, and you welcome a setup that actively forces you to grow into a much more versatile engineer.
ON-CALL
- All engineers at Investa are involved in providing support for our products. This involves responding to events outside of working hours and is a core part of the role of all engineers.
WHAT WE OFFER:
Career Ownership & Impact: While we provide clear levels to grow into, you also have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.
Collaboration & Proximity: You’ll work directly alongside our Co-Founders, Alec and Ross, and our founding engineers to co-author both the product roadmap and our engineering architecture. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a direct voice in how we solve deep technical issues as we scale.
Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.
Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company EMI equity. Our success is your success.
The Package and Perks: Competitive base salaries, private medical insurance, team socials chosen by you, milestone celebrations, and hybrid flexibility.

ABOUT HIVED 📦
At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.
Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.
A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.
Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.
Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures https://planet-a.com/, Maersk Growth https://www.maersk.com/growth, Pale Blue Dot VC https://sifted.eu/articles/pale-blue-dot-vc-87m-fund/, Eka Ventures https://techcrunch.com/2021/07/12/eka-ventures-closes-95m-impact-vc-fund-for-sustainable-consumption-healthcare-and-society/, NordicNinja VC https://nordicninja.com/ and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.
ROLE OVERVIEW 📝
We're on a mission to make parcel delivery clean, and our drivers are at the heart of it. If you love getting stuck into meaty backend problems with real purpose, you'll feel right at home building the complex, distributed systems behind HIVED's emission-free delivery network. Every feature you ship puts the right information in a driver's hands at exactly the right moment, helping them deliver smarter and greener from the moment they log on to the very last drop of the day.
In the Driver Squad, you'll take genuine ownership of problems across the backend systems and tooling that keep our drivers moving. You'll drive features end-to-end, from discovery through to deployment and monitoring, scoping the solution, weighing the trade-offs, and contributing to the squad's engineering quality, all in close partnership with Product, UX, Operations, and fellow engineers. We're rebuilding parcel delivery from the ground up on a modern stack, with sustainability, flexibility, and scalability baked in from day one.
These are real challenges on our roadmap that you'll have a hand in cracking:
- Last metre navigation. Guide drivers to the exact closest access point to a customer's door, shaving precious seconds off every drop.
- Smarter routing. Teach our systems to recognise different types of addresses, like a business that's shut on a weekend, so we stop attempting drops that were never going to land. Fewer wasted miles means faster routes for drivers and lighter emissions.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/meter/a5e602e4-4cd8-459.description_excerpt:
Meter’s ambition is to evolve internet infrastructure into a utility by building a product that caters to stakeholders from Customers, ISPs, Partners, and Technicians. Every utility starts with a network design – and that’s where you come in.
To achieve our mission, we must ensure our network deployments are designed for performance and scale, as well as executed flawlessly. As a Deployment Engineer, you will be responsible for translating customer requirements to fully designed wireless networks using Meter’s in-house tooling. You’ll lead all technical decisions throughout the design and deployment phases, and support our customers through network turn-up and validation. Your expertise will directly impact the efficiency of our deployments and the satisfaction of our customers, enabling Meter to scale and meet the growing demand for reliable internet infrastructure.
YOU WILL HAVE AN IMPACT BY
- Designing performant and resilient networks: You will create wireless network designs using Meter’s in-house toolkit.
- Leading critical technical decisions: You will lead technical network decisions during design and deployment phases until network go-live and validation are complete.
- Supporting network turn-up: You will troubleshoot and support critical devices and network functionality during the network turn-up phase, ensuring a seamless experience for customers.
- Supporting On-site Installation: You will visit complex customer sites as needed to support installation and validation, ensuring successful deployment.
- Providing real-time wireless escalation support: troubleshooting RF issues, power settings, SSID configuration, and AP placement during live installs (this is SLA-bound and reactive)
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams: You will work closely with Deployment Project Managers, Sales Engineers, and Product Engineering to design the next generation of Meter’s deployment and networking products.
WHO YOU ARE
You thrive on the complexity of enterprise wireless deployments, balancing RF design, customer environments, security requirements, and the diverse devices that rely on the network. You have the project management discipline to produce multiple wireless designs at once without dropping the ball. Clear communication, disciplined documentation, and a builder’s mindset enable you to bridge teams, create structure, and translate frontline insights into scalable tools and product improvements.
WHY METER?
The internet runs the world. Every email you send, purchase you make, video call you join—it’s all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven’t changed for decades. They’re brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.
We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground-up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, Reddit, rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.
Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable business to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/meter/f71471f3-da51-405.description_excerpt:
Meter’s ambition is to evolve internet infrastructure into a utility by building a product that caters to stakeholders from Customers, ISPs, Partners, and Technicians. Every utility starts with an installation – and that’s where you come in. The Technician Operations team is the live backbone of Meter’s deployment engine, ensuring that we deliver critical infrastructure on time, to standard, and with zero friction for our partners and customers.
A Network is most vulnerable during deployment - and each stakeholder plays an essential role to ensure it’s built as performance and resilient critical infrastructure. Meter dedicates a team to each stakeholder, ensuring our product and work empowers stakeholders to do operationally and technically sound work at scale. In this role, you'll own the live technical execution of enterprise network deployments. By partnering directly with field technicians in real time, troubleshooting issues as they happen, and building the systems and tools that make installations effortless, you'll ensure every customer network is successfully brought online.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Your fingerprints will be on every installation, shaping the technician experience and driving the scale Meter needs to reach utility status. In your first six months, you will:
- Become the technical escalation point: Independently resolve the majority of live deployment networking issues, reducing escalations to Deployment Engineering and keeping installations on schedule.
- Keep projects on track: Deliver >90% of installations on time by partnering with field technicians, unblocking issues in real time, and ensuring customer networks are successfully brought online.
- Raise quality standards: Reduce rework rates <5% and ensure compliance with installation artifacts and validation checks.
- Accelerate installs: Partner with Operations Engineering to roll out automated technician tooling that cuts install validation times by 30%.
WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL LOOK LIKE
From day one, you'll own the live technical execution of enterprise network deployments. A typical week might include:
- Acting as the technical lead on the live install thread: Running pre-install prep calls with technicians, deciding what gets resolved on the call vs. escalated to Wired or Wireless Deployment Engineering, and owning the shift handoff so context never drops.
- Real-time troubleshooting of issues mid-install: ISP circuit turn-up, native VLAN mismatches, trunk vs. access port config on AP uplinks, DHCP reservations and inter-VLAN routing, IPSec tunnel failures, HA firewall failover, DAC cable issues on backup uplinks, and more.
- Owning sign-off as the final technical gate before a customer network goes live: Clearing the Dashboard Issues page, confirming all hardware (firewalls, switches, APs, PDUs) is online and on the current NOS, validating ISP quality and HA failover, executing VLAN auto-config, and signing off in the deployment thread. No network activates without you.
- Keeping installs moving: Documenting progress across active deployments, pushing updates to technical project managers and stakeholders, and proactively surfacing blockers before they slip.
- Closing the feedback loop: Identifying recurring failure patterns and partnering with Operations Engineering to ship new playbooks, tooling, or product fixes.
- Building for the field: Translating technician insights into hardware and software improvements so our product is purpose-built for how installs actually happen.
WHERE THIS ROLE CAN TAKE YOU
In year two, you could design automated validation tools that remove manual install steps, lead the rollout of new technician onboarding programs that cut ramp time in half, and shape product improvements that fundamentally change how installations are done in the industry. Through all this, you’ll continue to provide a great experience with Meter for our Installation Partner Technicians. Your work will directly define how Meter scales installation quality and speed worldwide.
WHO YOU ARE
You thrive on solving complex networking problems in real time and making order out of chaos. You have strong Layer 2 and Layer 3 troubleshooting skills and excel in fast-moving environments where every deployment is different. You enjoy owning technical decisions during live deployments and keeping installations moving when unexpected challenges arise. You're comfortable partnering directly with field technicians, translating technical concepts into clear guidance, and making sound decisions when the path forward isn't immediately obvious. Beyond troubleshooting, you think systematically, identifying recurring operational pain points and building scalable processes, tooling, and documentation that make future deployments more reliable.
We are building towards 24/7 coverage. To that end, we are hiring across four shifts: Monday-Friday, Tuesday-Saturday, Sunday-Thursday, and Thursday-Monday. In your application, please note your preferences across these shifts.

FLEET PARTNERSHIPS
Meter builds enterprise networking as a service: we design, install, and manage the critical networking infrastructure modern companies run on. Every network that Meter deploys depends on technicians showing up on time, doing excellent work, and getting it right the first time. This is only possible when installation partners are supported, incentivized, and held to a high standard. Fleet Ops owns that loop.
Meter deploys networks through a global installation ecosystem we call Fleet - a network of partners and technicians responsible for building critical internet infrastructure. As Fleet scales, we need systems that ensure partners consistently deliver high-quality work across thousands of deployments.
In this role, you will build deep relationships with our installation and Fleet partners and build the systems that ensure they consistently deliver high-quality network deployments at scale. Your job is to make partners successful: driving performance, improving systems, and building the programs that help technicians do their best work.
If you do this well, partners will execute faster installs, higher quality work, and at a lower cost per deployment. This will drive scale globally and make Meter the best platform for partners to develop their technical practice and grow their business.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
In your first six months, you'll performance manage relationships that empower partners to do their best work. Success looks like:
- Technicians perform as an extension of Meter. Partners hit ≥ 95% on-time arrival, 100% documentation completeness, and reworks are <5%, driven by your cadence and accountability structure.
- Fleet capacity scales ahead of demand. You maintain a live view of each partner's capacity against forecasted volume, and proactively negotiate expansion - more named technicians, updated rate structures, renewed capacity agreements - before it becomes a bottleneck.
- Technicians want to work on Meter projects. You launch recognition programs that incentives motivate technicians to deliver exceptional work. Partners should feel like our product is built just for them, technicians should feel like our colleagues, and customers will love the outcome as a result.
- Technician feedback continuously improves the system. You launch partner scorecards, structured check-ins, and an engagement cadence so partners always know how they are performing and insights from the field consistently improve how Meter deploys networks.
WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL LOOK LIKE
This role sits at the center of the partner performance loop - the system that ensures Fleet partners consistently deliver high-quality deployments. A typical week might include:
- Running partner performance reviews and identifying improvement plans when partners miss KPIs.
- Reviewing upcoming deployment volume against current partner capacity, and proactively negotiating capacity expansion - new technicians, updated agreements - with partners who need to scale.
- Leading commercial conversations on rates, capacity commitments, and contract terms as partners grow with Meter.
- Meeting with Fleet technicians and partner leadership to understand operational challenges and unblock deployments.
- Designing incentive programs that reward technicians for quality work and on-time installs.
- Leading commercial onboarding for new partners entering the program.
- Translating partner feedback into improvements with internal teams like Ops Engineering, Dispatch, Fleet Sourcing, Technician Operations, Distribution, and Service Delivery.
- Advising Dispatch on partner capacity based on your commercial relationships and operational knowledge.
- Running recurring partner check-ins covering tactical execution and regular engagement in long-term business planning.
- Building the systems that power the partner network - dashboards, feedback loops, onboarding programs, and partner scorecards.
WHERE YOU CAN TAKE THIS ROLE
In year two, you could build the global performance system that powers Meter’s deployment network - from partner scorecards and incentive programs to technician certification and training. You will expand the installation partner ecosystem by onboarding and developing Fleet partners in new markets, manage Meter’s most strategic installation partners, or share insights that influence the next generation of installer tooling and operational systems that support Fleet.
Critical network infrastructure is built through a network of technicians and partners around the world, and the systems you build will directly shape how Meter scales its global deployment network. To be successful, Meter must become the best and most scaled platform for partners to build their business.
WHO YOU ARE
You thrive on building strong relationships while holding a high bar for operational performance. You enjoy working on physical-world programs, supporting operators in the field and are energized by building systems that help people do their best work. You’re comfortable holding partners accountable to clear standards while also advocating for them internally and translating their feedback into improvements across the organization. Most importantly, you communicate clearly, build trust with partners and internal teams, and stay calm when things get messy. You’re motivated by building systems that enable thousands of technicians and partners to deliver world-class infrastructure. You should increasingly have your own vision for how this program can impact the work and lives of our partners, technicians, and customers at global scale.
Travel: 30-40% travel expected - You’ll be in the field running in-person meetings, supporting onboarding, and seeing technicians at work firsthand. Being on-site with partners and technicians is essential to building trust and raising the bar.
WHY METER?
Meter is a vertically integrated networking company. Hardware, software, services, ISP, and autonomous networks—all built on a single data pipeline from the local network to the data center.
The internet runs the world. Every purchase you make, video call you join, it's all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven’t changed for decades. They’re brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.
We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground-up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, Reddit, rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.
Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable business to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.

We power card issuing for leading banks, fintechs and digital brands across the globe, and as we continue to grow, we are looking for curious, ambitious people who thrive on solving complex challenges, embrace innovation and want to make a tangible impact at global scale.
Role Purpose
The Financial Accountant is responsible for the end-to-end financial accounting and compliance activities for a few markets. This role ensures accurate and timely month-end close, statutory and tax compliance, audit support, balance sheet integrity, and financial reporting. The position works closely with Commercial Finance, Payroll, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Tax, and external advisors to deliver high-quality financial information, drive process improvements, and support business decision-making.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Close & Reporting
· Lead the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes for assigned markets, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
· Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and other accounting adjustments.
· Review and analyse profit and loss accounts and balance sheet movements.
· Ensure compliance with group accounting policies and local statutory requirements.
· Support the preparation of management reporting packages and financial analyses.
· Own and maintain balance sheet integrity through timely and accurate reconciliations. Investigate and resolve reconciling items and unusual transactions.
· Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, and governance requirements.
Tax Compliance
· Manage indirect tax compliance activities, including VAT/GST and other local tax filings.
· Support corporate income tax compliance, tax provisioning, and reporting requirements. Liaise with internal tax teams and external advisors to ensure compliance with local regulations.
· Support tax audits and regulatory inquiries.
· Manage legal entity transfer pricing recharge processes in line with group policies.
· Prepare and post intercompany charges and reconciliations.
· Resolve intercompany discrepancies and support transfer pricing documentation requirements.
Statutory Accounting & Audit management
· Prepare annual statutory financial statements and supporting disclosures for assigned legal entities.
· Coordinate local statutory filing requirements and ensure compliance with regulatory deadlines.
· Act as a key contact for external auditors and internal audit teams. Prepare audit schedules, supporting documentation, and responses to audit requests.
· Coordinate local and group audit activities and ensure timely issue resolution.
Business Partnering
· Collaborate closely with Commercial Finance to understand business performance and accounting impacts.
· Partner with Payroll, AP, AR, Treasury, Tax, and other finance functions to ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data.
· Provide accounting guidance and support to stakeholders across the business.
· Build effective relationships with external advisors, auditors, and service providers.
Process Improvement & Automation
· Continuously identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, and reporting efficiency.
· Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual activities and improve data quality.
· Support finance transformation projects and system enhancements.
· Promote best practices and standardisation across markets and entities.
Qualifications & Experience
Essential
· Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
· Previous experience in financial accounting, statutory accounting, or a similar role.
· Strong understanding of month-end close and balance sheet reconciliations.
· Experience with indirect taxes (VAT/GST) and corporate tax compliance.
· Experience supporting external and internal audits.
· Knowledge of IFRS and statutory reporting requirements.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
· Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems.
Desirable
· Experience managing multiple markets or legal entities.
· Knowledge of transfer pricing and intercompany accounting.
· Exposure to finance transformation, automation, or continuous improvement initiatives.
· Experience with SAGE Intacct, NetSuite, Dynamics, or similar finance systems.
