job-boards.greenhouse.io/ideo/jobs/80415.description_excerpt:
Strategy and Organisational Design Director— IDEO London

In a Nutshell

IDEO London is looking for a Strategy and Organisational Design Director who understands that strategy without activation is just intention — and that the gap between ambition and reality is where organisations most need a thinking partner.

This is a senior role for someone who reads organisations the way a designer reads a brief: with curiosity about what's really going on beneath the surface, and with a clear instinct for where the real levers for change are. You understand how systems work — how structure, incentives, culture, and leadership interact to make or break a strategy — and you know how to work with those forces rather than against them.

When organisations are navigating something genuinely hard or new — adapting to AI, restructuring how decisions get made, building new capabilities, shifting culture, or figuring out what to stop doing — they don't need more frameworks or slides. They need someone who can help them see the system clearly, make honest choices, and design a path forward that will actually stick. And they need the confidence to act.

You'll spend most of your time leading complex client engagements, particularly in our Health portfolio, directing multidisciplinary teams and building trusted relationships with senior leaders. Alongside that, you'll help build something: IDEO London's strategy and organisational design practice, at a moment when the studio is intentionally investing in depth, expertise, and the kind of work that moves organisations forward rather than producing reports about them.

About IDEO London:

We’re a global design consultancy where curiosity, empathy, and solving complex challenges drive us. For over 40 years, we’ve partnered with clients to innovate in healthcare, financial services, mobility, retail, and beyond. Here, every challenge is a chance to grow, connect, and create impact across our communities in the UK, US and Asia.

Why is this role important for IDEO's work?

Organisations today are facing increasing pressure to evolve: adapting to new technologies, shifting customer expectations, changing workforce dynamics, and growing complexity across systems and markets. Strategy alone is not enough. Organisations need support translating ambition into the structures, behaviours, capabilities, and ways of working that make change real.

This role sits at the heart of that shift. The clients who need us most are navigating real transformation — health organisations reinventing how they deliver care, companies trying to embed AI into how their people work, leadership teams grappling with the human cost of change that's moving too fast. They need someone who can see the whole system, name what's really holding things back, and design interventions that create lasting change rather than temporary momentum.

Strategy at IDEO is not just about the quality of the thinking in the room. It's about what happens when the engagement ends. This role exists to make sure that gap closes.

Once here you will

  • Lead complex strategy and organisational design engagements from framing through to activation — not just defining the direction, but designing what needs to change for that direction to become real
  • Read organisations as systems: understand the structures, incentives, behaviours, and cultures that shape how things actually work, and identify the levers most likely to drive meaningful, lasting change
  • Act as a senior client partner — building trust with leadership teams over time, shaping the conversation before the brief is written, scoping opportunities, and staying invested in outcomes long after the engagement closes
  • Direct multidisciplinary teams across strategy, research, and design, holding both rigour and creativity, and keeping work grounded in what will genuinely move the organisation forward
  • Help clients make honest strategic choices — not just articulating ambition, but surfacing trade-offs, challenging assumptions, and aligning leadership around what they're actually committing to
  • Prototype strategic and organisational futures in practice: test ideas through experimentation and iteration so clients build real confidence before they scale
  • Facilitate executive conversations that advance decisions rather than defer them — bringing both structure and sensitivity to rooms where the stakes are high and consensus is hard
  • Contribute to IDEO's strategy and organisational design practice: develop methods, build POVs, mentor colleagues, and help make the studio's expertise visible and distinctive
  • Coach and mentor designers and project leads, modelling excellent client communication, facilitation, and strategic thinking
  • Help clients navigate the human dimensions of AI adoption — how organisations restructure for it, how teams build confidence with it, and how leaders model the change they're asking of others
  • Represent IDEO externally through writing, talks, and relationships — contributing to how the studio is known in the market for the quality and seriousness of its strategy work

We're looking for

  • Someone with a strong track record leading innovation, strategy and organisational design engagements — in consulting, in-house, or both — with the scars and the wisdom that come from seeing what it actually takes to make change stick
  • A genuine systems thinker: you understand how organisations work as interconnected wholes, and you know how to identify the structural, behavioural, and cultural levers that matter most
  • Someone who is as comfortable designing an organisational future as they are facilitating the difficult leadership conversation that makes it real — you move between strategy and making with ease
  • Experience helping organisations navigate real transformation: not just documenting what needs to change, but designing the conditions — structures, capabilities, rhythms, behaviours — that allow change to take hold
  • Strong facilitation and narrative skills, including the ability to hold senior executive rooms with clarity and care, and to build alignment across organisations where people genuinely disagree
  • People leadership that creates conditions for good work — you know how to direct a multidisciplinary team, develop junior talent, and maintain creative rigour under pressure
  • Experience scoping and building new client relationships — you're comfortable writing a proposal, shaping a brief, and growing an account over time
  • Curiosity about the intersection of strategy, AI, and the human dimensions of organisational change — you don't need to be a technologist, but you understand…

CLINICAL DIRECTOR – COMPLEX CARE
Greenstaff & Clinical24
Location: England | Hybrid / Field-based

Greenstaff and Clinical24 are part of ICG Medical, an international healthcare business with a growing portfolio of complex care and community-based services.

As our complex care services continue to develop, we are looking for an experienced Clinical Director – Complex Care to provide senior, hands-on clinical leadership across both businesses.

This is not a purely strategic or corporate clinical role. The successful candidate will remain close to service delivery, working directly with clients, families, nurses and care teams to ensure complex packages are assessed, mobilised and delivered safely and to a consistently high standard.

The role will work closely with Operations, Mobilisation and Compliance, with professional accountability into the Chief Nurse.

Key responsibilities:
- Provide clinical leadership and oversight across complex care packages.
- Undertake and support clinical assessments, care planning and risk assessment.
- Ensure appropriate clinical input is in place before new packages are accepted and mobilised.
- Support mobilisation of new complex care services and ensure clinical readiness prior to go-live.
- Lead on clinical competency, delegation, supervision and development of nurses and care teams.
- Visit clients and services regularly to maintain strong clinical oversight and support delivery teams.
- Review incidents, complaints and clinical concerns, ensuring learning is translated into improved practice.
- Work closely with Operations, Compliance and Mobilisation to ensure services are safe, effective and operationally deliverable.
- Support continuous improvement, clinical governance and CQC readiness across complex care services.
- Provide practical clinical leadership and intervention where services or packages require additional support.

About you:
You will be a Registered Nurse with current NMC registration and significant experience working with complex care in community, homecare or a similar environment.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have:
- Senior clinical leadership experience, ideally at Band 7 level or above.
- Strong experience of complex physical health needs and high-acuity care.
- Experience assessing and mobilising complex care packages.
- Experience training, supervising and assessing staff competency.
- A strong understanding of clinical governance, safeguarding and CQC requirements.
- The confidence to work independently and make sound clinical decisions.
- The ability to combine senior clinical leadership with a practical, hands-on approach.

Regular travel to client homes and service locations will be required, along with some flexibility outside normal office hours where service needs require it.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping and developing a growing complex care service while remaining closely involved in the quality of care delivered to clients.

ICG Medical is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/minitab/jobs/79.description_excerpt:

  • A structured sales enablement programme and clear career development framework to support sustained success and professional growth

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting organisations whose work positively influences people and communities across the region


Who We Are Seeking

  • A commercially astute and intellectually curious sales professional who enjoys uncovering customers’ business challenges and delivering long-term value

  • A consistent high performer with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets

  • Demonstrated experience in value-based selling of complex software solutions to large enterprise customers (typically €1B+ revenue organisations) across 6–9 month sales cycles

Sell solutions with a meaningful impact.
Our customers use Minitab to improve quality, eliminate waste, increase efficiency and solve important real world problems.


Build on a respected global reputation.

Develop valuable expertise.

Create lasting customer relationships.
Our broad portfolio gives you opportunities to solve an immediate challenge and then grow alongside customers as their requirements evolve.

You’ll help shape what we build next and how we build it. You’ll work with new models, solve real customer problems, and take your ideas from experiment to production. If you want to build agents people actually rely on, we’d like to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Ship the full experience. Build in-product chat, streaming responses, permission-aware APIs, and our external MCP server
  • Make quality measurable. Build evals, catch regressions, and use production feedback to improve quality, latency, and cost
  • Help shape the platform. Make decisions about how we build, deploy, and run agents as the product grows

To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You'll Need to Have

We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You Will Be Working With

As a Creative Copywriting Senior Associate, you’ll be part of a creative team that cares deeply about craft—writers, designers, producers, and creative leads who like pushing ideas further while keeping the work grounded in what the audience actually feels and needs. You’ll partner closely with creative leadership to shape concepts, refine language, and bring strong copy to life across different formats and channels.

You’ll also collaborate with strategy and account teammates who help clarify the “why” behind the work—audience insight, brand goals, and the role each message plays in a bigger campaign. At times, you’ll work directly with clients, presenting copy directions, explaining your thinking, and helping teams land on language that feels true to the brand and clear to the customer.

What You Will Be Doing
  • Write original, engaging copy across a range of projects—campaigns, brand storytelling, product and service messaging, and content systems.
  • Adapt your voice quickly and thoughtfully, capturing the tone and personality of multiple brands without losing clarity or consistency.
  • Take briefs from early concept to polished execution, exploring different angles and elevating ideas through strong language and structure.
  • Present copy and creative concepts with confidence, explaining how the work supports both the creative vision and the business goal.
  • Bring sharp attention to detail—tight edits, clean grammar, and wording that feels intentional in every headline, CTA, and long-form line.
  • Spot content opportunities by paying attention to audience behavior, customer needs, and cultural moments that can make messaging feel more relevant.
  • Stay current on trends in advertising, design, and culture, using what you learn to strengthen the work (not distract from it).
  • Use available tools—including AI where helpful—to speed up exploration, sharpen drafts, and streamline workflows while keeping the final voice human and brand-true.

What You Will Bring
  • 3+ years of experience in copywriting, ideally in an agency or high-growth brand environment
  • Strong writing fundamentals and a clear point of view—your work is polished, purposeful, and easy to understand.
  • Experience creating copy for integrated campaigns and performance channels.
  • Proficiency in writing for digital platforms, especially paid social, video, and web.
  • Range: you can shift tone, voice, and format depending on the brand, the channel, and the audience.
  • Conceptual strength: you can generate ideas, not just lines—and you enjoy pushing beyond the first draft.
  • Confidence presenting your work and taking feedback well, with the ability to improve copy without losing the original intent.
  • A good instinct for what makes messaging effective, and curiosity about how creative connects to real customer action.
  • Organization and follow-through: you manage revisions, deadlines, and details without the work feeling rushed.
  • Comfort using modern tools to work efficiently, with good judgment about when AI helps and when it does not.
  • A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.
  • A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by Leading by Example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

  • Professional Development: Take advantage of our learning and development programmes, mentorship opportunities, and career advancement support.
  • Generous Annual Leave: Benefit from our substantial holiday allowance pto recharge and spend time with loved ones.
  • Parental Leave: We provide parental leave to support your family during important life events.
  • Pension Plan: Plan for your future with up to a competitive 5% contribution match.
  • Healthcare: Our Cash Benefit Health Plan ensures coverage for everyday medical expenses and routine care.
  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Enjoy 100% company-funded accounts to promote healthy habits and well-being.
  • Commuter Spending Account: Receive company-subsidised support for your travel to the office, making your commute more convenient and affordable.
  • Annual Bonus: All employees are eligible for an annual bonus.
  • Volunteering Opportunities: Receive 8 give-back hours to volunteer in your local community
  • AI Enterprise License: Access AI Enterprise accounts and participate in weekly AI training sessions to empower and ensure AI safety.

 

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s focused on outcomes not outputs. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

 

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/pendo/jobs/8859.description_excerpt:
The Team + The Role

Pendo’s Customer Engineering team is the technical backbone of the pre- and post-sales customer motion.

The team brings together work across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Solutions Engineering into one full-lifecycle technical owner. Customer Engineering helps customers connect technical execution to business outcomes and realize the value of their investment in Pendo.

As a Senior Customer Engineer  you will own strategic and complex Enterprise accounts across acquisition, implementation, adoption, expansion, and escalation. You will lead technical strategy for complex deployments, resolve ambiguous customer challenges, and partner closely with account teams to drive retention, expansion, and customer value. Your impact will extend beyond your own accounts through playbooks, coaching, repeatable fixes, and workflow improvements that raise the capability of the broader Customer Engineering team.

This role is based in our London office. 

What this looks like day-to-day

  • New customer acquisition and selling: Partner with Account Directors on pre-sales motions for new customer acquisition, product expansion, and growth across lines of business. You identify customer pain, craft and deliver tailored demos, and lead technical evaluations through requirements gathering, success criteria, installation guidance, and hands-on workshops.
  • Quarterly business outcomes: Drive measurable improvement in customer health, retention, expansion, and technical resolution across strategic accounts. You contribute at least one reusable framework, playbook, or process that other Customer Engineers use and become a trusted advisor to Account Directors on account health and technical strategy.
  • Adoption, expansion, and growth: Identify opportunities to expand adoption across underutilized features, untapped products, and new lines of business. When adoption stalls, you diagnose root causes, design a path forward, and connect technical work to measurable business outcomes.
  • Complex implementations and value realization: Lead onboarding for strategic customers, including planning, implementation, integrations, and training. You build customer-specific implementation playbooks, guide complex deployments with executive visibility, and ensure customers realize value during onboarding and over time.
  • Team capability building: Build playbooks, document repeatable fixes, coach peers, and improve how Customer Engineering work gets done across the team. You use AI tools to accelerate content creation, surface patterns across accounts, and share practical workflow findings with the broader team.
  • Early account impact: Assess account health, risks, stakeholder relationships, and the highest-priority problems to solve within your portfolio. You establish trust with Account Directors and customer stakeholders, then independently lead complex customer interactions that move accounts forward.
  • Technical escalation: Serve as an escalation point for complex technical challenges raised by other Customer Engineers. You resolve ambiguous problems with multiple variables and tradeoffs, involving Product or Engineering only when truly needed.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.
You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Customer Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.
You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

  • Passion for working with customers and building strong and impactful customer relationships
  • 5 to 8 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, Customer Engineering, implementation, professional services, or solutions architecture.
  • Deep hands-on experience with web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and REST APIs, with the ability to architect and troubleshoot complex front-end implementations.
  • Proven experience managing strategic Enterprise accounts with executive-level stakeholders, competing priorities, and complex technical or business requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems involving multiple variables, constraints, and tradeoffs.
  • Experience connecting technical execution to business outcomes such as retention, expansion, ROI, and value realization.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools for account research, content creation, or workflow automation, with demonstrated integration into day-to-day work rather than light experimentation.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching more junior technical team members.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Pendo, digital adoption platforms, product analytics, or in-app experience tooling in an enterprise environment.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile app development, including Swift, Android, or React Native.
  • Familiarity with data architecture, AI or machine learning concepts, or advanced analytics instrumentation.
  • Track record of building reusable frameworks, playbooks, or processes that were adopted by a broader team.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week in London,…

Role Overview - Primary Objective

To help deliver next generation instruments involving a combination of lasers, electro-optics systems, 3D positioners, high speed CMOS detectors and microfluidics.

How you'll achieve it

Working in the engineering function alongside multidisciplinary engineers, the system engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining Refeyn’s cutting edge technology platforms and will lead and participate in high-level instrument design choices, definition of module boundaries and the integration of new and improved modules/features into the broader technology platform. The system engineer will work closely with research, engineering, software, product, and operations teams, to translate product requirements into technical specifications and actionable design verification plans. The system engineer will be responsible for scoping future product/system requirements, scoping their architecture and how they will fit/interact with our current systems, and planning for this integration/upgrade. They will take ownership for the delivery of all technical and customer facing specification for new products and systems.

Key responsibilities for this role include:  

  • Provide technical and scientific insight to develop/deliver new innovations in the implementation mass photometry for next generation instruments and submodules, including optical/electro-optical design and data analysis approaches, from proof of concept to production handover.
  • Concepting, designing, building and troubleshooting prototype optical microscopy instruments that measure single molecule properties based on the detection of light scattering.
  • Analysing complex data sets taken on custom built hardware to evaluate instrument performance and
  • Working closely with applications specialists, systems engineers and software developers to deliver new designs or features.
  • Understand and define complex technical specifications and requirements and interpret these to realise new designs/features quickly.
  • Actively participating in the growth of Refeyn’s IP portfolio and identifying patentable IP.
  • Keep up to date on the cutting-edge advances in the fields of light microscopy, light scattering and single molecule bioanalytics, with a view to offer novel approaches and improvements to our technology roadmap.

We are ideally looking for someone with the following skills and experience:

  • BSc Engineering (all fields) or equivalent experience
  • Self-starting and excited by the prospect of working alongside/contributing to a multi-disciplinary team focussed on developing novel high-tech instrumentation.
  • Relevant experience in an optics/electro-optics background, for example: a PhD in Microscopy/laser optics/Nano-optics and a degree in a related field
  • Design/alignment/troubleshooting of optical equipment; Building new optics systems in microscopy or similar technologies.
  • Data analysis in C/C++/Python/Matlab or similar package – ability to perform complex analysis on novel data.

We know there is no such thing as the perfect candidate and that there is great value in transferrable skills, so please don’t feel you have to tick all of the above boxes to apply!

Why work for Refeyn?

Compensation and core benefits

  • We anticipate a base salary of £34,000 to £39,000 for this role, depending on candidate experience 
  • 25 days annual leave per year in addition to bank holidays
  • Up to 7% employer matched pension contribution
  • Private health insurance from day one plus Medicash, critical illness cover, income protection and life insurance
  • Give as You Earn and Cycle to Work salary sacrifice schemes.
  • Annual Company and Individual bonus scheme 
  • Paid volunteer day each year

Family Friendly Benefits

Refeyn offers YellowNest Nursery Scheme to all employees once probation is passed, and new parents can benefit from up to 17 weeks fully paid maternity, adoption and shared parental leave, 4 weeks fully paid paternity leave, plus an annual allowance for emergency childcare.

Supporting your Development

All employees receive access to Linkedin Learning which offers thousands of courses to support their personal and professional development. We also run frequent training sessions on both hard and soft skills.

Creating an Engaging Culture

Refeyn supports hybrid working where the role allows and offers flexible start and finish times. We also have a subsidised weekly lunch for onsite employees and a vibrant social calendar which includes holiday parties and midsummer festivals plus an annual team budget for managers to plan team-building activities.

Values-Led 

Refeyn is committed to celebrating each other’s differences and creating a dynamic, driven and diverse culture where everyone can flourish. We are proud to have been awarded Committed Status by the Inclusive Employers Standard in 2024 and are working hard to create a safe and empowering environment for all.

We firmly believe that there is great strength in building teams with different voices, experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds so that we can continue to share the team workload and enable our customers to succeed, and we welcome applicants from all sections of society to join us on our mission to advance discovery through innovation. 

Expected Interview Plan

  • Initial Teams call with the hiring manager (30 minutes)
  • Onsite panel interview with presentation, case study, and site tour (1hr 45 minutes)
  • Final call with Chief Product and Marketing Officer (30 minutes)

About the Role:

Refeyn is scaling its mass photometry platform from a research instrument into a bioprocessing-grade analytical capability. That ambition runs through a growing portfolio of development programmes across instrument, consumables and software, each with its own dependencies, readiness gates and stakeholders.

We are looking for a Project Manager to join the Project Management Office (PMO) and take ownership of programmes within that portfolio, working at the interface of R&D, Operations, Quality and Commercial. You will own delivery end-to-end, ensuring each programme reaches its gates with clear ownership, controlled cost and managed cross-workstream dependencies.

This is a delivery-focused role in a matrix organisation. You will not have direct authority over the functional specialists you coordinate. Your impact comes from structure, accountability and clear communication.

Primary responsibilities for this role include:  

  • Own end-to-end project plans for assigned development programmes, from concept through to launch, with defined stage gates and readiness criteria at each phase.
  • Translate strategy into executable workstreams, sequencing delivery against our priority domains and their technical dependencies.
  • Drive cross-functional accountability across R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality and Regulatory, and Product Management.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget and risk, maintaining a single source of truth for status, dependencies and critical path. Surface trade-offs early to leadership.
  • Coordinate design control activities where applicable, ensuring documentation, verification and validation are planned and on track for a regulated environment.
  • Support engagement with external partners and suppliers, including cadence, deliverables and escalation.
  • Run effective governance: steering reviews, gate decisions, status reporting and minutes, keeping functional leads and senior stakeholders aligned.
  • Identify and remove blockers, anticipating dependency conflicts across workstreams before they hit the critical path.
  • Contribute to the development of PMO standards, templates and ways of working, applying them consistently across the portfolio.

We are ideally looking for someone with the following skills and experience:

  • Track record of working in a matrix organisation, securing delivery through influence rather than direct authority.
  • Strong grasp of a stage-gate or phase-gate development process, and familiarity with design control fundamentals (V&V, design transfer, change control).
  • Enough technical comfort to support estimates, interrogate risk and hold a credible conversation with R&D specialists.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication: direct, structured and clear, able to brief both bench scientists and senior leadership.
  • Fluency with project and portfolio tooling and a disciplined approach to status, risk and dependency tracking.
  • Smartsheet experience would be an advantage but is teachable

About Glean:
 
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
 
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
 
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
 
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a Partner Sales Manager to build and manage strategic partners to expand Glean’s customer reach in Europe. This individual will be closely aligned to multiple sales segment teams and be responsible for building and executing the partner strategy to drive meaningful revenue impact—in a hands-on, results-oriented role.

You will: 

  • Build and maintain executive and working-level relationships across key partnerships and the Glean sales teams that translate into measurable sourced and influenced pipeline growth
  • Educate and coach the Glean Sales teams on the “why” and the “how” of scaling with our revenue growth with partners
  • Define and operationalize co-selling and co-delivery motions that are aligned with Glean’s field priorities and designed to scale with the right partners.
  • Build repeatable plays for sourcing new opportunities, including campaigns, events, account mapping, and outbound motions, and maintain clear visibility into partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, SE, Marketing, Operations, and Legal to simplify and scale partner processes such as deal registration, approvals, contracts, MDF and reporting.
  • Embed with the sales organization by aligning partners to territories, participating in key deal reviews and account planning, and ensuring partners feel like an extension of the Glean field teams.

About you:

  • Outcome- and revenue-oriented partner leader who thinks like a GM/business owner, not just a relationship manager, and is comfortable being accountable for partner-driven pipeline and bookings.
  • 5-8 years experience in channel, alliances, partner management, or business development roles in B2B SaaS.
  • Background in search, AI, productivity, or enterprise SaaS is required. With at least 1-2 years of experience in frontier AI sales, having worked on and delivered projects — either directly with customers or via partners — implementing AI solutions.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, activating, and growing SI/VAR or similar partners, not just managing inherited relationships.
  • Strong collaborator with sales, with experience working in tight lockstep with regional leaders and field reps to align partners to territories, accounts, and plays.
  • Excellent communicator and influencer, comfortable presenting to executives, negotiating with partner leaders, and coaching partner sellers and SEs.
  • Familiarity with modern sales and partner tooling, including CRM, PRM, and reporting/BI tools, and comfort navigating evolving tech stacks.
  • Able to travel periodically to partners, key accounts, and internal events, including SKOs and GKOs, as needed.
  • Experience operating across multiple European markets, comfortable navigating different languages, business cultures, and regulatory environments to expand partner coverage.

Nice to have:

  • German language proficiency to support partnerships…

About the Role:
 
The Solution Engineer role sits within the GTM organisation within the UK&I region, making you a trusted technical advisor to the local sales team, our partners, and our customers. These platforms include Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, and everything in between! As an SE, you will work closely with our local Account Executives (AEs) and will be responsible for the technical success and delivery of our sales opportunities.

We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

Calling all Greater London Uni students! 

As Hasbro continues to build our UK summer internship program, we’re hosting a curated networking event in London for a select group of high-caliber undergraduate students across commercial, marketing, finance, merchandising, design, engineering and related disciplines.

 

Experience. Connect. Imagine Your Future.

Join Hasbro’s Early Careers team for a special event to discover what it means to bring joy and play to millions of families around the world! From Magic: The Gathering and Dungeons & Dragons to Monopoly, Peppa Pig, Play-Doh, and Transformers, Hasbro’s brands are part of families’ lives everywhere.

This event is designed for students who are curious about career opportunities at Hasbro. You’ll meet members of our Early Careers team, former interns, and business leaders to learn about life and culture at Hasbro, and get an overview of our 2027 Internship Program. It’s a relaxed, conversational evening to ask questions, build connections, and find where your interests and talents might fit, all from wherever you are.

Whether you’re drawn to Marketing, Finance, Design, or another business function, this is your chance to explore the paths available to you!

 

WHERE: 📍 Central London

DATE: 📅 Tuesday, November 3rd

TIME: 🕖 5:00pm - 7:30pm

 

 

What to Expect

🚀 Hasbro’s Vision & the 2027 Internship Program

We’ll kick off the evening with a presentation on Hasbro’s vision, culture, and business priorities, plus an overview of the 2027 Internship Program, including what we look for, development opportunities, and how to apply.

🌍 Explore Careers at Hasbro

Get an inside look at the business functions where interns work, the projects they take on, and how these teams come together to support Hasbro’s brands.

🤝 Networking & Game play

As the company behind Monopoly, Nerf, Dungeons & Dragons, Magic: The Gathering, My Little Pony and more, Hasbro operates at the intersection of global brand strategy, consumer insight, product innovation and creativity. And, of course, experience a bit of gameplay with peers (it wouldn’t be Hasbro without it)!

We’re particularly eager to connect with students who combine strong academic performance with intellectual curiosity — and ideally, a genuine interest in the brands and games that shape culture. Preference for 2028 & 2029 graduates!

As capacity is limited (40–50 students), attendance & address will be confirmed following review of registrations.  Applying to this post expresses INTEREST in attending the event and is not considered an application for internships.

**REGISTRATION CLOSES October 29th!**

 

Employees may be eligible for annual and long-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package, depending on role, location, and eligibility. Benefits and programs may include:

  • Health & Wellness
  • Time Off to Recharge
  • Financial Well-being
  • Life & Family Support
  • Volunteer and Community Initiatives
  • Learning & Development 
  • Exclusive Perks

Senior Financial Analyst: Licensing Consumer Products

This role is based at our Capper Street (London) Office. It follows a hybrid working model, with required in-office presence on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, while offering flexibility for remote work on Mondays and Fridays.

Are you an experienced Senior Financial Analyst looking for a challenge? We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Financial Analyst to join our Licensing Finance team. The successful candidate will play a critical role in analysing, budgeting, forecasting, and planning activities to ensure accurate financial projections and strategic decision-making.

The Senior Financial Analyst will play a pivotal role in providing financial insights and analysis. You will be responsible for interpreting financial data, developing forecasts, and producing reports to aid key decision-making. Daily, you will work alongside various teams to ensure cohesive analytics, budgeting, financial planning, and performance evaluation. Additionally, you will play an active role in driving ongoing process improvements.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a company that is constantly innovating and creating content and products that bring joy to millions of fans worldwide!

job-boards.greenhouse.io/hasbro/jobs/439.description_excerpt:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

At Hasbro, play is at the heart of everything we do, and so is making sure that play is safe. 

We are looking for an experienced quality, regulatory and compliance leader to head our EMEA team, driving product safety and technical compliance across Hasbro and licensed product. You will lead a specialist QA team, act as Hasbro's technical voice in the industry bodies that shape toy regulation, and partner with global stakeholders to ensure our products meet the highest safety standards in every market they reach. 

You will join a global QA team that is every bit as passionate about safety as we are about having fun. If you want to make a measurable impact on an iconic brand portfolio, we would like to hear from you. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Represent Hasbro in industry and standardization bodies including TIE, TA, ATPA, BTHA, FJP, AFNOR, CEN and ISO, shaping proportionate regulation and standards for the company and the wider toy industry. 
  • Lead and develop the EMEA QA team, setting technical direction and providing authoritative interpretation of regulatory and licensing requirements. 
  • Monitor regulatory change across EMEA, assess business exposure, and lead engagement with industry associations to mitigate impact. 
  • Own the Regulatory Change Management Process for the region, ensuring new requirements are implemented on time and verified. 
  • Develop compliance strategies for complex markets, notably distributor territories and the GCC region including Saudi Arabia, and equip local teams to meet their national requirements. 
  • Partner with global QA licensing and EMEA licensing leadership to define, communicate and operate licensing compliance processes. 
  • Support global development teams on new product lines: research applicable requirements and translate them into product specifications and certification programs. 
  • Act as escalation point for market surveillance authorities and consumer safety complaints, applying balanced, ethical judgment where compliance and commercial pressures meet. 

What will you bring 

  • 8+ years in product regulatory or compliance, including experience leading or mentoring across multiple markets. 
  • Deep working knowledge of toy safety standards and legislation worldwide. 
  • Command of EMEA and global regulation affecting Hasbro and licensed product, including REACH, the General Product Safety Regulation and the wider framework. 
  • Working knowledge of requirements beyond the toy scope, covering 14+ product, adult collectibles and games, where the General Product Safety Regulation and related standards apply rather than toy safety legislation. 
  • Proven experience leading a Regulatory Change Management process end to end. 
  • Practical grounding in consumer product safety testing requirements. 
  • Understanding of children's play patterns and how they interact with toys and games. 
  • Experience representing a business with trade associations, regulators and market surveillance authorities. 
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and influence across a global, multicultural team. 
  • Fluent English; additional European languages an advantage. 
  • Navigate tight deadlines, shifting regulation and ambiguity with a positive mindset, a focus on solutions and a sense of humor. 
  • Thrive in an environment of continuous improvement and learning. 

 

We are an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer 

Hasbro is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment. We are committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

Purpose of Role:
SheMed is looking for a Head of Retention to own our end-to-end retention strategy, from the numbers that define success to the team and processes that deliver it. You’ll set the strategic direction for how we keep members engaged and in-programme for longer, and you’ll build the operating model and team needed to execute it.

This is a build-and-run role. You’ll spend the first chapter defining the strategy and standing up the team and testing infrastructure, and every chapter after that using data and experimentation to compound retention gains. You’ll work daily across Product, Tech, CRM, Support and Strategy, and you’ll be the person leadership turns to for “what’s our retention number going to be, and what are we doing about it.”

What You'll Work On:
Own the retention strategy

  • Define SheMed’s end-to-end retention strategy, from onboarding through renewal, and translate leadership goals into a clear roadmap with owners and outcomes.
  • Set the retention agenda rather than just coordinate other people’s initiatives, make the call on where to invest, what to sunset, and what to prioritise when trade-offs come up.
  • Own the retention P&L logic: understand how retention moves LTV, CAC payback, and overall unit economics, and make the case for investment accordingly.

Build and lead the team

  • Design and build out a dedicated retention function , define the roles you need (e.g. lifecycle, retention analyst, experimentation), hire, and manage the team as it grows.
  • Set ways of working for the function: how work gets prioritised, how experiments get greenlit, how wins get shared back to the business.

Test, learn, and experiment

  • Build a structured experimentation programme (A/B and multivariate testing) covering lifecycle messaging, in-app journeys, onboarding, win-back, and pricing/packaging levers that affect retention.
  • Establish a test-and-learn cadence: hypothesis backlog, prioritisation framework, statistical rigour, and a clear loop from insight to shipped change.
  • Be scrappy where speed matters and rigorous where the stakes are high, know which mode a given initiative calls for.

Drive cross-functional execution

  • Be the connective tissue across Marketing, Product, Tech, Clinical, CRM and Support so retention tactics are aligned, not duplicated, and executed with clear accountability.
  • Partner with Product and Clinical to introduce features that support retention directly,  habit-forming mechanics, health tracking, milestone recognition, member-exclusive content.
  • Support the design of segmented, personalised email, SMS, and in-app journeys tied to customer education, milestones, and health goals.

Measure and report

  • Partner with the data team to define success metrics for every retention initiative; own churn rate, LTV, cohort retention curves, and forecasting.
  • Work with the data team to build retention dashboards and reporting that show what’s working, what isn’t, and why and then importantly use them to drive decisions, not just describe history.
  • Report on progress against KPIs monthly, quarterly and annually to leadership.

Build the voice-of-member feedback loop

  • Launch in-product surveys, calls, and forums to understand why members stay and why they leave.
  • Turn qualitative insight (Product, CX, Marketing) into an actionable, prioritised backlog of retention initiatives.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Have ~6 years of experience in a retention, growth, lifecycle, or customer engagement role — ideally in a healthtech, DTC, or subscription-based startup.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to keep multiple teams aligned and focused on goals.
  • Data-driven mindset with a proven track record of hitting retention targets.

  • Are energised by fast-paced, high-growth environments where things are always changing.

About the Role

iCapital is seeking a Vice President, Regulatory & Compliance to join its International Regulatory & Compliance Team, based in London. This role will support a broad range of regulatory, compliance, corporate governance, and risk management activities across the firm's UK and EMEA operations.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior members of the International Regulatory & Compliance Team to help maintain and enhance the firm's compliance framework, support regulatory obligations, and partner with the business teams to ensure that our UK & EMEA offices are operating within the letter and the spirit of the regulations.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to multiple regulatory regimes, private markets distribution, corporate governance, and international compliance matters within a fast-growing global organization.

  • Provide compliance guidance and reviews of financial promotions, distribution activities, conflicts of interest, AML/CFT, staff compliance, and other regulatory matters.
  • Develop and undertake risk-based assessments, compliance monitoring and testing, and support the deployment and remediation of identified issues.
  • Oversee and deliver compliance training and maintain appropriate training records.
  • Support regulatory reporting and governance obligations, including FCA filings and attending board meetings.
  • Maintain corporate governance records, regulatory registers and filings, board documentation, and support responses to regulatory enquiries, audits, and examinations.
  • Assist with financial crime and employee compliance programmes, including third party onboarding, AML/CFT, sanctions, personal account dealing, gifts and entertainment, outside business interests, annual attestations, investigations, incidents, breaches, and regulatory recordkeeping.

  • Work closely with senior management, colleagues, regulators and external stakeholders to identify and mitigate regulatory and compliance risks for the firm and its clients.

  • Understanding of financial crime requirements, including AML, sanctions, and KYC obligations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical, and organizational skills.

About the Role

iCapital is looking to hire a Vice President to lead go-to-market for iCapital Passthrough, iCapital’s business for non-advised investors, across the United Kingdom and Europe. This is the first dedicated commercial hire for Passthrough in the region, and the remit is deliberately broader than its US equivalents: one person owning the full-cycle sales motion and the partner channel that feeds it.

The business serves general partners who onboard investors directly, outside of wealth management channels. The individual in this role will own that market in Europe end to end, sourcing and closing new fund manager customers while building out existing and creating new fund administrator, law firm, and technology partnerships that generate referrals into the platform.

iCapital is the leading international player in private markets technology and distribution, with an established presence and deep relationships across the UK and Europe. This role is the chance to build a new business line with that platform, brand, and network already in market rather than from a standing start.

The position reports jointly to the Managing Director, GP Onboarding Solution and to the Managing Director, International Asset Manager Solutions. The successful candidate will carry an individual revenue number while working closely with iCapital's existing international coverage teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle new client revenue for Passthrough across the UK and Europe, from first touch through signature, for both self-sourced and partner-sourced opportunities.
  • Consistently meet or exceed an annual revenue quota of approximately $900,000 to $1,000,000 in year one, scaling as the market matures.
  • Own the top of the funnel and prospect directly into general partners across the region. There is no dedicated sales development support in Europe, so pipeline generation is part of this job rather than a stage handed over to you.
  • Build and activate the European partner channel across fund administrators, fund formation counsel, and technology and API partners, from sourcing and pitching through structuring, launch, and ongoing management, including converting existing inbound interest from current partners.
  • Act as Europe's Passthrough product expert, supporting iCapital's international asset manager coverage teams where their relationships intersect with the platform, while independently running your own book of business.
  • Become an expert on the European private funds landscape and articulate the value proposition credibly to COOs, CFOs, General Counsel, and Investor Relations leaders at fund managers.
  • Test and document what the European market will bear on pricing and packaging, structuring deals within agreed commercial guardrails.
  • Keep meticulous records of all activity in the CRM to ensure predictable and accurate forecasting.
  • Provide structured monthly feedback to the product team on European requirements, including GDPR, AIFMD, and local KYC and AML considerations.
  • Represent Passthrough at European industry events and conferences, drawing on central iCapital marketing support.
  • Travel regularly across the UK and Europe for client meetings, partner meetings, and industry events.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in full-cycle B2B sales, business development, or partnerships, with a demonstrated record of personally generating, running, and signing new business. This is not a relationship management or account coverage role, though you will be able to take advantage of iCapital’s deep relationships.
  • A track record of carrying and meeting an individual revenue quota.
  • Established relationships with general partners, fund administrators, and/or fund formation counsel in the UK and Europe.
  • Fluency in private markets, with the credibility to hold a substantive conversation with a fund COO, General Counsel, or Investor Relations lead about how capital is raised and investors are onboarded.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity. This role has not existed before, and the playbook will be built instead of inherited.
  • Experience selling to or through channel partners is a strong plus.
  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company is a strong plus.
  • Experience on the allocator side, whether at an LP, fund of funds, investment consultancy, or placement agent, is valued for the industry fluency it brings, though it does not substitute for closing experience.
  • German or French language ability is useful but not required.

job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/spektr/jobs/.description_excerpt:
We’re hiring Account Executives to win and grow some of the most exciting accounts in financial services. You’ll own $100K+ deals, work closely with our founders and help shape how we sell a product that can change the way an entire industry operates.

You’ll have inbound interest, RFP opportunities, partner introductions and creative outreach to work with, alongside Commercial Associates and a team that gets behind its sellers. Your job is to turn that opportunity into lasting customer relationships and revenue.

About us

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

  • $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.
  • Founders who have done this before. Mikkel and Cip built HelloFlow together and sold it to Trulioo in 2022. They’re now building spektr alongside co-founders Jan-Erik and Jeremy, taking on a much bigger part of the customer lifecycle.
  • Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.
  • Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

What you’ll do

  • Own your accounts and deals. Set the account strategy and lead the sales cycle, from discovery and qualification through proposals, pricing, negotiation and signature.
  • Build relationships across the buying team. Understand what matters to Product, Operations and Compliance, develop champions and bring decision-makers together around a clear business case.
  • Make the product real for customers. Learn the platform deeply, lead tailored demos and work with spektrQ, our implementation team, on more involved demos and proofs of concept.
  • Turn interest into business. Progress inbound enquiries, partner introductions and RFP opportunities, while building new opportunities in your priority accounts.
  • Work closely with Commercial Associates. Collaborate on research, outreach, meeting preparation and live deals. Give them context, share your judgement and help them take on more responsibility.
  • Grow the accounts you win. Work with spektrQ to identify where customers could do more with spektr, then own the commercial side of expansion into new use cases, teams and markets.
  • Keep deals moving. Follow up persistently, make next steps clear and maintain an honest forecast. Bring problems to the team early and help improve how we sell.

How we work

You own the deal. The whole company helps you win it.

Our AEs work closely with Commercial Associates throughout the sales process. spektrQ helps demonstrate what’s possible and how we’ll deliver it. Growth, marketing and partnerships create reasons for prospects to engage, and the founders get involved in strategic deals. You’ll have people to build with, challenge your thinking and help get things over the line.

We already have inbound interest and many opportunities to compete in RFPs. Alongside that, we actively go after the accounts we most want to work with. You’ll be expected to create opportunities too, with support and plenty of freedom in how you do it.

We pride ourselves on being one of the most creative outreach teams around. Nobody likes generic outreach. We send custom comics, make videos around a prospect’s business and bring people together at events. Sometimes a thoughtful email or a phone call is exactly what’s needed. Bring a good idea and you’ll find people who want to help make it happen.

Who you are

  • An experienced B2B software seller. You’ve owned complex sales cycles, closed substantial deals and can explain how you made them happen.
  • Comfortable building in an early-stage company. You’ve helped develop a sales approach, opened accounts or built a market. Founding AE experience is especially relevant.
  • Strong at discovery and commercial judgement. You can uncover the real problem, understand a buying process, build a business case and negotiate with confidence.
  • Personable and credible. You build trust with senior people, ask good questions and know how to win support across a buying team.
  • Curious about the product. You want to use it, understand it and show customers what they could build with it.
  • Resourceful and persistent. You take initiative, find ways around obstacles and keep following up.
  • Generous with what you know. You enjoy developing others, work well across teams and take feedback as readily as you give it.

Experience selling into financial services or regulated businesses is useful. What matters most is your ability to learn a complex product, understand the customer and close.

Why join

  • $100K+ deals, with relatively quick sales cycles for our industry. Win substantial business with ambitious companies, with room to grow those accounts as they adopt more of the platform.
  • A product you can believe in. Work with technology already used by demanding financial businesses, in an industry ready for a better way of doing things.
  • Several ways into a deal. Build on inbound interest, RFPs, partnerships and events, alongside targeted outreach.
  • A team behind you. Work with Commercial Associates, product experts and founders who get involved in helping you win.
  • A chance to shape the company. Help build our commercial approach, develop people and feed what you learn from customers directly into the business.

The…

We’re hiring Commercial Associates to help us win some of the most exciting accounts in financial services. You’ll work closely with our commercial and founding teams on everything from opening doors to shaping deal strategy and bringing the product to life. If you want to learn fast, take responsibility and help build a company, read on.

This isn’t an SDR or BDR role. You’ll be involved beyond the first meeting, helping shape deals and build customer relationships. As your product knowledge and commercial judgement develop, you’ll increasingly take on your own accounts, lead customer conversations and own how those opportunities move forward, with the team’s support.

About us

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

  • $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.
  • Founders who have done this before. Mikkel and Cip built HelloFlow together and sold it to Trulioo in 2022. They’re now building spektr alongside co-founders Jan-Erik and Jeremy, taking on a much bigger part of the customer lifecycle.
  • Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.
  • Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

What you’ll do

  • Research priority accounts, understand their business and work out who we should speak to, what matters to them and why spektr is relevant.
  • Help shape account plans and deal strategies, turning research into a compelling story for senior decision-makers.
  • Find creative ways to start conversations, from personal videos and custom comics to calls, introductions and events. Use what works and keep following up.
  • Create tailored demos, presentations, videos and other materials that show prospects what spektr could do for them.
  • Work on live opportunities, from preparing customer meetings to developing proposals and answering questions about the platform, increasingly taking ownership of your own accounts as you develop.
  • Work across the company to bring good ideas to life and help shape how we go to market as we grow.

How we work

You won’t be stuck in a call booth making cold calls all day. We reach out with whatever works, and we pride ourselves on being one of the most creative outreach teams around.

Nobody likes generic outreach. We send custom comics, make videos around a prospect’s business and bring people together at events. Sometimes a thoughtful email or a phone call is exactly what’s needed. You’ll have the freedom to work out what will resonate, try it and keep finding ways to start a conversation.

The whole company gets behind you. Growth, marketing, product, engineering and the founders all get involved. Bring a good idea and you’ll find people who want to help make it happen.

Who you are

  • Ambitious and early in your commercial career, with an appetite to learn quickly and take on more responsibility.
  • Personable, curious and good at winning people over. You listen well, build rapport and enjoy getting to know people.
  • Resourceful and persistent. You try different approaches, take initiative and follow through.
  • A clear communicator, whether you’re writing an email, building a presentation or explaining an idea in a room.
  • Comfortable getting into the details of a product and figuring out how it solves a real business problem.
  • Open to feedback, willing to get stuck in and excited by a role that will develop as you do.

You might come from consulting, banking, sales or a startup, or have built something of your own. We’re interested in what you’ve taken responsibility for, how you think and how quickly you learn. Prior compliance experience isn’t a requirement.

Why join

  • Learn how a company grows. Work closely with experienced founders and commercial colleagues on substantial accounts and real deals.
  • Sell a product you can believe in. Get hands-on with a platform already used by demanding financial businesses, solving problems that matter to them.
  • Have room to be creative. Help shape our approach, try ideas and get support from people across the company.
  • Build towards owning your own accounts. Take increasing responsibility for account strategy, customer relationships and moving deals forward. You’ll have support as you grow towards an AE role, with ownership earned through what you demonstrate.
  • Be recognised for your contribution. Commercial Associates have no individual quota. We look at the quality of your work, what you learn and how you help opportunities progress.

The process

  1. Initial conversation with our Head of Growth or Chief of Staff
  2. Case study
  3. Final conversation with our CEO

  • Travel within the assigned territory as required.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation

Location: Amsterdam ( preferred), or London
Reports to: Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead
Role type: Full-time

Role Overview

Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.

This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.

This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.

This is a senior leadership role combining:

  • Deep power systems expertise
  • Top-tier strategy problem solving
  • Origination and senior client leadership
  • Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes

You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.

Key Responsibilities

Power Systems & Grid Transformation

Origination & Growth

  • Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor high-performing teams.
  • Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.

We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.

  • Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy

Role: Strategy Consultant, Contractor, Associate to Manager
Location: London preferred, with flexibility depending on experience and project requirements via our other global offices.

Join Systemiq's contractor network

We are looking for experienced strategy and management consultants at Associate to Manager level to work with Systemiq teams on a flexible, project basis.

For contractors, Systemiq offers the chance to work on complex strategy and transformation challenges with teams that combine consulting, sector expertise and a strong focus on real-world impact. Assignments vary in topic and duration but typically involve working closely with Systemiq colleagues and clients on high-priority questions where strong problem solving, analysis and communication matter from day one.

We currently have several live contractor opportunities and expect further needs to arise over the coming months. We are therefore looking both for consultants who may be able to join projects in the near term and for strong candidates who could be relevant for future assignments.

Our priority is people with previous strategy consulting, management consulting or closely comparable advisory experience who can join a project team, get up to speed quickly and deliver high-quality work with limited ramp-up.

Previous sustainability experience is welcome but not essential. Strong consulting generalists are very much encouraged to apply, particularly those with relevant experience in one or more of our focus areas.

The role

As a contractor at Systemiq, you will join a project team for a defined period and contribute to strategy, analysis and delivery. Depending on the project, you may work with businesses, governments, financial institutions, foundations and civil society organisations on complex sustainability and systems change challenges.

Depending on your experience and the assignment, you may:

  • Structure complex problems: Develop clear approaches to ambiguous strategic questions and identify the analysis needed to answer them.
  • Conduct analysis and research: Undertake quantitative and qualitative analysis, research and synthesis to build a strong evidence base.
  • Develop clear insights: Turn complex information into concise conclusions, recommendations and client-ready outputs.
  • Own workstreams: Take responsibility for defined areas of work and deliver to agreed timelines.
  • Engage stakeholders: Support or lead client and stakeholder meetings, interviews and workshops.
  • Support project delivery: Work closely with Systemiq colleagues while operating independently and adapting quickly as project needs evolve.
  • Lead others: At more senior levels, manage workstreams, guide junior team members and build effective relationships with senior clients and stakeholders.

Who we are looking for

Our priority is candidates with experience in strategy consulting, management consulting or a closely comparable advisory environment, typically at Associate, Senior Associate or Manager level.

You are likely to bring:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience structuring ambiguous strategic questions.
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills.
  • The ability to turn complex information into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Experience producing concise, high-quality outputs for senior or client audiences.
  • Experience working in consulting-style project teams and delivering to tight timelines.
  • Confidence working with clients and senior stakeholders.
  • The ability to learn quickly and work effectively across unfamiliar topics.
  • A collaborative, pragmatic and adaptable working style.

For Manager-level opportunities, we will also look for experience leading substantial workstreams, managing team members and engaging confidently with senior clients.

Relevant sector or sustainability expertise is of course an advantage, but it does not replace the core consulting and advisory experience we need for most assignments. From time to time, we may also require specialist expertise for particular projects, but this contractor network is primarily focused on strategy and advisory roles.

Location, availability and contracting approach

London is our preferred location. We also welcome candidates who can work with our teams in Amsterdam or Nairobi. Remote arrangements may be considered for particularly strong matches, depending on the requirements of the project.

Contract length, start date and time commitment vary by assignment. Some requirements arise at relatively short notice, so we particularly welcome candidates who are already independent or expect to become available soon.

If your earliest availability is more than approximately eight weeks away, you are welcome to apply, but we may only review or contact you closer to the point at which you become available.

When applying, please tell us your earliest available start date, location, expected availability & day rate, and any relevant sector or subject matter expertise.

Current and future opportunities

We are recruiting for several immediate needs while also identifying strong consultants for projects that may arise over the coming months.

Because contractor needs can develop quickly, we may not contact every strong applicant straight away. We will get in touch when there is a potential match between your consulting experience, expertise, location, availability and a specific project need.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with strong teams and applying your consulting skills to sustainability and systems change challenges, we would be pleased to hear from you.

About Taskrabbit:

Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.

At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.

Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!
