job-boards.greenhouse.io/10alabs/jobs/40.description_excerpt:
About 10a Labs: 10a Labs is the safety and threat-intelligence layer trusted by frontier AI labs, AI unicorns, Fortune 10 companies, and leading global technology platforms. Our adversarial red teaming, model evaluations, and intelligence collection enable engineering, safety, and security teams to stay ahead of evolving threats and deploy AI systems safely.

Our client’s team is responsible for identifying and investigating misuses of their products – especially new types of abuse–and creating systems of defence to address them. Part of this team specialises in the latter, and they need additional support to help them monitor abuse on product launches and design and build scaled detection, review, enforcement, and measurement for uncovered risks. This position is a Full-Time (40 hours per week), contract position.

About The Role:

Protection Science Engineering is an interdisciplinary role mixing data science, machine learning, investigation, and policy/protocol development. As a Protection Scientist Engineer within the client team, you will assist in designing and building systems to proactively identify and enforce on abuse on their AI products. This includes ensuring they have robust abuse monitoring in place for new products, sustaining monitoring for existing products, and prototyping and incubating systems of defense against the highest risk harms.  You will also respond to and investigate critical escalations, especially those that are not caught by existing safety systems. This will require developing understanding of the products and data, and working cross-functionally with product, policy, and engineering teams. 

You will need a strong ability to use SQL and python to query, transform, and understand data, and to build and improve prototype detection. An investigative mindset is key, with experience in identifying and enforcing on bad actors (in any industry). A background including data science, machine learning and classification basics, AI, and/or threat investigation is a plus.

This is a remote position, based in London, UK.  The position includes participation in an on-call rotation that will involve resolving urgent escalations outside of normal work hours, for at least 7 consecutive days per quarter. Some detection and investigations may involve exposure to sensitive and distressing content, including sexual, violent, or otherwise-disturbing material. 

In This Role, You Will:

  • Scope and implement abuse monitoring requirements for new product launches.
  • Improve processes to sustain monitoring operations for existing products, including developing approaches to automate monitoring subtasks. 
  • Prototype and mature into production systems of detection, review, and enforcement of abuse for major harms.
  • Work with Product, Policy, Ops, and Investigative teams to understand key risks and how to identify and address them, and with Engineering teams to ensure we have sufficient data and scaled tooling. 

Requirements:

  • Ability to work remotely on GMT and must be geographically located in the UK.
  • Quantitative and coding background , including statistics/metrics and proficiency in python and SQL.
  • Experience in identifying (and ideally enforcing on) bad actors with scaled tooling.
  • Ability to be on-call approximately once a quarter that will involve resolving urgent escalations outside of normal work hours, including occasional evenings and weekends
  • Ability to rapidly context switch across domains, modalities, and abuse areas, to include high severity areas like violent activities and child safety
  • Excited to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, and purposeful space with high impact across users and beyond, and to learn quickly. 

Desired Qualities (but not required):

  • Background in machine learning and classification, especially on novel or poorly understood behaviours.
  • Experience scaling and automating processes, especially with language models.
  • Experience working with scaled labellers or reviewers, particularly at scale.
  • Familiarity with one of the following topics/areas: AI safety, child safety, abuse by nation state and other malicious actors, digital mental health, fraud abuse, radicalization/persuasion/grooming; hateful activities and groups.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/apothecom/jobs/.description_excerpt:
About ApotheCom

ApotheCom is an exciting leader in the field of medical communications. Drawn together from several backgrounds including the pharmaceutical industry, research, marketing, medical and regulatory writing, sales, publishing, digital media and design, we have the experience and all-round ability to conceive and deliver the best quality medical communications programs.

About the role

The Associate Medical Director is a scientific and strategic lead responsible for the quality, accuracy and strategic direction of assigned medical communications workstreams and accounts.

 

In this role, you will be accountable for ensuring that scientific content is clinically accurate, strategically aligned, insight-driven and relevant to client medical strategy and agency objectives. You will partner closely with client services, editorial, creative, digital, medical writing and senior scientific leadership to ensure that deliverables meet client expectations, reflect current scientific evidence and support broader communication goals.

 

The Associate Medical Director serves as a key scientific contact for clients, faculty and external experts, bringing subject matter expertise, sound judgment and a proactive consultative approach to assigned projects. You will lead and contribute to content development plans, elevate the scientific and strategic quality of deliverables, support new business activity and help guide junior scientific team members.

 

To be considered for this role, candidates should have successfully demonstrated Senior Medical Writer-level capabilities and typically bring at least 5 years of experience in medical communications, publications, medical education or a related scientific communications environment.

 

The Associate Medical Director will report to a Medical Director, Senior Medical Director or senior Scientific Services leader.

 

Key responsibilities

Strategic thinking and scientific insight

  • Accountable for the scientific strategy and quality of assigned accounts, workstreams and deliverables, ensuring alignment with client medical strategy and agency objectives.
  • Leads and contributes to content development plans, ensuring deliverables are grounded in evidence and aligned with strategic imperatives.
  • Interprets and synthesizes complex clinical data, including clinical trial results, congress updates, treatment guidelines, publications and competitive information.
  • Translates complex scientific and clinical information into clear, compelling and strategically relevant medical communications.
  • Provides proactive scientific input into publication plans, medical education programs, communication platforms and other client deliverables.
  • Identifies key scientific insights, evidence gaps and communication opportunities that can strengthen client strategy.
  • Participates in new business pitches, proposals and client onboarding by providing scientific insight and therapeutic area expertise.

Client partnership and excellence in delivery

  • Serves as a key scientific contact for clients, faculty, authors, investigators and external experts, building relationships based on scientific credibility, responsiveness and delivery excellence.
  • Partners with pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients to understand goals, communication objectives, scientific priorities and success measures.
  • Reviews and elevates scientific content to ensure not only accuracy, but also strategic alignment with client objectives.
  • Ensures assigned medical communications are clinically relevant, current and reflective of recent advances in the therapeutic area.
  • Liaises with clients and external experts to support streamlined, efficient development of high-quality deliverables.
  • Supports the planning and execution of advisory boards, investigator meetings, faculty meetings, congress activities and scientific workshops.
  • Anticipates client needs, flags risks early and recommends solutions to protect scientific quality, timelines and budget expectations.

Teamwork, collaboration and leadership

  • Partners with Client Services and cross-functional colleagues across creative, digital, editorial, account and specialized services to ensure deliverables meet client expectations.
  • Provides day-to-day scientific direction to medical writers, freelancers and junior scientific team members.
  • Offers formal and informal mentorship, coaching and performance feedback to junior team members, supporting their scientific growth and delivery quality.
  • Demonstrates increasing autonomy in account decision-making while knowing when to escalate scientific, client, budget or delivery risks.
  • Proactively drives team growth and efficiency, including suggestions for process improvement within the team, cluster or squad.
  • Contributes to key strategic priorities, including recruitment, resourcing, business development and operational excellence.
  • Collaborates with project and account teams to ensure timelines are realistic, scope is understood and scientific requirements are appropriately planned.

Content development and quality oversight

  • Leads or oversees development of scientific content across manuscripts, abstracts, posters, slide decks, advisory board materials, white papers, monographs, congress materials and medical education content.
  • Reviews and refines medical writing to ensure scientific accuracy, strategic relevance, logical flow, appropriate tone and audience fit.
  • Conducts targeted literature reviews and evidence assessments to ensure content reflects current clinical practice and therapeutic developments.
  • Maintains awareness of good publication practices and appropriate standards for publications, medical education and professional communications.
  • Provides quality control for scientific content developed by internal writers, freelancers and external partners.
  • Ensures reference support, data interpretation, claims and scientific messaging are accurate, balanced and appropriately substantiated.

Financial and operational awareness

  • Understands the financial side of assigned accounts and works with team members to help projects remain in scope.
  • Provides senior scientific input into scopes of work, budgets, timelines and resource planning.
  • Identifies potential changes in project focus, scientific complexity or scope and escalates appropriately.
  • Supports efficient delivery by balancing scientific excellence with timeline, budget and client-service…

Senior Medical Writer

(Publications or Medical Affairs)

London ,Manchester, Macclesfield, Glasgow, Hybrid or UK remote

 

The power of three of the world's leading medical communications companies – Nucleus Global, ApotheCom and Ashfield MedComms – and the specialised services and skills within MEDiSTRAVA combine to form iNIZIO Medical. With over 2,000 employees globally, iNIZIO Medical creates compelling content and engage communities across the spectrum of healthcare. This role would suit an experienced Senior Medical Writer. It will provide a great career development opportunity for you with the support of a very experienced team.

Reporting to a Scientific Director, you will develop scientific expertise in assigned therapeutic areas, supporting delivery for a versatile team. Core deliverable tasks include researching and developing technical materials, ensuring that a candidate or employee makes all outputs follow written brief, makes them accurate in content and editorial style, and references them. You will also communicate with clients and KOL on content development and attend scientific meetings.

To succeed you will have:

· Several years experience working within a medical communications agency environment.

· An academic background in the life sciences (Bachelor of Science, Master of Science, Doctor of Philosophy)

 

We offer a great compensation package including pension, life insurance, private healthcare and paid time off. In addition to our benefits package, we are happy to talk flexible working with hybrid and remote working options available. We offer excellent opportunities for career and personal development, including opportunities to transfer your skills to our other agencies globally.

Our Pledge

We are committed to promoting a culture of diversity, inclusion and belonging where everyone can bring each facet of themselves to work each day. We believe that strength in diversity and inclusivity is a driver of our success. We strive to accelerate the adoption and adherence of new medicines across the globe. We're determined to advance scientific understanding and pursue health equity for all. Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

This specialized unit focuses on research projects that specifically survey B2B target groups, professional decision-makers, and niche business audiences (rather than only standard B2C consumer panels). You will work closely with leading global strategy and management consultancies as well as major international corporates, supporting high-stakes projects where research needs to be delivered quickly, precisely, and with a clear focus on the business question.

  • You bring a pragmatic, proactive, and resilient mindset with a passion for data quality and innovation.

You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. Embedding directly with enterprise teams, you’ll uncover how their operations actually run, identify where AI can create meaningful value, and build the systems that deliver it.

Location: London Office/Hybrid

Overview 

Sales Account Executives at Asset Reality own the full sales cycle with public sector agencies, from first conversation to closed contract. You'll run complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes across agencies where decisions move slowly and budget authority is rarely obvious, requiring the kind of discipline and commercial instinct to keep deals moving to closure.   

The goal is to understand each agency's real problem deeply, navigate to the people who control the budget, and deliver solutions that speak directly to what you've learned. As part of a small, early-stage UK/EU team, report to and work closely with the VP of Sales in the London office. You will build your pipeline and have real influence over how the go-to-market strategy develops. If you thrive on purpose-driven selling, this is a rare opportunity to do meaningful work at scale. 

 

What this role is 

You’ll be working in a small UK/EU focused team with a mission to convert an expansive public sector market opportunity. Your job is to build relationships of trust to get to the heart of the challenges that government agencies face when it comes to seizing and managing assets, from boats to bitcoin. You will be passionate about understanding their problem, identifying a champion and getting the attention of the economic buyer. You are comfortable owning the whole sales lifecycle, from identifying opportunities, to leading product demos, and closing deals.  

This is a role for someone who can run a complex, multi-stakeholder sales process with discipline and patience. Government agencies don’t move fast, and decisions rarely sit with one person. You’ll need to navigate that while keeping commercial momentum. 

  

What you’ll be doing 

  • Learning everything about Asset Reality, our solutions, our clients and the problems we can help them solve and how we do it better than any other combination of solutions  
  • Generating your own pipeline, where needed, through direct outreach and event follow-up and nurturing qualified leads referred to you from the team  
  • Running deep discovery to go beyond the initial qualification: understanding how the agency currently works, the real problem, their current risks and full scope of impact  
  • Identifying and navigating to the economic buyer, using your champion and contacts as a route in

Location: London Office/Hybrid (1–2 days on site)
Schedule: Full-Time

 

The Role 

Most security roles protect data. This one protects evidence. Asset Reality builds mission-critical infrastructure for clients in law enforcement and government, operating in environments where records are examined adversarially and the stakes are high. 

You will join a small engineering team as a working engineer with deep security expertise. This is not an advisory role and it is not a governance role. You will ship production code alongside the rest of the team — Go services, Postgres, React, all on AWS — and you will be the person who makes sure that what we ship stands up to adversarial scrutiny. 

Security here is not a separate function reviewing the team's work from the outside. It is a discipline embedded in how the team designs, builds, and operates the product. You will set the standard for that.

 

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to day-to-day product development as a senior engineer: designing, writing, reviewing, and shipping production code in Go and React.
  • Own the security dimension of engineering work: lead threat modelling on new features and architectural changes, drive secure design decisions, and review high-risk changes.
  • Own and improve the security of our AWS estate: IAM design, network segmentation, secrets management, and data isolation in a multi-tenant system.
  • Build security into the development lifecycle: dependency and vulnerability management, CI/CD security controls, static and dynamic analysis, and the tooling that makes the secure path the easy path.
  • Design and build product security features where the domain demands them: audit integrity, tamper evidence, access controls, and data isolation.
  • Lead the technical side of incident response: detection, investigation, and remediation, and the exercises that keep us ready.
  • Support client-facing security work with technical depth: contribute to security questionnaires, due diligence responses, and client assessments where engineering answers are needed.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/brave/jobs/8165.description_excerpt:
AI Security Researcher / Research Engineer

Remote or hybrid - London preferred but North America, EU, UK accepted

About Brave:

Brave is on a mission to protect the human right to privacy online. We’ve built a free web browser that blocks creepy ads and trackers by default, a private search engine with a truly independent index, private AI assistant, latest privacy and security features, and a private ad network (opt-in!) that directly rewards you for your attention. Already over 120 million people regularly use Brave for a faster, more private web. Millions more switch every month.

The internet is a sea of ads, hackers, and echo chambers. Big Tech makes huge profits off our data, and tells us what’s true and what’s not. Brave is fighting back. Join us!

Summary

We are looking for a researcher/research engineer to help mitigate the security risks that come with building AI systems-especially LLM-powered web agents and chatbots. In this role, you'll design and implement secure-by-design architectures, audit our LLM-powered web agent (https://brave.com/blog/ai-browsing/) and chatbot, and help set Brave's direction on how we identify, measure, and reduce security risk across AI products.

Responsibilities 

  • Design and execute adversarial evaluations to uncover failure modes in LLM-powered web agents and chatbots (e.g., prompt injection, tool abuse, data exfiltration)
  • Analyze model behavior (including internal thoughts) to understand and forecast security risks in frontier models
  • Develop and prototype security-focused training and fine-tuning techniques 
  • Augment web agents with security principles including information flow control, privilege control and contextual security
  • Partner with engineers and (privacy, ML, and Cryptographic) researchers to translate findings into product changes, tests, and measurable security improvements
  • Help define a forward-looking security strategy and policy for building and responsibly releasing web agents—advocating for user protection

You may be a good fit if you have

  • Demonstrated experience working on Secure AI (prompt injection attacks and security guardrails)
  • Strong publication record in AI security, ML security, or closely related areas
  • A track record of shipping products and features inside a fast-moving environment
  • Strong coding skills in Python and familiarity with ML frameworks like PyTorch or JAX
  • Experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating large language models
  • Deep familiarity with large language models and web agents, how they work, and how they are trained
  • Experience applying security principles (e.g., information flow control, access control/least privilege)
  • Demonstrated success in bringing clarity and ownership to ambiguous technical problems
  • A Ph.D. in computer science is highly preferred, but we may consider some exceptions with industry experience

Skills That Will Set You Apart from the Competition

  • Knowledge of AI Systems (pipelines, security evaluation, etc.)
  • Open source projects on security/privacy
  • Experience with confidential computing and ZKP/SMPC protocols
  • Ph.D. in computer science from a top-tier school
  • A strong publication record in premier systems, performance, or ML 
  • Work experience in industry is desirable

Working at Brave - What we offer

  • Ability to work at an exciting and well-funded international startup headquartered in San Francisco
  • Cutting-edge technology, allowing you to work with state-of-the-art tools and software solutions
  • Competitive compensation and plenty of room for personal growth
  • Great international exposure and team atmosphere

We are looking to hire in London but would consider an exceptional candidate in the rest of Europe. 

NO AGENCIES or RECRUITERS PLEASE - Unfortunately, we cannot work with third parties on these searches.

We strive to be the most innovative firm in the industry today, tomorrow, and long into the future while upholding ethical excellence. We believe that CTC makes a positive impact on the markets, the lives of our employees, and all the communities to which we belong. Started in 1995 by a team of forward-thinking Traders, we are proud to call ourselves an industry leader that keeps making markets and each other better.

Are you excited by the opportunity to be part of a dynamic trading environment that values teamwork and collaboration? Do you thrive in an innovative atmosphere? If so, we encourage you to consider Chicago Trading Company! 

The Role 

The Quant Trading Associate (QTA) role is our entry-level position within our Trading and Quant organization and gives you broad exposure to the whole business as you work towards graduating from the Associate Program and assuming a role as a Quant Trader or Quant Researcher.

As a QTA, you will work in a high-impact role as a member of a trading or quantitative team. You will play a vital part in identifying trading opportunities and impacting your team through dynamic problem solving — including trade execution, strategy formulation, back-testing, data analysis, and the modeling and pricing of traded financial derivatives — while communicating with traders, risk managers, software engineers, and quants throughout the trading day. You will learn all aspects of the trading and quant operation and work towards a role that generates trading revenue or drives strategy development for the team. In addition to the trading and quantitative side of the business, you will have exposure to technology through our combined trading and technology curriculum.

We encourage competitiveness and collaboration in equal measure and strive to better each other to win as one team.

What to Expect 

Due to the dynamic nature of this business, we cultivate an environment of continuous learning and growth through an in-house education department. Through formal classroom work, mock trading, and real-time practical exposure, you will gain a holistic introduction to the derivatives market while sharpening your quantitative skillset. You can expect:

  • An introduction to options pricing, theory, trading philosophies, and programming courses
  • Exposure to different product areas and responsibilities
  • One-on-one mentorship from senior members in the firm
  • Opportunities to grow quickly and start making autonomous trading decisions
  • Participation in data-driven research for the purpose of alpha generation

What it takes for you to be successful: 

  • You have a competitive drive and are a highly motivated individual that only gets stronger as part of a collaborative team
  • An aspiration to collaborate with traders, quants, developers, and other experts to further CTC's goal of providing world class liquidity to financial markets
  • You love solving complex problems
  • You're intellectually curious and like to challenge the status quo
  • You can effectively communicate sophisticated ideas both written and verbally
  • Strong quantitative and analytical abilities
  • Basic programming skills or a willingness to learn Python
  • No prior experience in finance is necessary, but a deep curiosity and a hunger to learn is essential

Key requirements: 

  • Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree. All majors and concentrations welcome. 
  • You will graduate between December 2026-June 2027 
  • You have a demonstrated record of success (academics, awards, etc.) 
  • You are willing to relocate to London  

Why should you consider a career at CTC? 

  • Be part of a fast-growing, industry-leading global trading company
  • Work in an environment that actively explores and applies emerging technologies — including AI — to enhance trading, engineering, and research workflows
  • Opportunity to work with and learn from forward-thinking leaders in our industry
  • Experience innovation, teamwork, and fun while working in an intellectually stimulating environment

As our first AI Engineer in the UK, you’ll lead engagements to help our customers build and productionize tailored AI applications in the Databricks platform, using the latest technologies to deliver business impact for our top clients. AI & Platform Consultancy

  • Enablement: Lead technical workshops to empower client teams, ensuring they have the expertise to manage and scale the AI platforms you help them deploy.

What does it take to fit the bill?

Technical Expertise

  • You have 5+ years of experience in AI or Machine Learning Engineering with a focus on cloud platforms (preferably Azure or AWS, but GCP is also ok);

Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.
JOB OVERVIEW
We are currently seeking a skilled Diesel Mechanic to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and troubleshooting diesel engines and related systems on our autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
RESPONSIBILITIES
- Perform routine maintenance tasks on diesel engines, including oil changes, filter replacements, and fluid checks, to ensure proper functioning and longevity.
- Diagnose and repair diesel engine malfunctions, mechanical issues, and electrical faults using diagnostic tools, technical manuals, and troubleshooting techniques.
- Inspect and test diesel engine components, systems, and subsystems to identify and address potential problems or areas of concern.
- Overhaul and rebuild diesel engines and associated systems, including fuel injection systems, turbochargers, and exhaust systems, as needed to restore performance and efficiency.
- Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including parts used, labour hours, and service performed, to track equipment history and ensure compliance with maintenance schedules and regulatory requirements.
- Follow safety protocols and procedures for working with diesel engines and related equipment, including proper handling and disposal of hazardous materials and fluids.
- Collaborate with other maintenance technicians, engineers, and operators to troubleshoot complex problems, share technical knowledge, and implement effective solutions.
QUALIFICATIONS
- Marine Diesel and/or Volvo VODIA experience required
- GCSEs (or equivalent) are required. A recognised vocational qualification or apprenticeship in diesel mechanics, marine engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
- Proven experience as a diesel technician or a diesel mechanic, with demonstrated proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining diesel engines and related systems.
- Strong mechanical aptitude and technical skills, with the ability to read and interpret technical manuals, diagrams, and schematics.
- Familiarity with diagnostic tools and equipment used in diesel engine repair, such as scan tools, multimeters, and oscilloscopes.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical and electrical issues.
- Effective communication skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.
- Willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with changing priorities and deadlines.
- Ability to travel as needed to meet business objectives, including throughout the Indo-Pacific region and to our headquarters in Austin, Texas. This role will require spending 30+ days training at Saronic headquarters in Austin, Texas.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
- Ability to perform physically demanding work for extended periods.
- Frequently and repetitively lift, push, and carry up to 23 kg's.
- Ability to work outdoors for extended periods in marine and waterside environments.
- Frequently and repetitively bend, lift, and reach to install and remove components of varying size and weight.
- Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, including over varied and uneven terrain such as docks, vessel decks, and gravel surfaces.
- Stoop, lay, bend, reach, squat, kneel, crouch, twist, and crawl for extended periods while working in confined or low-clearance spaces.
- Climb and maintain balance on ladders, platforms, vessels, and other elevated structures.
- Exposure to loud noise, vibration, engine exhaust, and hazardous materials with required adherence to safety and disposal procedures.
- Wear Personal Protective Equipment at all times in work areas, including safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, and other PPE as required.
BENEFITS
- Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success
- Competitive Salary: Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses
- Medical Insurance: Comprehensive private health insurance
- Time Off: Generous annual leave entitlement, plus public holidays.
- Parental Leave: Paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents

As defined by U.S. law, individuals who are any one of the following are considered to be a “U.S. Person”: (1) U.S. citizens, (2) legal permanent residents (a.k.a. green card holders), and (3) certain protected classes of asylees and refugees, as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/8/1324b.

  • Develop the brand system - Work with the Creative Director to extend and refine our visual language. Build and update guidelines, templates and toolkits that make great design easier to produce.
  • Own projects from idea to delivery - Take a brief, explore different approaches and develop a clear recommendation. Present your thinking, respond thoughtfully to feedback and follow the work through to its final execution.
  • Build the brand wherever it lives - Design for brand campaigns, events, internal branding, social and web. Push the brand into new directions at every opportunity. 
  • Bring your point of view - Look beyond category conventions. Bring references that mean something to you, explain what makes them relevant and develop work that reflects your passions. 
  • Raise the standard through making - Contribute work that gives the team a stronger reference point. Share ideas, give useful feedback and collaborate generously. Influence the team through your craft and how you work.
What you'll bring:
  • Craft - Strong typography, layout, composition, colour and visual hierarchy. An eye for detail that carries through to production.

Technical skills

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience using AI to optimise, research, scale or otherwise improve your workflow.

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

We're hiring Enterprise Account Executives to own the full sales cycle—from discovery to close—driving new business with enterprise customers who care deeply about developer productivity and application security.

You won't inherit a full pipeline—you'll build it. The AEs who thrive here create demand and run a repeatable enterprise motion with intent.

  • Map the buying committee, build internal champions, and earn trusted-advisor status—you sell insight, not a feature checklist.

Forecast Discipline & Ownership

  • Manage pipeline rigorously, forecast with precision, and consistently exceed targets.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment—taking ownership over titles to win for the customer and the team.

What You Bring to the Table

You’re a strategic, technical seller who loves simplifying complexity and guiding customers through transformation. You know how to navigate ambiguity, collaborate deeply, and earn trust through insight and credibility.

  • 5+ years of full-cycle enterprise sales experience in cybersecurity, DevOps, or developer tools.
  • A strong track record of closing multi-threaded, six-figure deals with enterprise accounts 
  • Experience in a structured, playbook-driven motion—Command of the Message, Force Management, MEDDPICC (or MEDDIC), or a comparable value-selling methodology.
  • Demonstrated over-attainment: President's Club, top-decile ranking, or a consistent record of beating quota.
  • You've done your best work at high-growth companies where you had to create demand, not fulfill inbound—and you know the difference.
  • Comfort selling to technical buyers—CISOs, Heads of Security, Engineering and Developer Productivity leaders.
  • High curiosity and initiative—you don't follow scripts, you lead the conversation.

The Bar We Hire To

We hold a bar above the market, and we're transparent about what it is. The best reps at Endor aren't defined by pedigree—they're defined by how they operate. We hire people who:

  • Lead with character. Commitment, humility, and grit. You've overcome something hard, you want to be the best, and you carry a strong moral compass into every room.
  • Are coachable by default. You seek feedback, act on it fast, and treat every deal as a chance to get better.
  • Think sharply and translate complexity. You build a credible business case and make hard concepts simple.
  • Have proven it where it's hard. You've carried a number at a high-growth, not-yet-household-name company and consistently beaten it.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/atoms/jobs/8903.description_excerpt:
Who we are 

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

 

What you’ll do

Project Delivery & Site Execution

  • Oversee the end-to-end construction of new developments—with a focus on roadside QSR drive-thrus and EVC hubs—as well as modernisations across the existing real estate portfolio.
  • Develop, manage, and track project schedules and critical path milestones to ensure timely delivery across multiple concurrent schemes.
  • Conduct regular site visits, job walks, and pre-construction due diligence activities to verify site conditions and progress.
  • Troubleshoot constructability, sequencing, and inspection issues on-site to resolve blockers quickly and prevent project delays.

Utility & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships and day-to-day coordination with external consultants, principal contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Lead the on-site sequencing and scheduling of utility companies to secure timely power, water, and telecom connections—critical for EVC and drive-thru operations.

Commercial & Financial Control

  • Assist with budget planning, cost monitoring, and financial control across assigned projects.
  • Review, verify, and process contractor valuations and payment applications to ensure compliance with contractual terms.

Quality, Compliance & Safety

  • Enforce rigorous Health & Safety standards across all active sites in line with UK statutory regulations and internal policies.
  • Conduct quality assurance checks to ensure all works conform to corporate specifications, design standards, and operational requirements.

Reporting & Administration

  • Provide regular project status, budget, and risk reporting to senior leadership.
  • Coordinate project administration, including site meetings, contract documentation, and handover processes.

 

What we’re looking for

Experience & Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in construction management, ideally within retail, hospitality, roadside QSR, or F&B developments.
  • Professional accreditation: RICS, CIOB, or MAPM membership (or actively working towards chartered status) is highly desirable.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or a related field preferred.
  • Full UK driving licence due to site travel.

Technical & Commercial Skills

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong negotiation skills and sound commercial judgment when managing contracts, suppliers, and budgets.
  • Multi-Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, navigate competing priorities, and deliver to strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving: A pragmatic approach to identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving complex constructability and operational challenges.

Soft Skills & Working Style

  • Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from site teams to executive leadership.
  • Autonomy & Collaboration: A collaborative team player who can take ownership, show initiative, and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Adaptability: Highly organized, resilient, and comfortable adapting to changing priorities across a dynamic operational footprint.

 

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

 

What else you need to know

This role is based in our London office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

 

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others? 

#LI-Onsite

Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 12 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. Our brand is built on trusted emotional connection, empathy, and consistency in how we show up for people every day. We are woven into everyday moments of people’s lives, becoming part of their routines, their self-expression, and their confidence. We are defined not just by what we make, but by how we make people feel and the relationships we build over time. Our north-star values are to be Human, Curious, Playful, and Helpful. We are driven by a shared mission to become the Most Loved Lifestyle Brand in the World.

THE ROLE.

As the Brand Experience Lead, you will be part cultural programmer, part community builder, and part producer. This person will define what Glossier means in London—making our flagship a place where culture happens, not just where it is reflected. This role is responsible for ideating and delivering in-store activations, events, and experiences that deepen community, drive cultural relevance, and give people a reason to show up, not just shop. You will serve as the connective force between brand, retail, and culture, building authentic relationships on the ground and translating what's happening in the world into moments that bring Glossier to life in London.

You will partner closely with Retail, Brand, Creative, PR, Merchandising, Store Operations, and Digital teams to ensure a cohesive approach to experiential strategy, and build an always-on programming strategy that transforms the London flagship into a cultural hub, identifying recurring tentpoles, local partnerships, and community moments that give Glossier a meaningful role in the city beyond product launch.

This role reports to the Director, Brand and Integrated Marketing and is an individual contributor role.

  • Evolve the experiential vision for Glossier's London flagship, reimagining how physical retail builds community, drives cultural relevance, and creates impactful moments
  • Lead the end-to-end strategy and execution of in-store events, activations, and experiential programming, from concept through launch and post-event recap
  • Identify and secure culturally relevant partners, collaborators, and community voices aligned with Glossier's positioning across beauty, culture, and community
  • Own the experiential and events calendar for the flagship, identifying opportunities tied to brand priorities, store moments, product launches, and cultural trends
  • Conceptualize and execute activations that bring the brand to life in-store, ensuring thoughtful guest experience, strong brand storytelling, and alignment across all touchpoints
  • Cultivate and nurture community on the ground, building authentic relationships with local creators, organizations, and cultural communities across London
  • Drive seamless cross-functional execution by managing workflows across creative, retail, Comms, talent, legal, and digital; keeping timelines, deliverables, and approvals on track
  • Lead go-to-market strategy for each experience, ensuring cohesive amplification across owned, earned, and paid channels
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partners, vendors, collaborators, and agencies, managing relationships and execution from kickoff through event day
  • Oversee budgets, contracts, and on-site logistics, ensuring efficient use of resources and high-quality execution
  • Develop recaps and reporting, tracking performance and distilling insights to inform future experiential strategy

We are a people-powered beauty ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 11 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/internationa.description_excerpt:
About ICE Services

ICE Services is a music technology company built by rightsholders, for rightsholders. We simplify the complexities of the music royalty chain through an innovative suite of licensing, processing, and copyright services, enabling our customers to accurately and efficiently compensate songwriters and composers for the use of their works. 

A joint venture between PRS, STIM, and GEMA, ICE Services is the result of a big vision for the industry that harnesses years of combined experience in the multi-territory music market. Serving over 330,000 rightsholders and leveraging a copyright database comprising 55 million musical works, ICE Services’ operations touch 250+ territories to distribute more than €1bn in royalties per year, with a total of over €5bn distributed to date.  

We’re based in the UK, Germany, and Sweden.  

 

About the Role

As we build out the IT Security function, we have determined the need for a resource with a specific remit of securing the cloud infrastructure used, both across the production and corporate space. This will encompass both the application hosting environment and the backend support services.

The role will involve aiding in building out the Cloud Security pillar, developing all the processes along with any technology required to make the role a key part of the security strategy.

Applicants have to be resident and have the right to work in the UK.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Engaging with key stakeholders to understand the current state of cloud security, develop the strategy of integration with all teams ensuring security is considered with all projects.
  • Perform gap analysis and identify risks across all cloud environments, drive improvements, document remediation steps, and aid in the reduction of risk
  • Design and build secure cloud environments. Working alongside the engineering function this role will assist the team in building an environment that meets the needs to host the applications in a secure manner.
  • Assess technologies for use across all systems, identify new tools to evaluate for use, build requirement documentation, criteria for success and preform the proof of concept assessment.
  • Configuring the corporate cloud functions and the security of AzureAD using policies and tools, this will include all corporate functions such as email, application connections, and stand alone servers.
  • Performing audit and benchmarking across the cloud environments to ensure optimal level of security controls are implemented (such as vulnerability management) and to help drive future initiatives.
  • Prepare and enforce standards and guidelines for cloud security, including standard builds, configurations, and automation processes, in particular the use of Terraform.
  • Drive particular focus on access controls across the environments and data within the cloud infrastructure.
  • Monitor solutions for critical security events and build investigation and incident response plans, including aiding the configuration and use of logging and SIEM tools.
  • Offer consultancy as an SME to all business units in relation to technical projects.

 

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • Experience in design, documentation, and configuration of secure solutions for AWS and Azure cloud environments.
  • Experience in designing configuring tools and technology to work within or alongside cloud environments.]
  • Experience in designing and configuring third party security technologies within a cloud environment (ie, firewalls, IDS/IPS).
  • Experience in design, documentation and configuration of Identity and Access Management solutions.
  • Experience in securing cloud container environments.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security standards including NIST, CIS, and ISO.
  • Performed risk analysis and documented all risks and mitigating controls within cloud environments.
  • Understanding of threat models and their application to aid in securing cloud environments.
  • Act as a role model, engage with the promotion of a culture of good conduct and contribution to maintaining such a culture.
  • Proactivity, transparency and clear accountability for the determination and management of security and risks.
  • Fast learner and critical thinker with excellent skills in problem solving and presentation.
  • Teamwork with peers and management.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and oral. 

 

What we offer:

  • Competitive local benefits based on your location
  • We promote flexible working regarding time and/or place
  • Both mental and physical health initiatives
  • Corporate pension scheme 
  • Comprehensive training and development opportunities 
  • Industry insider events, team socials and company events
  • Enhanced holiday allowance 

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. 
We are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.

About ICE Services

ICE Services is a music technology company built by rightsholders, for rightsholders. We simplify the complexities of the music royalty chain through an innovative suite of licensing, processing, and copyright services, enabling our customers to accurately and efficiently compensate songwriters and composers for the use of their works. 

A joint venture between PRS, STIM, and GEMA, ICE Services is the result of a big vision for the industry that harnesses years of combined experience in the multi-territory music market. Serving over 330,000 rightsholders and leveraging a copyright database comprising 55 million musical works, ICE Services’ operations touch 250+ territories to distribute more than €1bn in royalties per year, with a total of over €5bn distributed to date.  

We’re based in the UK, Germany, and Sweden.  

 

About the Role

For us ServiceNow is a product platform, not just a ticketing tool. On top of ITSM we run our own custom apps and workflows for internal operations, plus customer support workflows for music rights organisations across Europe. Integrations connect ServiceNow to AWS, GitHub Actions, Datadog and other systems. Most of it is business critical.

You'll be the technical lead of this team, and the owner of the platform. That means you’ll need to grow deep understanding how the existing workflows, integrations and custom artifacts work, keeping them up to date, and deciding how new changes can be embedded to reach production.

There are some green field areas, most of your time will go on configuration, troubleshooting, making technical decisions and keeping the platform and the custom apps healthy, so that internal and external stakeholders get work they can rely on. This means you'll need to be hands on.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the platform in every respect: architecture, data model, upgrades, platform health, access, licensing and security (service accounts, roles, ACLs)
  • Own the release process end to end, including testing, logging and rollback
  • Own SLAs, assignment rules, routing and business critical automations, and keep them simple, recoverable and as close to out of the box as possible
  • Build scoped apps, flows, portals and integrations, and be able to build outside ServiceNow when that's the better option
  • Guide a small team through code reviews, pairing and technical direction, and make documentation and runbooks a normal part of the job
  • Turn customer meetings into business requests and then into practical solutions, own the roadmap, and manage vendor and partner relationships
  • Work with internal and external stakeholders, and act as Product Owner when needed

 

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • Experience as a tech lead or senior engineer who has truly owned a system
  • Hands on ServiceNow development experience, that goes beyond admin work: developed apps, scripting, ACLs, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, REST APIs
  • Solid knowledge of instance management, upgrades, cloning, safe deployments, SLAs, ITSM processes and licensing
  • Web development skills (JavaScript or TypeScript, REST, OAuth, webhooks), plus Git, CI/CD, AWS, SQL and data modelling
  • Comfort picking up an existing setup, asking "why", and explaining technical topics in plain language to anyone, senior leadership included
  • A habit of writing things down
  • Fluent English

Good to know

  • This role probably isn't for you if you only want to work inside ServiceNow, don't want to deal with a heavily customised instance, would rather not be hands on anymore, or are looking to manage a large team.

We are seeking a motivated Solutions Architect Post-Sales to join our customer success team, specializing in the AI security space. About Jump and Jump Crypto

Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incenting collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems.

Jump Crypto, the crypto division of Jump Trading Group, is committed to building and standing up critical infrastructure needed to catalyze the growth of the crypto ecosystem. We're builders, partners, and traders who take a long-term view of crypto's prospects and operate to unlock the full potential of open, community-driven networks. Since our inception as a skunkworks intern project in late 2015, we've grown into a dynamic and seasoned team of high performing players across a range of functions. Today, we play an important role in the development of some of the largest and most innovative crypto communities.

As a Campus [Intern / Full-time] Researcher at Jump Crypto, you will have the opportunity to partner with senior Leaders of Jump Crypto and other senior researchers to help shape the direction of our strategic efforts. The Researcher role is dynamic. Depending on your strengths and interests, you may be looking for macro-level trends that will inform the group’s future efforts, heads down on a nuanced issue advising our engineers or partners, producing valuable research reports, or advising our business development team on partnerships. You’ll use your deep knowledge of the crypto industry, computer science, distributed systems, consensus algorithms, networking, game theory and other disciplines relevant to blockchain technology to help identify, vet, and propose new business initiatives. The ideal candidate will know their strengths and contribute deeply to areas where they believe they can add the most value.

What You’ll Do:

  • Monitor the broader crypto landscape and identify new opportunities for Jump Crypto.
  • Translate industry trends into actionable architecture, product, or investment strategy.
  • Aggregate information from technical repositories, research reports, white papers, industry relationships, Jump Crypto’s own data, as well as anecdotal feedback from our team or partners to produce valuable content, recommendations, or general advice to guide our group’s strategy.
  • Look to empower the broader Jump Crypto team through great research that facilitates better deals, more robust product insights for our engineers, and more strategic partnerships for our investment team.
  • Make material contributions to Jump Crypto’s partners through direct contributions or advice on code, tokenomics modeling, strategy, and other areas.
  • Produce actionable insights on incomplete data to drive decision making on investments and product strategy.
  • Identify early-stage opportunities for our investments, engineering, market making, and trading operations.
  • Feed research insights on new trends (such as MEV) or projects back to the group through strong writing or effective presentations.
  • Other duties as assigned or needed.

Skills You’ll Need:

  • Obsessed with the crypto industry and willing to follow its ever-evolving landscape to help guide the group’s efforts optionally on macro-level strategy or specific project architecture.
  • Well versed in one, or many disciplines material to blockchain development including, but not limited to, smart contracts, cryptography, crypto-economics, networking, consensus algorithms, distributed systems, and other related technologies.
  • An excellent communicator across both written and verbal channels, and able to effectively convey technical concepts clearly to the appropriate audience.
  • Able to balance open-ended, blue-sky research with actionable results.
  • Excited by the prospect of working in a fast-paced and lean organization with evolving focuses and priorities.
  • Kind, communicative, resourceful, self-sufficient, and able to work with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Reliable and predictable availability.

  • Private Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance

About us

We’re Littlepay - a growing fintech headquartered in Melbourne with operations in the UK, EU, LATAM, USA, and Australia. Our payments platform enables our customers to pay for public transport using any payment card, mobile wallet, or wearable device. Processing over USD 1 billion a year in 19 countries and continuing to expand globally, we’re proud to move more people through better payment experiences.

About the role

Littlepay simplifies payments for public transport. We are building on that expertise to develop opportunities across parking, tolling, EV charging and fuel, helping operators manage payments across complex, interconnected environments.

We are looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to lead commercial development in these sectors across the UK and Europe. You will identify where Littlepay has the strongest opportunity to compete, build relationships with customers and partners, and convert those opportunities into profitable new business.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a personal revenue target and meaningful influence over how we enter and grow in new markets. It calls for someone who can combine market development with disciplined sales execution, from opening the right doors to negotiating and closing complex enterprise agreements.

What you'll do

Develop a focused approach to market

Identify and prioritise the customers, use cases and markets where Littlepay can deliver clear value. Translate market insight into an actionable commercial plan, informed by customer demand, competitive positioning, revenue potential and the capabilities required to win. Work with Revenue leadership, Product and Partnerships & Solutions to agree priorities and direct effort towards the strongest opportunities.

Build senior customer and partner relationships

Develop relationships with major operators, infrastructure owners, retailers and relevant public authorities. Engage decision makers across commercial, operational, technology, finance and procurement teams, building a clear understanding of their priorities and buying processes.

Work with Partnerships & Solutions to develop routes to market through equipment manufacturers, software providers, acquirers and other partners whose technology and relationships shape customer decisions.

Own the sale from prospecting to contract

Build and manage a qualified pipeline, taking personal responsibility for progressing opportunities through discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation and signature. Develop a compelling business case for each customer, connecting Littlepay’s capabilities to measurable commercial and operational benefits.

Lead complex tenders and RFPs, coordinating contributions from across the business and maintaining a clear strategy for winning each opportunity.

Shape commercially sound solutions

Work with Partnerships & Solutions, Product and Delivery to establish solution fit, integration requirements, dependencies and delivery feasibility. Ensure customer proposals reflect capabilities and commitments agreed internally.

Structure and negotiate agreements with support from Finance and Legal, balancing customer value with revenue, margin, implementation effort and contractual risk. Exercise sound judgement about which opportunities to pursue and when to step away.

Build a foundation for sustainable growth

Maintain accurate opportunity records and evidence based forecasts, with clear next steps, buying milestones and risks. Bring customer and competitor insight into commercial planning and product discussions.

Lead a structured handover to the Strategic Account Leader and Delivery, remaining engaged through mobilisation where needed to preserve relationships and continuity. Use early customer wins to develop references, strengthen sector knowledge and establish a repeatable approach to winning further business.

What we're looking for

You will have a strong record of winning complex enterprise business, personally owning significant opportunities through long sales cycles and consistently delivering against new business targets.

You will understand at least one of our target sectors through experience selling payments, parking, tolling, EV charging, forecourt technology or closely related solutions. You will bring relevant senior relationships and the ability to establish credibility with customers and partners in unfamiliar markets.

You will be comfortable developing business where the route to market is still taking shape. That means asking good questions, testing assumptions and turning incomplete information into clear commercial priorities.

You will also bring:

  • A practical understanding of card payments, acquiring and the integration considerations involved in unattended payment environments.
  • Experience navigating complex procurement processes, competitive tenders and negotiations involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial judgement, including the ability to assess customer value, profitability and the cost of delivering a proposed solution.
  • The ability to lead opportunities across internal teams, securing commitment and maintaining momentum without direct authority.
  • Clear communication, disciplined forecasting and personal accountability for results.

Experience developing business across European markets, working with public sector buyers or building partner routes to market would be valuable. An additional European language would be an advantage. The role involves regular travel across the UK and Europe.

What success looks like

Success will be measured through profitable new business secured against agreed targets, the quality and progression of your pipeline, and the accuracy of your forecasts.

In your first year, you will be expected to establish clear priorities for the sectors and markets you cover, build a credible pipeline of major customer opportunities, develop productive partner relationships and secure initial contracts against an agreed sales plan. Those wins should provide a practical foundation for Littlepay’s continued growth in new sectors.

Our benefits

We love to look after our people. At Littlepay, you'll be part of an inclusive and diverse team that celebrates the differences and unique gifts we each bring to work.

You’ll have access to:

  • A high trust working environment, with access to cloud collaboration tools like Notion, Slack, Claude, Google Workspace, and Jira to help us work together effectively

About the role

Littlepay is entering an exciting new phase of growth, creating an opportunity to build one of our most commercially important capabilities. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, you will own the commercial success of our Tier 1 and Tier 2 enterprise customers across global markets, protecting and growing the relationships that drive the majority of our recurring revenue.

As one of the first dedicated hires in this function, you will build the account management frameworks, governance and ways of working that will scale across the business as Littlepay continues to expand globally. What you’ll do

Strategic Account Management

Lodestar's mission is to develop the first "Protect and Defend" capability for high-value space assets in orbit.   • Knowledgeable in high-speed interface design and signal integrity analysis.
  • Skilled in hardware debugging, fault isolation, and performance characterisation.

The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for increasing sales from current and new MariaDB services within multiple customer segments. The ideal candidate will own the full sales cycle by engaging with customers continually throughout their adoption of MariaDB.   • Must be willing to travel up to 20% to various company and customer locations

  • Proven ability to manage large enterprise opportunities, while closing transactional business

Remote - UK - London, England

Impact the world of technology by pushing the boundaries of technology and business models, working at MariaDB, plc. Be part of a game-changing organization that encourages outside-the-box thinking, values empowerment, and is truly shaping the future of the software industry.

Senior Analytics Engineer, Analytics & Insights 

London, UK (Hybrid, 2 days in office) 

Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe.
