Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials. 

About the role 

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join Analytics & Insights, the team that owns Material Bank's analytics data layer, internal reporting, and data products that support our teams and brand partners. 

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who wants to own how analytics get built. You will take approved metric definitions and business questions and turn them into the models and metric logic in Snowflake and dbt, the dashboards, and the semantic layer and data products people use every day. 

You will own the analytics engineering for key areas of the business: understanding what needs to be measured, building the models, validating the logic, delivering the reporting, and keeping it accurate and reliable over time. You will work across multiple departments and across our data products, including embedded analytics for brands. The work varies day to day, and as a team we contribute to everything. 

What we require 

  • Ownership, end to end. You own what you build, from the first stakeholder conversation to the model, the dashboard, and the fix when something breaks. 
  • Precision and attention to detail. You understand the nuance behind a number, verify before you publish, and produce work that leaders and brand partners can trust without checking. 
  • Appetite for hard work. We are a small, ambitious team with a lot of goals. The work is demanding and the hours vary with what needs to get done. We are upfront about that because it is what the role is. 

What you'll do 

  • Own the analytics engineering for assigned business domains, translating metric definition through data model, dashboard, and insight. 
  • Design, build, and maintain documented, production-quality dbt models in Snowflake that turn approved metric definitions into reliable, reusable models and semantic definitions, and power reporting, self-serve, automation, and AI. 
  • Identify and resolve technical inconsistencies in metric logic so the business runs on one certified source of truth. 
  • Build a small set of high-value dashboards in Tableau (and Sigma, as we evolve the stack).

job-boards.greenhouse.io/gomotive/jobs/8.description_excerpt:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role

As the Staff Product Manager, UK Market, you will define and execute Motive's product strategy for the UK, with the opportunity to expand your scope to continental Europe over time. You will own the commercial roadmap: where we compete, what we build, and in what order. You will then deliver it, working with engineering teams and peers across the product organization.

International expansion is one of the most important strategic initiatives at Motive. You will partner closely with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, product leaders, designers, and engineers to bring our products to customers who face different regulations, vehicles, hardware, and buying needs than in the US. You will be a senior voice in the room as leadership decides where to invest, and you will see those decisions through to shipped product.

To succeed, you must be comfortable influencing leaders across the company and navigating complex technical and organizational challenges. We operate like a startup within a larger organization, so you will wear many hats. Being entrepreneurial, commercially minded, and growth-oriented is critical.

What You'll Do

  • Define the UK product strategy. Decide which segments, products, and use cases to prioritise to win, grounded in customer, competitive, and regulatory insight.
  • Align the company on the right commercial roadmap. Work with GTM, finance, and executive leadership to turn market opportunity into prioritised roadmaps, business cases, and investment asks.
  • Execute with engineering. Partner with multiple engineering teams and product peers to scope, sequence, and deliver UK requirements, including regional feature adaptations, compliance products, and hardware and integration needs.
  • Build a deep understanding of UK customers, from fleet operators to drivers, through regular customer visits and field research, and translate what you learn into clear product requirements.
  • Influence across the product organization so that shared platform and product teams deliver against UK priorities.
  • Establish success metrics for the region, such as win rate, market coverage, adoption, and revenue, and report progress to senior leadership.
  • Contribute to the broader international strategy through market research, benchmarking, and financial and risk assessments.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in product management at a B2B company or on operational products, with a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives at scale.
  • Strong product sense and execution, with the commercial judgement to tie roadmap decisions to business outcomes.
  • Deep analytical skills and the ability to synthesise insight for an executive audience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence up and across, including senior engineering and business leaders.
  • Experience in a startup or new team environment.
  • Based in the UK. London preferred for in-office collaboration. Ability to travel within the UK for customer visits and field research (about 1-2 times per quarter) and to San Francisco 1-2 times per year for team meetings.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with products similar to Motive's, such as connected devices, telematics, fleet or asset management, IoT hardware plus software, or AI video and safety products.
  • Experience with international launches or localization.

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. 

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations. It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology. 

Regarding US-based roles, depending on your role and primary work location, Motive Technologies, Inc. (“Employer”) discloses candidates may be required to execute a non-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.

Non-compete covenant terms in all other jurisdictions will be subject to the applicable statutory requirements, including but not limited to, procedures, industry related prohibitions, or salary and compensation thresholds.

All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/impact/jobs/855.description_excerpt:
About impact.com
impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products—Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral)—unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands, including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics, rely on impact.com to power more than 225,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

 

Your Role at impact.com:

We are growing our sales organisation to accommodate the increasing demand for our solution. We are looking for an experienced and dynamic sales person to own one of our top territories in the UK & Ireland.  You will have the opportunity to grow rapidly and gain exposure to new marketing technologies as we progress! As an Account Executive , you will be responsible for driving the sales process with prospective customers. Strong consultative and analytical skills are important for successful navigation from solution demo, the definition of the scope and final contract. Be the face and name of impact.com to some of the most well-known brands worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Sell the product to the appropriate accounts and manage towards hitting a preset revenue target.
  • Generate pipeline by proactively sourcing opportunities within the designated territory.
  • Prepare & deliver world-class demos and value-based presentations.
  • Answer prospects’ questions about product value, uses, integrations, and implementation.
  • Pro-actively drive the process with a prospective client from initial prospecting to a signed contract and internal handoff.
  • Drive active engagement by all internal and external stakeholders necessary to close a deal.
  • Update SFDC daily with all relevant details needed to reflect business reality.

Does this sound like you:

  • Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of closing experience as an AE
  • Experience within the marketing space
  • Must be a true hunter!
  • Trained in  MEDDPICC and value-based selling is a plus
  • Proven track record of over-achieving quota (top 10-20% of the company) 
  • Must be willing to work out of the London office 2x a week, at the minimum
  • Independent person with the desire to excel in a competitive and highly rewarding industry.
  • Strong communication, effective problem-solving, networking and presentation skills.
  • Proven track record of building territories and addressing client needs.
  • Experience handling objections at multiple levels of enterprise organisations.

 

Benefits and Perks: 

At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

  • Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.
  • Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.
  • A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.
  • Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.
  • Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.
  • Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses. 

impact.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. job-boards.greenhouse.io/minio/jobs/5442.description_excerpt:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.

European governments, research institutions, and public bodies are investing in large-scale AI, analytics, and data infrastructure. MinIO's software-defined, S3-compatible, cloud-native object storage is built for the performance and scale these workloads demand.

We are seeking a technical, creative, and entrepreneurial Enterprise Account Executive to lead MinIO's growth in the public sector across EU Region. You will sell to national and regional government, research and HPC centres, universities, healthcare bodies, defence and security agencies, and EU institutions. You will combine technical depth in storage, data lake/lakehouse, AI/ML, and HPC with a real understanding of how the public sector buys, so you can shape and win complex, multi-stakeholder deals of €250K+.

What You Will Do

  • Drive Public Sector Business Development: Identify and develop opportunities across ministries, agencies, research organisations, and public institutions. Engage early, before requirements are written, to influence strategy, architecture, and budget planning.
  • Lead Technical and Vision Selling: Articulate how MinIO delivers transformational outcomes for data infrastructure, AI/ML, analytics, and HPC, not just incremental improvements. Translate technical capabilities into mission outcomes and public value.
  • Navigate Public Procurement: Manage the full cycle from early engagement through tender, evaluation, and award. This includes EU and national procurement rules, framework agreements, and dynamic purchasing systems. Respond to RFIs, RFPs, and ITTs with Solutions Engineering, Legal, and Contracts.
  • Close Complex Deals: Own opportunities with longer, committee-driven sales cycles, from first contact through to award.
  • Compete and Win Against Legacy Vendors: Position cloud-native, S3-compatible object storage against traditional storage vendors by demonstrating its advantages for modern workloads. Make the case on cost, flexibility, and performance.
  • Support Security Reviews: Work with customers and internal teams to respond to security questionnaires and architecture reviews, involving Product and Legal as needed.
  • Build the Business Case: Develop ROI and total-cost-of-ownership models that speak to public-sector priorities: value for money, risk reduction, and long-term sustainability.
  • Partner-First Territory Strategy: Build and run co-selling plans with resellers, system integrators, and alliance partners, including those holding public-sector frameworks, to extend coverage and reach buyers who purchase through partners.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, and Marketing on tailored solutions, successful POCs and pilots, and a smooth path from award to deployment.
  • Forecast with Discipline: Maintain accurate pipeline management, realistic forecasting that reflects procurement timelines and budget cycles, and clear account plans.

Your Skills and Experience

  • Public Sector Sales Expertise: 7+ years of enterprise or public-sector sales in the EU, with consistent quota attainment and average deal sizes of €250K+.
  • Procurement Fluency: Hands-on experience with public tenders and frameworks, and with working through procurement officers, technical evaluators, and budget holders.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong knowledge of storage, data infrastructure, data lakehouse, AI/ML, and HPC environments. You can engage architects and researchers and connect technical concepts to mission and policy outcomes.
  • Public Sector IT Awareness: Working knowledge of the data protection and security requirements that shape European public-sector IT purchasing.
  • Partner-Led Approach: Track record of building co-selling strategies with channel, SI, and alliance partners.
  • Competitive Selling: Proven ability to displace entrenched vendors with a differentiated value proposition.
  • Consultative, Challenger Mindset: You teach, tailor, and challenge customer thinking, and you shape requirements rather than just responding to them.
  • Startup Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity and building from the ground up in a fast-moving company.
  • Network: Established relationships within UK/EU public institutions, research communities, and the partner ecosystem.
  • Communication: Excellent presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with technical and executive stakeholders. Fluency in English and other relevant local languages is required.
  • Education: BA/BS in computer science, engineering, business, or a related field; MBA preferred.
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

With millions of devices under management and 100+ annual feature releases, you will have the opportunity to shape the next phase of a category-defining platform.

Drive high-velocity pipeline and revenue growth through a strategic partner ecosystem across the UK. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of the partnership: recruiting, enabling, and actively co-selling with top-tier VARs, MSPs, and Distributors to close complex enterprise deals. You will target key buyers in IT, Security, and Endpoint Management, building the blueprint for how Hexnode wins at scale through the channel.

  • Collaborate on compelling partner offers, including creative bundling, MDF/co-marketing initiatives, and clear referral/resale frameworks.
  • Maintain a disciplined cadence for forecasting partner-sourced pipeline and bookings to ensure consistent quota over-performance.
  • Act as a skilled "internal seller" capable of securing SE resources, pricing approvals, and technical support to unblock partner deals.

 

Required Experience & Expertise

  • 5 to 10 years of B2B partner/channel sales experience within SaaS, Security, or IT Infrastructure.
  • Proven record of carrying a partner quota and navigating 2-tier distribution models (Distributor → Reseller/MSP).

  • High partner empathy with the ability to translate technical complexity into a simple, partner-ready value proposition.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/cssmerge/jobs/8.description_excerpt:
Who we are 

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

 

What you’ll do

Project Delivery & Site Execution

  • Oversee the end-to-end construction of new developments—with a focus on roadside QSR drive-thrus and EVC hubs—as well as modernisations across the existing real estate portfolio.
  • Develop, manage, and track project schedules and critical path milestones to ensure timely delivery across multiple concurrent schemes.
  • Conduct regular site visits, job walks, and pre-construction due diligence activities to verify site conditions and progress.
  • Troubleshoot constructability, sequencing, and inspection issues on-site to resolve blockers quickly and prevent project delays.

Utility & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships and day-to-day coordination with external consultants, principal contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Lead the on-site sequencing and scheduling of utility companies to secure timely power, water, and telecom connections—critical for EVC and drive-thru operations.

Commercial & Financial Control

  • Assist with budget planning, cost monitoring, and financial control across assigned projects.
  • Review, verify, and process contractor valuations and payment applications to ensure compliance with contractual terms.

Quality, Compliance & Safety

  • Enforce rigorous Health & Safety standards across all active sites in line with UK statutory regulations and internal policies.
  • Conduct quality assurance checks to ensure all works conform to corporate specifications, design standards, and operational requirements.

Reporting & Administration

  • Provide regular project status, budget, and risk reporting to senior leadership.
  • Coordinate project administration, including site meetings, contract documentation, and handover processes.

 

What we’re looking for

Experience & Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in construction management, ideally within retail, hospitality, roadside QSR, or F&B developments.
  • Professional accreditation: RICS, CIOB, or MAPM membership (or actively working towards chartered status) is highly desirable.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or a related field preferred.
  • Full UK driving licence due to site travel.

Technical & Commercial Skills

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong negotiation skills and sound commercial judgment when managing contracts, suppliers, and budgets.
  • Multi-Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, navigate competing priorities, and deliver to strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving: A pragmatic approach to identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving complex constructability and operational challenges.

Soft Skills & Working Style

  • Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from site teams to executive leadership.
  • Autonomy & Collaboration: A collaborative team player who can take ownership, show initiative, and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Adaptability: Highly organized, resilient, and comfortable adapting to changing priorities across a dynamic operational footprint.

 

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

 

What else you need to know

This role is based in our London office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

 

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

London, United Kingdom or Zurich, Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens)

You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?

  • Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.
  • Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.
  • Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.
  • Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.
  • Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.

About the opportunity

We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.

You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.

Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.

How you will make an impact

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.
  • Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.
  • Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.
  • Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.
  • Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.
  • Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.
  • Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.
  • Business-fluent French: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in French. 
  • Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.
  • Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.
  • Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.
  • Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.
  • Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.
  • Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.

Working model

Working hours are generally 9:00am-6:00pm London time, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.

You’ll typically spend:

  • Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.
  • Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.
  • Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.

Initially this role will be remote. Once Pallet opens its local office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.

Reporting structure

You’ll report directly to the General Manager, London for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.

You’ll also work closely with our Head of Sales, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.

  • Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins

  • Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins
  • Final Interview - ~3 hours
  • Brief Background Check and Reference Check

Compensation

The estimated compensation range for this role is £100,000-£240,000 OTE, depending on experience and skill set.

Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.

In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.

Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide

For further details please visit www.pantheon.com

Purpose of Position

The purpose of the role is to manage and maintain investor and prospect data within our CRM and to train Pantheon employees to ensure high levels of adoption across the Client Solutions and marketing teams. The role will also drive enhancements to the CRM and the delivery of enhances to the organization. In addition, the role will support the boarder Product Strategy & Fundraising team, along with Client Onboarding to ensure data is synchronized and up-to-date, along with supporting Client Onboarding around data inputting during new investor closings.  

Key Responsibilities

CRM Maintenance, Enhancements & Training

  • Ensure all prospect leads are synchronized and up-to-date (including meeting notes and lead status)
  • Ensure all new client information is correct at new investor closings
  • Run and create ad-hoc reports and analysis around prospective investors and current client data (including PowerBI reports)
  • Support marketing campaigns by generating mailing lists / target lists
  • Continuously focus on creating synergies and enhancements to the CRM
  • Liaison / work with outside vendors, consultants and internal IT on problem solving, enhancements and updates
  • Train all staff in the functionality of the CRM and focus on increasing adoption
  • Act as the data owner for prospect and new client information
  • Ensure all new funds are set-up correctly in CRM and available for FRO tagging

On/Offboarding Support

  • Ensure new client data is captured during the closing process
  • Support on an ad-hoc basis any closing related need
  • Participate in all internal closing related meetings

Reporting

  • Responsibility for ensuring data is accurate for reporting on fundraising data to Senior Management and external Boards
  • Ad-hoc support to the broader Product Strategy & Fundraising team on pipeline reporting to internal and external stakeholders

Knowledge and Experience Required

  • Degree qualified with solid experience managing data within MS Dynamics
  • Strong communication skills, both written and oral
  • Meticulous attention to detail regarding data organisation within CRM
  • Deep understanding of Microsoft Dynamics, PowerBI and ideally Introhive
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills (Lookups/Pivots)
  • Experience organizing / setting up conference calls and meetings across multiple times zones
  • General knowledge of alternative investments desirable

We are looking for the successful candidate to start in Feb 27

This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. You may be required to perform other job-related duties as reasonably requested by your manager.

Pantheon is an Equal Opportunities employer, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't perfectly align we'd still encourage you to apply.

Purpose of Role 

The role will be responsible for the ongoing assessment and monitoring of Investment Risk at both portfolio and deal level across Pantheon’s private markets platform, with an initial focus on Private Credit. The role will provide independent evaluation of existing and emerging risks, taking a proactive approach towards management and mitigation of risks identified. While a second line of defence, the individual will work closely with investment teams and portfolio management teams to understand risk profiles and how these develop as portfolios mature. They will ensure that capital allocation aligns with each fund's stated investment strategy, LPA limits and investment restrictions, internal soft targets, and regulatory requirements. The individual will produce risk analytics for review and discussion with investment teams and portfolio management teams, with results used to improve investment outcomes for investors.

There will be continued development of current tools that will ultimately allow Pantheon to further improve risk analytics to enhance monitoring of our portfolios.

The role will support the development of the risk framework, taking ownership of the build-out of risk processes and tools.

Key Responsibilities  

Manage and monitor investment risk across Private Credit (Primaries, Secondaries and Co-investments), involving:

  • Portfolio management oversight, including adherence to LPA limits, internal soft targets, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Understanding of investment processes and portfolio construction through regular interaction with investment teams
  • Attending Investment Committee(s) for relevant area 
  • Assessment of any changes to internal portfolio limits/targets against its risk profile
  • Ongoing development of analytical tools to assist better portfolio monitoring as determined by Group needs and requirements
  • Supporting the continuous refinement of the oversight model and process
  • Reporting on portfolio management activities and presenting the results to the appropriate governing body (eg Risk Committees and Fund/AIFM Boards) and stakeholders. In-depth risk reviews of deals/portfolios as appropriate
  • Ensuring compliance with relevant laws, regulations and Pantheon policy (including reporting compliance risks and maintaining appropriate standards of conduct)

Skills and Experience Required  

  • Deep understanding of Private Credit investment dynamics
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills such that the individual can collate, interpret and analyse portfolio, risk and performance data
  • MS Office, especially Excel including basic VBA. Experience with Bloomberg terminal considered an advantage. AI tool usage would be an advantage
  • Masters degree preferred
  • Critical thinking
  • Appreciation of risk, and how risks can be mitigated

Governance Operations Manager

Time commitment: Full-time
Location: Hybrid working, 3 days per week in our London office, 2 days from home. If this is not possible, we will consider alternative requests, though the minimum is 1 day per week in our London office.
Reporting to: Head of Operations (VP Operations in interim)

 

About Paloma

Our mission is to make NHS autism and ADHD care accessible within 4 weeks and, in turn, help every child achieve their potential.

In 2024, our founders, Mark and Darshak, were shocked to find that children needing an NHS autism or ADHD assessment were waiting 4-10 years. Delays result in children being more likely to develop mental health conditions and fall behind in education. Furthermore, the much-needed pre/post-assessment support (outside of ADHD medications) is typically not funded by the NHS. 

These long waits have built up because of increased recognition and understanding of neurodevelopmental conditions, and a lack of investment and innovation within the NHS to meet growing demand.

Mark and Darshak, with their 25 years of combined NHS experience, including building services that have treated over 1,000,000 patients in obesity & ophthalmology, founded Paloma to change this. 

We have successfully reduced waits to less than 3 months by;

  • Taking a product-first approach to redesign the care pathway to give families a more consumer-like experience of care
  • Our in-house product, engineering and AI team have built our own autism- and ADHD specific electronic health record and AI support tool to free clinicians from documentation to refocus on supporting families
  • Investing in up- and cross-skilling our clinicians

We are proud that Paloma is:

  • Loved by families, with 4.9 out of 5 on Google and 4.8 out of 5 on Trustpilot
  • Care Quality Commission (CQC) registered and quality-focused
  • Clinically led, with over 100 clinicians who support families through their care journey. 
  • A community of passionate, mission-driven and innovative team members who challenge the status quo and test and learn from new ideas and approaches.
  • In control of our own destiny, as we are profitable and backed by leading healthcare investors Triple Point and Heal Capital
  • Growing fast, hiring over 100 more roles in the next 12 months.

What’s next?

  • Whilst we have reduced wait times, it is estimated that up to 500,000 children are still waiting for an NHS autism or ADHD assessment, and potentially millions more are waiting for post-assessment care. We won’t rest until this comes down.
  • We will build new services to support families and children diagnosed with autism or ADHD who feel lost after their assessments when the NHS is no longer there for them.

Are you an organised and skilled operations manager passionate about improving children’s mental health? We are seeking a Governance Operations Manager to lead our governance, safeguarding and care quality operations.

Paloma is a Care Quality Commission (CQC) regulated provider, and you will support our Registered Manager to build and improve our systems to demonstrate our care is safe, effective and well led. 

This work includes line managing our Safeguarding team and working closely with the Medical Director and senior clinicians to build robust processes around:

  • Clinical governance and patient safety: keeping our families, team and organisation safe.
  • Safeguarding: protecting the children and young people we work with.
  • Care quality: ensuring all families receive care that we are proud of.

Importantly, this is not a clinical role. It is an operations expert who supports our senior clinicians. 

With strong performance in this role, you can progress to a Senior Manager.

 

About You

This role is great for someone who:

  • Loves building, delivering and improving processes
  • Enjoys leading and managing a (small) team of 2
  • Communicates clearly and succinctly both verbally and in writing
  • Relishes challenging constructively where you see things can be improved
  • Manages their work with project management tools or spreadsheets
  • Can work in Google Sheets/Excel to understand and analyse data
  • Understands the importance of keeping sensitive data confidential 
  • Has a passion for healthcare safety
  • Wants to be part of an always-learning environment that embraces software and AI tools and wins as a positive and collaborative team.

  • Partner with the Registered Manager and Medical Director to ensure all governance topics are mapped, monitored and delivered, so that we can demonstrate Paloma is safe, effective and well-led.

    • Support the safeguarding team with operational processes, including case tracking, safeguarding supervision records, and multi-agency liaison.
    • Make sure safeguarding activity and audit findings, led by the Senior Safeguarding Officer, are reported to the governance meeting.
  • Drive our governance processes, including:
    • Setting annual quality priorities
    • Run our governance forums (including agendas/actions/follow ups)
    • Producing a monthly integrated quality and safety report for the leadership team
    • Maintain our organisational risk register, including clear risk owners, controls and review dates, and escalate emerging risks
    • Manage the day-to-day complaints process: logging, acknowledgement, investigation, response and learning, within agreed timeframes.

    • Manage the day-to-day incident and risk reporting process: logging, triage, response and closure, identifying themes and trends, and reporting them to the governance meeting.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/phaidra/jobs/47.description_excerpt:
About Phaidra

Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.

The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:

  • We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.
  • We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.
  • We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.

Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo, to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.

Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Agency, Velocity, Craft, and Truth. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture

Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR. Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India.

About the Project

Phaidra builds autonomous AI control systems for data centre and industrial infrastructure. We deploy reinforcement learning in production on some of the world's most complex physical systems. The hard, unsolved research problems are the same ones that matter in practice. This studentship is an opportunity to work on foundational RL research while staying grounded in real-world challenges.

Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful framework for sequential decision-making. Yet a fundamental limitation remains: agents trained on historical data under fixed policies often exploit spurious correlations that break at deployment time, especially when the environment shifts or the new policy explores previously unseen regions of the state-action space.

This PhD project tackles that limitation by integrating causal reasoning into RL. Causal inference provides a formal language (causal graphs, interventional queries, counterfactuals) for distinguishing stable structural relationships from incidental correlations. The research will investigate how these tools can make RL agents more robust and generalizable, particularly in real-world industrial settings.

The project will proceed in three phases:

  1. Theoretical Foundations: formalising policy learning from biased, small datasets through a causal lens; characterising how confounding and mediators affect offline RL.

  2. Algorithm Development: building RL algorithms that leverage known or learned causal structure to improve out-of-distribution generalisation and provide policy guarantees.

  3. Benchmarking & Evaluation: evaluating proposed methods on controlled simulated environments with known causal structure, benchmarked against standard and offline RL baselines.

Supervisors

  • Academic Supervisor: Prof. Alessandro Abate, Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge

  • Industrial Co-supervisors: Dr. Miguel Suau and Dr. Alec Edwards, Phaidra

The student will be based primarily at the University of Cambridge, with the opportunity to spend time at Phaidra.

Funding & Duration

This is a fully funded 4-year PhD studentship, expected to start January 2027, co-funded by Phaidra and administered by the University of Cambridge.

Who You Are

You are a curious and technically rigorous researcher who wants to work at the intersection of causal inference and sequential decision-making. You are excited by foundational questions with real-world stakes and want your PhD to contribute both to the academic literature and to the practical deployment of intelligent systems.

Key Qualifications

  • A first-class or upper second-class honours degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related technical field.
  • Strong background in at least one of: reinforcement learning, machine learning, probabilistic modelling, or control theory.
  • Proficiency in Python and standard ML libraries (PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn).
  • Clear scientific writing skills and the ability to communicate research to both academic and applied audiences.
  • Eligibility to study at the University of Cambridge (international students welcome; English language requirements apply).

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Familiarity with causal inference, causal graphical models, or structural equation models.
  • Prior research experience (undergraduate thesis, MSc dissertation, research internship, or publications).
  • Experience with offline RL, batch RL, or safe RL.
  • Exposure to applying ML to real-world physical or industrial systems.

How to Apply

There are two parallel steps, both required:

  1. Apply through Phaidra's careers portal at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/phaidra. You will be asked to submit a CV and a short cover letter describing your research interests and motivation.
  2. Apply to the University of Cambridge through the postgraduate application portal for the PhD in Engineering…

About Phaidra

Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.

The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:

  • We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.
  • We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.
  • We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.

Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo, to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.

Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Agency, Velocity, Craft, and Truth. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture

Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR. Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India.

Who You Are

Research Scientists at Phaidra lead our efforts in developing novel algorithmic architecture towards the end goal of bringing intelligent control systems to industrial sector.

Having pioneered research in the world's leading academic and industrial labs as PhDs, post-docs or professors, Research Scientists join Phaidra to work collaboratively within and across research fields.

Drawing on expertise from a variety of disciplines including model-based reinforcement learning, planning and optimal control, deep learning, world models, and safe reinforcement learning, our Research Scientists are at the forefront of groundbreaking research and applying it to real-world industrial control systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evaluate model-based reinforcement learning agents — including planning-based controllers (MPC, MPPI) — and the software prototypes needed to deploy them on real industrial control systems.
  • Develop learned dynamics and world models (learned surrogates) that generalize across systems, including the training pipelines — pretraining, curriculum learning, active/adversarial learning, and fine-tuning — needed to make them reliable for planning and control.
  • Research and implement methods for e.g. safe RL, constrained control, scenario planning and Bayesian RL, to develop agents that satisfy safety constraints during deployment.
  • Report and present research findings and developments including status and results clearly and efficiently both internally and externally, verbally and in writing.
  • Participate in and organize ambitious collaborative research projects, and work with external collaborators and partners to translate research into production outcomes.
  • Mentor and guide Research Engineers to apply research findings and developments to industrial domains.
  • Independently defines new research directions
  • Translates research into practical outcomes
  • Owns the development and rollout for an entire research area or large project

Key Qualifications

  • PhD in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, with a strong background in model-based reinforcement learning and demonstrated knowledge in one or more of the following:
    • Planning algorithms
    • World models / learned dynamics surrogates
    • Reinforcement Learning and Deep Learning
    • Control Theory
    • Safe / constrained RL
  • Either:
    • 2+ years of research experience in academia or industry after PhD graduation.
    • 5+ years of research experience in academia or industry after Master’s graduation.
  • Extensive research in the fields of {ModelBased, ModelFree, Safe} RL and Control Theory, with particular depth in model-based methods.
  • Hands-on experience building and evaluating agents against simulators (e.g. differentiable simulators or world models) and closing the sim-to-real gap.
  • Alignment with Phaidra's values: Agency, Velocity, Craft, & Truth.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • PhD in machine learning, control, or a closely related field.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with model-based RL and planning agents applied to real-world dynamical or industrial systems.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including vectorized/differentiable simulators and scaling experiments on distributed compute (e.g. Ray, Kubernetes, GCP).
  • A proven track record of publications in RL, control, or a related area.
  • A real passion for AI and applying it to industrial systems to improve resource efficiency.

Our Stack

  • PyTorch, scipy
  • Kubernetes, Docker, Ray
  • GCP

In your first 30 days...

  • You will spend time in the research team and get introduced to the different tracks of research that we perform.

In short, you bring the expertise to keep payroll running brilliantly and the mindset to keep making it better.

QuEra Computing UK Limited is looking for an experienced AMO Physicist for its UK Quantum Computing operations. About Salary Finance

Working with employers, we provide a financial wellbeing platform as an employee benefit, helping employees to understand their money better, get out of debt faster and save for their future. We already have a reach of circa 4,000,000 employees through our relationships with over 500 of the largest employers in the UK. 

By improving employee financial wellbeing, we have a very real and meaningful impact on people’s lives. We remove the stress and worry associated with financial difficulties by dramatically reducing the interest rates employees pay on their personal debt, and provide them with the tools needed to start saving sooner and be more financially secure. We are backed by some of the biggest brands, including investments from Blenheim Chalcot (the UK’s leading venture builder), Legal and General (the FTSE 100 insurer and asset manager), Experian and Goldman Sachs, and funding partnerships with JP Morgan and Blue Owl. 

Launched in 2015, we have made excellent progress, and are scaling fast. We have been named BITC’s Responsible Business of Year, included in KPMG’s Global Fintech 100, listed top of the Forbes' list of socially-responsible startups, and profiled by the Financial Times, the Times, the Wall Street Journal, the Guardian, the Telegraph, CityAM and the Institute of Directors.

Your role in our mission

This is a hands-on senior role covering maternity leave that sits across two disciplines: Employee Communications (the employer-facing channel - client launches, employer comms strategy and B2B2C messaging) and Engagement (email marketing, B2C audience).

You're a self-starter who's used to being an individual contributor, able to deliver projects end to end with guidance and support from the Head of Engagement. Across B2B2C and B2C you will own compliance governance for the content and campaigns you’re responsible for, and be accountable for key KPIs such as applications and app downloads , and the quality of the client and end-user experience across every campaign you touch. You’ll need to be comfortable moving between strategic, employer-facing conversations and hands-on, data-led consumer engagement work from one day to the next.

What you’ll do

Employee Communications (B2B2C - Employer Channel)

  • Lead and manage end-to-end launch communications strategies for large, complex clients working closely with Sales, Implementation and Client Success teams.
  • Run client-facing communications workshops that explain our products, the regulatory context behind them, and best communications practice for engaging with our clients’ employees.
  • Own content production for large client launches from initial brief through to post-launch review, and be accountable for production quality and delivery timelines against business and revenue targets.
  • Own and manage a portfolio of large and complex enterprise clients or Key Accounts, providing them with strategic guidance, campaign ideas, content and day to day communications support.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Head of Engagement on client management and campaign investment decisions, and be accountable for the quality of client experience across the campaigns you manage.

Engagement (B2C - Consumer Channel)

  • Own planning and execution for monthly B2C email marketing campaigns, and be accountable for the commercial effectiveness of the campaigns you run.
  • Collaborate with the Enterprise Data team to ensure audience data and impact reporting for email marketing is available, accurate and helps us shape our approach and decisions.
  • Optimise our email marketing flow by identifying process improvements, delivery efficiencies, and contributing to seamless collaboration between cross-functional teams 

Analytics, Compliance & Governance (Both Channels)

  • Own and monitor engagement performance and reporting across B2B2C and B2C, leading analysis of what’s driving take-up and engagement and identifying trends.
  • Own FinProm compliance governance for both the Employee Comms and Engagement content you’re responsible for, leading compliance input into product development and campaign planning, and acting as first escalation point for compliance queries within your remit.

Content (Both Channels)

About Salary Finance

Working with employers, we provide a financial wellbeing platform as an employee benefit, helping employees to understand their money better, get out of debt faster and save for their future. We already have a reach of circa 4,000,000 employees through our relationships with over 500 of the largest employers in the UK. 

By improving employee financial wellbeing, we have a very real and meaningful impact on people’s lives. We remove the stress and worry associated with financial difficulties by dramatically reducing the interest rates employees pay on their personal debt, and provide them with the tools needed to start saving sooner and be more financially secure. We are backed by some of the biggest brands, including investments from Blenheim Chalcot (the UK’s leading venture builder), Legal and General (the FTSE 100 insurer and asset manager), Experian and Goldman Sachs, and funding partnerships with JP Morgan and Blue Owl. 

Launched in 2015, we have made excellent progress, and are scaling fast. We have been named BITC’s Responsible Business of Year, included in KPMG’s Global Fintech 100, listed top of the Forbes' list of socially-responsible startups, and profiled by the Financial Times, the Times, the Wall Street Journal, the Guardian, the Telegraph, CityAM and the Institute of Directors.

Your role in our mission

As Head of Product for Borrow, you'll own our lending products from the moment a customer starts an application to the day their loan is repaid. You'll lead two product squads: one covering everything up to the point the money is paid out, and one covering everything after it. You’ll be accountable for helping more employees borrow with us, and for making sure every loan is run accurately and fairly, with customers well supported from application to final repayment. You'll report to the Product Director.

How Borrow works

We lend to employees through their employer. Three parties are involved:

  • Customers are employees who take out a loan with us.
  • Employers deduct repayments from pay and give us the data we need to confirm customers are who they say they are.
  • Salary Finance is the lender, responsible for the application, the payout and the life of the loan.

Taking repayments straight from salary means much lower credit losses than other lenders, and we pass that saving on to customers as a lower rate. It also makes lending harder to run. Repayments follow payroll, so loans are repaid weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly or monthly. Customers can change payroll at any time. Employers pay us in bulk, and we reconcile each payment to individual loans.

  • Get compliance right: make sure customers receive the correct regulatory communications on time, every time, and own the evidence that Borrow delivers good outcomes and fair value under Consumer Duty
  • Represent Borrow: prepare and present Borrow papers for our Product Oversight Committee

  • Customer-obsessed: you talk to customers and clients regularly, run research yourself, and can point to decisions you changed, and things you decided not to build, because of what you heard. You know many borrowers are under financial pressure, and you design for good outcomes as well as conversion

At SilverRail, we're on a mission to reshape the way the world travels, and we're inviting you to be part of this journey. Rail is becoming the go-to choice for short and medium-haul travel worldwide, and we're here to help make it happen. 

In the face of the ongoing climate crisis, our vision is crystal clear. We are transforming the online customer experience for rail travel, making it easier than ever for customers to find, buy and use rail. Our cutting-edge technology is the backbone of rail and travel agencies worldwide, making it effortless for travellers to choose the eco-friendly option and reduce their carbon footprint. 

We have more than 15 years of trailblazing success behind us, and our teams are spread across the globe, with bases in London, Boston, Brisbane, and Stockholm. We thrive on the philosophy of 'fail-fast-fail-early,' which drives us to find ingenious solutions to complex challenges. 

Join us, and help shape the future of travel! 

The Role 

As Account Director, you'll sit within our Commercial / Partnerships team reporting to our Head of UK Commercial, and will be working on our partnership with ScotRail - one of our key UK train operating company (TOC) relationships and industry stakeholders. As such, the role will require regular travel to Glasgow, so you will ideally be based either in Glasgow or within a reasonable travel distance. The role may also require occasional travel to our London head office. 

You'll own the commercial relationship end-to-end, managing stakeholders at all levels to ensure booking and revenue targets are met or exceeded, and that SilverRail is viewed as a valuable, competent and innovative partner. 

You will call on strong commercial instincts and a solid grasp of distribution technology and retailing to understand what drives bookings through ScotRail's channels, working closely with Product, Technology, Customer Operations & Planning as well as other subcontracted companies and third-party suppliers to recommend and deliver initiatives that grow partnership value. 

This role will suit someone from a commercial account management or partnership background who is comfortable working with data, product teams, and senior stakeholders. A genuine curiosity about technology, retailing, and customer experience - particularly how AI is reshaping rail retailing - will help you spot the next opportunity for the partnership before others do. 

 
Key Responsibilities 

  • Partner Development: Own the ScotRail relationship, working in partnership with ScotRail teams to hit or exceed booking volume targets. 
  • Partner Expansion: Identify and deliver growth initiatives across product, technology, and new services to increase bookings and revenue through ScotRail's channels.

job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/scbitdefende.description_excerpt:
Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com

Who this is for

You're a strong technical security practitioner - offensive security, threat research, detection engineering, endpoint / EDR, incident response, or similar - and you increasingly find yourself the one explaining the hard stuff: writing it up, giving the talk, answering in the community, mentoring. You want a role where that becomes the job. This is a deliberate career move from doing the technical work to being a respected technical voice in the community - with the runway and support to grow into it. The common thread: you actually do the work, and the voice is your own - this is a role for someone with real depth to share, not someone who repackages other people's (or an LLM's) takes.

The role in one line

Be Bitdefender's credible technical voice for technical audiences - through deep, honest content and genuine community engagement - and the technical anchor of a team that ships to security practitioners.

Why this role exists

BSG's work is research-led and prevention-first, and it's aimed at technical people who can smell marketing from a mile away. We want someone who lives in that world: who can produce content practitioners actually respect, and who is (or wants to become) a real, trusted member of the communities where those practitioners gather. You'll work directly with the researchers at Bitdefender Labs and have access to our global threat telemetry - using that vantage point to spot emerging threats, techniques, and trends early and translate them into education the wider technical community can act on.

What you'll do

  • Original, deep technical content. Produce genuinely technical material for technical audiences - hands-on deep dives, threat and defense analysis, explainers, the occasional talk or workshop. Your own analysis and work, not recycled takes; substance over polish, evidence over adjectives.
  • Community engagement. Be present and useful in the security communities that matter - hacker cons, user groups, CTF scenes, meetups, online spaces (BSides and the wider EU/UK con and user-group circuit, local hacker groups). Not as a booth, but as a member: contributing, answering, connecting, learning. Help our own community efforts grow over time.
  • Work with Bitdefender Labs, and turn early signal into education. Partner with our threat researchers and draw on Bitdefender's global telemetry to spot new threats, techniques, and trends before they're widely understood - then translate them into clear, timely education for the technical community.
  • Bring the field back in. Surface what practitioners actually care about and are struggling with, so our technical content stays relevant and grounded.
  • Grow the craft (and yourself). Build your public technical voice - with room to develop the speaking, writing, and community-building muscles if you're earlier on that path.

What you bring (required)

  • Deep, hands-on technical security background - practitioner-level in one or more of: offensive security / red teaming, threat research, detection engineering, endpoint security / EDR / XDR, incident response. You've done the work, not just talked about it. This is the non-negotiable.
  • A real pull toward sharing and community - you already write, speak, contribute, mentor, or hang out where practitioners do, even if it isn't your full-time job yet.
  • Excellent technical communication - you write and explain the way practitioners want to read and hear it, and you instinctively avoid hype ("industry-leading", "best-in-class") in favour of specifics.
  • Roots or genuine ties in security communities - user groups, cons, meetups - or a credible, already-started path toward them.
  • UK or EU based.
  • Self-directed - this is a Principal IC role; you'll own your patch and set your own bar.

Bonus points

  • A public body of technical work - published research, talks, open-source, tooling, CTF results, advisories.
  • An existing network on the EU/UK con and user-group circuit.
  • Comfort with scripting / tooling (e.g. Python) to build or automate your own technical work.
  • Multilingual across key EU markets.

What success looks like (first 6–12 months)

  • A credible, growing technical presence - content practitioners share, and communities where you're a known and trusted member.
  • The team's external technical substance is measurably sounder because you're in the loop.
  • The beginnings of a community program with your fingerprints on it.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/theweathercompa.description_excerpt:
About The Weather Company:

The Weather Company is the world’s leading weather provider, helping people and businesses make more informed decisions and take action in the face of weather. Together with advanced technology and AI, The Weather Company’s high-volume weather data, insights, advertising, and media solutions across the open web help people, businesses, and brands around the world prepare for and harness the power of weather in a scalable, privacy-forward way. The world’s most accurate forecaster globally, the company reaches hundreds of enterprise clients and more than 360 million monthly active users via its digital properties from The Weather Channel (weather.com) and Weather Underground (wunderground.com).

Job brief:

As the Assignment Editor for The Weather Company’s UK desk, your job is deceptively big: while North America sleeps, you and your team are the newsroom, driving coverage for millions of users on Weather.com and The Weather Channel app. You own what publishes during the North American overnight and early-morning window. You’ll make editorial calls and package stories so that stateside readers wake up to coverage that's timely, accurate, and unmistakably useful. It's a role built on trusted editorial judgment, tight coordination across time zones, and a clear mandate to get ahead of the U.S. morning news cycle.

The impact you'll make: 

Own the overnight news agenda

  • Run the overnight and early-morning news agenda for North American audiences: decide what leads, what waits, and what we skip.
  • Make the editorial calls on story selection and framing, with an emphasis on what users need to know as they start their day.
  • Own headlines, packaging, and placement for the overnight window, and test into what grows engagement.
  • Manage a clean handoff with the US desk at both ends of the window: pick up open threads at night, hand off in-progress stories in the morning.
  • Keep the site and app current and credible through breaking news, severe weather, and developing stories that break while the US is offline.
  • Pick up any outstanding assignments from the U.S. news team.

Level up the product

  • Be a senior editorial decision-maker on shift: you set the bar for what's ready to publish and what isn't.
  • Hold the line on accuracy, quality, and voice under time pressure and with limited backup.
  • Know a good story and a good headline, not just a good metric, and know when a developing story is worth waking someone up for.

Coordinate across teams

  • Work in close, deliberate handoff with the US newsroom, video, and product so nothing falls through the time-zone gap.
  • Set a clear, repeatable handoff rhythm: what gets logged, flagged, and escalated, and to whom.
  • Represent the overnight window in planning so the desk is set up ahead of known events rather than reacting to them.

Grow the audience

  • Own overnight and early-morning engagement targets and treat the window as an audience to grow, not just cover.
  • Turn analytics into plain, actionable calls on timing, packaging, and story mix.
  • Optimize headlines, alerts, and modules for the overnight audience and build on what works.

What you've accomplished:

  • 8+ years in a newsroom, including significant time making live editorial decisions on shift.
  • Strong editorial judgment. You're trusted to run a desk and make the final call without a senior editor on shift.
  • Experience coordinating across desks or time zones, with a knack for clean handoffs and no dropped threads.
  • Comfort with audience analytics (Chartbeat, Parse.ly, GA). You read the numbers and act on them.
  • Familiarity with North American news and audiences, or a demonstrable ability to get up to speed fast.
  • Self-directed and calm under pressure. You thrive with autonomy, own the room, and hold standards when news breaks and no one else is online.
  • Eligible to work in the UK and able to reliably cover the US overnight / early-morning window.

Nice to have

  • Fluent with the latest engagement and distribution tools.
  • Experience building and running workflows for a 24/7 or breaking-news operation.
  • A track record of managing editorial talent across text and video.

About The Weather Company:

The Weather Company is the world’s leading weather provider, helping people and businesses make more informed decisions and take action in the face of weather. Together with advanced technology and AI, The Weather Company’s high-volume weather data, insights, advertising, and media solutions across the open web help people, businesses, and brands around the world prepare for and harness the power of weather in a scalable, privacy-forward way. The world’s most accurate forecaster globally, the company reaches hundreds of enterprise clients and more than 360 million monthly active users via its digital properties from The Weather Channel (weather.com) and Weather Underground (wunderground.com).

Job brief:

As a Meteorologist on The Weather Company’s UK desk, you are the weather expert for North America while the U.S. sleeps. You analyze the forecast, explain what is happening and why, and turn it into clear, accurate coverage for millions of users on Weather.com and The Weather Channel app. You work alongside the UK Assignment Editor and hand off cleanly to the U.S. team, so the morning audience wakes up to a forecast and story they can trust.

The impact you'll make: 

Own the science overnight

  • Monitor and analyze North American weather overnight and early morning: model guidance, observations, radar, and satellite.
  • Write and review forecast-driven stories, with the right level of confidence and detail for a general audience, making use of The Weather Company’s tools and reporting systems as well as other trusted models.
  • Provide expert guidance on severe weather, tropical systems, winter storms, air quality, flooding and other high-impact events as they develop.
  • Hold the line on scientific accuracy under time pressure and with limited backup.

Support breaking coverage

  • Work with the UK Assignment Editor to prioritize what leads, what waits, and what needs a closer look.
  • Flag developing high-impact weather early and know when it is worth waking someone up.
  • Contribute to video and social content, including identifying network clips for posting and writing original scripts for handoff to the U.S. team.

Coordinate across teams

  • Hand off in-progress forecasts and threats to the U.S. meteorology team each morning, and pick up open threads at night.
  • Keep a clear log of what was changed, flagged and escalated.
  • Work with editorial, video and product so nothing falls through the time-zone gap.

What you've accomplished:

  • Degree in meteorology, atmospheric science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience as an operational or broadcast meteorologist, with strong forecasting skills.
  • Working knowledge of North American weather patterns, including severe weather, tropical systems, wildfires and winter weather.
  • Ability to explain complex weather clearly and quickly to a general audience.
  • Self-directed and calm under pressure. You are comfortable making calls with limited backup.
  • Eligible to work in the UK and able to reliably cover the U.S. overnight / early-morning window.

Nice to have

  • Professional certification or membership (for example, RMetS, AMS, or NWA).
  • On-camera or video experience.
  • Experience with a 24/7 or breaking-news operation.

Together AI runs one of the largest GPU fleets in the world. The Infra Agent Systems team builds the software systems that power and automate that infrastructure.

We develop production AI agents that diagnose hardware failures, investigate incidents, correlate signals across the fleet, and automate operational workflows. Alongside these agents, we build the platform they run on, including knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and developer tooling.

These agents are used every day by our infrastructure and datacenter teams through APIs, CLI, dashboards, and Slack.

Core Agent Platform — Build the platform that powers these agents, including knowledge graphs, search and retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and the tooling that enables agents to reason, act, and continuously improve.

We’re working on something that hasn’t really been done before: building knowledge graphs and self-improving AI agents that understand, operate, and continuously improve large-scale AI infrastructure.
