Virtu Financial is an industry-leading financial technology firm that operates both proprietary trading and client-facing businesses in the global financial marketplace. 

Our unique culture combines the creativity of a fast paced start up, with the stability of a disciplined financial services firm. We have fun, work hard and strive to be virtuous in all we do. 


Virtu Execution Services (VES) comprises of the firm's client-facing business encompassing, Brokerage, Analytics and Workflow technology. The primarily client support focused roles under VES include Sales,Trading, Electronic Coverage, and Workflow Technology.

Roles within VES client support teams offer the opportunity to:

  • Become a multi-faceted Financial Services professional, joining a global team engaging with a wide range of vendors and institutional and retail clients
  • Receive an in-depth education on global financial markets and apply knowledge to a spectrum of Virtu's products and services- combining technology with business needs
  • Interact directly with a global client base, supporting trade execution workflow queries in real-time
  • Drive product development based on client needs and feedback, working both internally and across vendors to increase client connectivity
  • Location: London, United Kingdom (onsite) for openings in London & Dublin
  • Dates: 10 week programme, starting 21 June 2027 - 27 August 2027

Virtu is looking for top performers with below qualifications:

  • Entering final year of school, or students expected to be ready for full time employment between December 2027 - June 2028
  • Excellent academic background (all subjects welcome) with a passion for financial markets
  • Highly motivated and tenacious individual, with a proven ability to take initiative and work independently and within a team
  • Fearless networker, comfortable stepping out of their comfort zone to connect with new people
  • Able to navigate dynamic, unscripted client interactions, connecting the dots quickly and problem-solving on the fly
  • Team player: authentic, genuine person capable of working towards collective goals
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and can easily build new interpersonal relationships
  • Basic programming skills beneficial but not required

YOU’RE JUST RIGHT FOR VIRTU IF YOU WANT

  • To work in a organisationally flat structure with an entrepreneurial environment.
  • Be part of a single team of professionals committed to excellence, passionate about continually learning, improving and raising the bar
  • A firm committed to create an inclusive, equitable, and supportive environment to individuals from all backgrounds
  • A community that values hard work as well as work-life balance and provides comprehensive benefits.
  • An open environment to explore and implement new ideas, and take ownership of team initiatives from the start

THE SELECTION PROCESS

After passing an initial resume screening, select applicants may receive an online programming test, which will be emailed to you via Hackerrank. Upon review, we will reach out to arrange next steps. We are looking forward to meeting you!

Closing Date: 15 November 2026

Virtu Financial is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming you for who you are and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/xantium/jobs/44.description_excerpt:
Xantium Group is looking for a Recruiter to join at a pivotal point in the Firm’s growth, with the opportunity to shape the talent coming in and the processes behind how we recruit. You'll lead searches across quantitative research, trading, and analysis, bringing the market knowledge and judgment to identify and attract exceptional candidates. 

Beyond delivering on immediate priorities, you'll help build the capabilities we need as we scale. Working closely with hiring managers, you'll develop targeted talent strategies, cultivate relationships, and strengthen our systems and interview practices. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys a fast pace and takes equal ownership of filling roles and advancing longer-term projects. 

 Key Responsibilities 

  • -Own end-to-end recruitment for front-office positions, from role scoping through assessment, offer negotiation, and closing. 
  • -Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand investment strategies, hiring priorities, and the commercial impact of each hire. 
  • -Build and maintain talent pipelines across quantitative research, trading, and investment roles. 
  • -Build recruiting infrastructure, including improving ATS functionality, workflows, reporting, and data quality. 
  • -Manage recruiting projects from planning through implementation, balancing longer-term improvements with day-to-day hiring needs. 

 

Key Criteria 

  • -5+ years of combined agency and in-house recruiting experience, preferably for front-office financial services roles. 
  • -Experience working in a growing or scaling business, where priorities evolve and processes are fluid and in various stages of maturity. 
  • -Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect hiring decisions to business needs. 
  • -Strong project management skills, with the ability to turn ideas into practical, well-executed improvements. 
  • -Hands-on experience with an ATS and an interest in making recruiting systems and workflows scale.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/xantium/jobs/43.description_excerpt:
Xantium Academy Fellow

We seek top early-career professionals to join our inaugural Xantium Academy Fellowship commencing the summer of 2027.  This six-month accelerated program blends structured mentorship, classroom theory, and hands-on practice across fluid tracks in Trading or Analysis.  Supported by active executive sponsorship – including direct engagement with Xantium Co-Founders – Fellows will make immediate contributions through real-world projects. 

We plan to hire 10-12 highly talented individuals with a range of experiences for our first cohort; while each person will be based in New York or London, they’ll collaborate with Xantium colleagues around the world.  The overall experience shall enable Fellows to discover their natural niche, hone in on an ideal role and team, and transition into their permanent professional home at the end of the program.

Program Structure

  • Six-Month Timeline: The program begins with an “Initial Immersion” rotation featuring 10-12 weeks of immediate, hands-on deployment into real work alongside seasoned professionals.  Fellows then transition into a 3-week cohort-wide classroom training led by experienced speakers and Xantium leadership hosted at one of Xantium’s main offices.  The experience concludes with a 10-12 week “Capstone” rotation of more advanced deployment, allowing Fellows to build off their learnings to tackle another set of projects.
  • Dedicated Mentorship: Fellows are matched with a long-term career "Advisor" for the full six months, alongside rotation-specific business unit "Facilitators" who provide immediate team onboarding and daily project direction.
  • Fluid Learning Tracks: Rather than rigid silos, the structure allows Fellows to tailor their journey, absorbing both Trading and Analysis content to find the unique intersection that best suits one’s talents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform fundamental and quantitative research, analyzing market dynamics, industry trends, and company-specific data to support actionable investment decisions.
  • Build and maintain financial models, monitor portfolio risks, and assist in evaluating complex company valuations.
  • Fuel trading desks by analyzing pricing, simulating market dynamics, and assisting with trade execution and lifecycle management.
  • Drive key business initiatives alongside Portfolio Managers, Analysts, and Traders, collaborating with colleagues globally across London, New York, Abu Dhabi, Singapore, and Hong Kong.

Qualifications

  • Strong academic and extracurricular record in university pursuits.
  • Demonstrated interest in financial markets, company research, trading, and/or business strategy.
  • High adaptability and self-direction, capable of seamlessly transitioning between rigorous academic theory and hands-on execution.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with executive leadership and a global team.
  • Deep intellectual curiosity and a relentless drive to thrive in a fast-paced, rigorous investment environment.

Compensation: Xantium Academy Fellows in New York can expect to earn $150,000 to $175,000+ base.  Total compensation for all Xantium Academy Fellows also includes a large annual bonus which is guaranteed in year one and based on employee and firm performance thereafter.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/whalarinc/jobs/.description_excerpt:
Job Title: Talent Manager / Senior Talent Manager

Work Location: Hybrid, Farringdon, London, UK

Start Date: ASAP

Sixteenth, part of Whalar Group, is one of the leading, global, 360° Creator talent management companies. As the home of “good influence,” we’re dedicated to building long-term, strategic partnerships that help Creators fulfill their professional and human potential. We believe in promoting positivity and purpose — enabling Creators to deliver culturally relevant content, achieve deeper audience engagement, and build lasting careers.

Andy Warhol once predicted that everyone would have fifteen minutes of fame. We're here to give creators their Sixteenth minute — and beyond. Learn more about Sixteenth: www.sixteenth.com.

About the role:

Sixteenth is looking for a Talent Manager/Senior Talent Manager to represent and grow a roster of Creators. In this role, you will help shape the professional brand and commercial strategy of your assigned talent, identifying opportunities, building strong industry relationships, and securing partnerships that drive meaningful growth for both creators and brands.

You’ll play a key role in expanding commercial opportunities for your roster while helping strengthen Sixteenth’s position within the creator economy. This role is an exciting opportunity to join the home of “good influence” and one of the world’s leading global, 360° Creator talent management companies.

What your day might look like:

  • Managing and growing a roster of creators, helping guide their commercial strategy and identifying partnerships that align with their voice, audience, and long-term ambitions.
  • Identifying, pitching, and negotiating brand partnerships that drive revenue while creating meaningful collaborations between creators and brands.
  • Building strong relationships across brands, agencies, and partners within your vertical to unlock new opportunities for your talent.
  • Acting as a strategic advisor to your creators—supporting them with career development, brand positioning, and commercial growth.
  • Working alongside the Talent Director to expand your roster by identifying emerging creators with strong cultural relevance and commercial potential.
  • Leading negotiations and overseeing the successful delivery of campaigns and partnerships from pitch through execution.
  • Supporting and mentoring junior team members, potentially managing a Talent Associate responsible for campaign execution and helping develop a Talent Manager.
  • Contributing to the broader talent team by supporting training, team structure, and overall roster growth across the division.

Here's what we're looking for:

  • Experience working in talent management or a related field such as influencer partnerships, digital advertising, PR, or creator marketing.
  • A strong understanding of the creator economy and how creators, platforms, brands, and audiences connect.
  • A commercially driven mindset, with a track record of generating new business and securing partnerships.
  • The ability to balance business instincts with creativity—spotting opportunities that make sense strategically and culturally.
  • A strong passion for the creator landscape and curiosity about how platforms and creator-led media continue to evolve.
  • Someone who is proactive, self-directed, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.
  • A team player who is coachable, open to feedback, and always looking to improve.
  • Humility and a “no task is too small” mindset when supporting creators and the broader team.
  • Some experience leading or mentoring others, with an interest in helping develop junior team members.
  • A natural relationship builder who enjoys connecting with people and growing a strong professional network.

Based in Farringdon, London, we embrace a flexible hybrid model. We ask our team to work from the office two to three days a week, with Tuesday and Thursday serving as our "anchor days." These days are dedicated to collaborating in person and celebrating Sixteenth’s vibrant culture together

Our values:

At Whalar Group, diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) isn't just a statement; it's our collective strength. Our people are our superpower. A diverse team and inclusive leadership have shaped Whalar Group since our inception in 2016, fueling a constant evolution of growth. We champion a culture of respect and empathy, fostering a sense of belonging that transcends demographics. We hire individuals of all backgrounds and empower them to thrive, challenge stereotypes, and actively break societal barriers. Learn more. 

Our benefits and perks:

Whalar Group provides flexible benefits and collaborative work environments and experiences so employees can work productively in a setting that best and uniquely suits their needs.

  • Private medical insurance
  • Health cash plan
  • 25 days of PTO + Sick days + Winter break
  • Private pension scheme
  • Monthly phone/internet reimbursement
  • Professional development stipend
  • New joiner Home office allowance 
  • Enhanced maternity (up to 22 weeks) / paternity (up 16 weeks) leave
  • Reduced fee gym membership (next to office location)
  • Life Assurance
  • Workplace Nursery Scheme
  • Volunteer days
  • Social programs

job-boards.greenhouse.io/powerdigitalmar.description_excerpt:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work. 

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

A day in the life:

The Paid Advertising Strategist is responsible for owning the execution, performance, and growth of campaigns within their book of business. They are oriented towards the clients’ business success, tying their efforts to the greater business goals. They are self-starters and autonomously own their responsibilities. The Strategist works hand-in-hand with account leadership to ideate and evolve the strategy of their service within the broader media mix. They are responsible for owning reporting, optimizations, client communication, and execution of keyword research, ad copy development, bid optimizations, and routine campaign management, sometimes with the support of a Specialist. The Strategist is excellent at providing insights and forward-thinking strategy to clients on an ongoing basis and has a strong understanding of their service’s strategy and the levers to pull to drive performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Full ownership and execution of performance marketing via paid social & paid media native platforms
    • Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Youtube Ads, Bing Ads
    • Effectively executing builds and production A-Z with redundancy across channels and 100% on time delivery 
    • Lead execution of optimizations with regard to performance improvements relative to goals
    • Manage all client budgets and/or advise on budget changes based on your expertise with accurate budget pacing 
    • Sufficient QA that results in no errors that would yield a negative impact to revenue for clients
    • Lead proactive strategy recommendations across assigned channels, surfacing opportunities and risks ahead of client requests.
    • Maintain client testing roadmaps and project manage next steps, ensuring a consistent, ongoing cadence of experimentation.
    • Escalate performance risks early, distinguishing normal fluctuation from genuine account risk requiring intervention.
  • Effectively own strategic communication internally for client teams
    • Proactive internal communication with team on performance, strategy, recommendations, deliverables, and action items; facilitating tactical needs with Specialists where applicable
    • Weekly client progress recaps, outlining performance insights and future recommendations
    • Consistent upkeep of client testing roadmaps and project management of next steps 
  • Excellent marketing and business strategy acumen
    • Complete understanding of the marketing funnel and how to execute via paid social and paid media
    • Full knowledge of the Power Circuit, adapting to the latest product processes 
    • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your role
    • Ability to navigate roadblocks and adapt strategy to changes in landscape to achieve desired results
  • Ownership of performance reporting and strategy communication
  • Ability to leverage data to tell a story and articulate results to clients and key stakeholders with clear next steps
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

Role Requirements:

  • 2-3 years of digital marketing experience; 1-2 years in an agency setting
  • Minimum 2-3 years of hands-on experience with at least 2+ of the following paid advertising channels 
  • Google/Bing, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat and other applicable paid advertising networks 
  • Specifically having experience with campaign development and optimization processes such as bid optimization, keyword research, ad copy development, campaign strategy, and optimizations 
  • Proficiency in Google/Microsoft Office Suite(s)
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics
  • Strong understanding of full-funnel marketing 
  • Other skills required: 
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills
    • Strong organizational and project management skills
    • Self-motivated individual with a strong desire to succeed
    • Excellent interpersonal skills
    • Confident with client-facing presentations and communication
    • Strong work ethic and ability to learn quickly and independently
    • Interested in a long-lasting relationship with a growing company

    Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

    • Managing a full workload indicated by $28K revenue/employee
    • 90% Client Retention, evaluated biannually 
    • Team Retention (of DRs if applicable): 95%

    Most Important Things (MITs)

    • Excellence in channel production and account performance
    • Cross-channel collaboration
    • Internal communication

    Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace.…

As companies move beyond one-time product sales, they are building dynamic business models that combine subscriptions, usage, services, and AI-powered experiences. Our flexible, modular monetization suite spans pricing and packaging, billing, payments, revenue, and financial operations. About Zuora

At Zuora, we power the world’s shift to Modern Business. We’re helping people and companies subscribe to a better way of doing business—one that’s built on recurring relationships instead of one-time transactions, creating more value for customers, companies, and the planet.

As pioneers of the Subscription Economy, our platform and expertise help the world’s most innovative organizations—from disruptive startups to global enterprises—monetize new business models, nurture long-term subscriber relationships, and optimize their digital experiences.

Join us as we transform industries and shape the future of how businesses grow.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to launch your sales career at the forefront of the Subscription Economy®? As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Zuora, you’ll be a driving force behind our growth—creating meaningful conversations, building high-quality sales pipelines, and helping companies transform the way they monetize their products and services.

You’ll connect with some of the most innovative brands in the world, sparking interest in how Zuora empowers businesses to deliver seamless subscription experiences and embrace recurring revenue models. If you’re curious, competitive, and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is the perfect role to accelerate your career in tech sales.

Work arrangement: This is a hybrid working role with an expectation of 3 days per week in our London office to foster collaboration, learning and success! 

About You

You’re an early-career sales professional (or aspiring one) who is excited about B2B SaaS, learning modern sales motions, and building a career in tech.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Have 1–2 years of experience in Sales Development or Business Development in SaaS or business application technology.
  • Are strongly interested in building a long-term career in sales or sales leadership.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently—positive, energetic, a great listener, and a strong writer.
  • Are a collaborative team player who thrives in a high-energy, goal-oriented environment.
  • Feel comfortable with cold-calling and outbound prospecting.
  • Are a self-starter who takes initiative, overcomes challenges, and celebrates wins.
  • Have passion for technology, innovation, and helping businesses grow.
  • Have familiarity with tools like Salesforce and LinkedIn Sales Navigator (or similar) — a plus, not a requirement.
  • 3 days per week office attendance (Soho, London)

About the Team

You’ll join a high-energy Sales Development team that sits at the front of Zuora’s go-to-market engine. The team:

  • Partners closely with Account Executives and Sales Managers to design targeted outreach strategies and customized messaging for priority accounts.
  • Uses research and insights to identify key decision-makers, understand their business challenges, and uncover the “why now” for Zuora.
  • Owns outbound prospecting across channels—calls, personalized emails, and social selling—to create a strong, qualified pipeline.
  • Operates in a collaborative, performance-driven environment where coaching, feedback, and growth are part of the daily rhythm.

What you’ll do:

  • Create opportunity: Identify, engage, and qualify new business prospects to fuel Zuora’s sales pipeline and growth.
  • Be strategic: Partner with Account Executives and Sales Managers to craft targeted outreach and messaging.
  • Do the research: Use industry knowledge and account insights to find key decision-makers and understand their challenges.
  • Own your outreach: Run outbound prospecting via calls, personalized emails, and social selling.
  • Learn and grow: Build deep expertise in Zuora’s product suite and how it transforms customer business models.
  • Track your success: Manage your activities and results in Salesforce, consistently aiming to exceed monthly and quarterly goals.
  • Engage leaders: Conduct discovery conversations with senior executives (C-level, VP, Director) across your target accounts.

 

You’ll be supported with coaching, tools, and enablement to help you ramp quickly and progress in your sales career.

Pay and Benefits

Compensation

  • This role offers a competitive base salary range in plus variable compensation tied to performance (e.g., commissions and/or bonus).
  • Actual compensation will be based on experience, skills, and location, aligned with Zuora’s global compensation…

Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. 

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? 

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience? 

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Assistant Site Manager - VR Concept Venue

Location: Bristol
Contract: Freelance, September 2026 – March 2027 (potential to extend)
Pay: £16 per hour
Working Pattern: Full-time (job share considered); requires evenings, weekends, and public holiday availability. Shift pattern arranged to overlap with, and to cover for, the Event Manager (Site Manager) as needed.
Reports to: Charlotte Potter, Producer – Fever (day-to-day line management from the Event Manager / Site Manager)
Manages: Front-of-house staff (agency and in-house); full management responsibility for all staff, including cleaners and front-of-house teams, when covering for the Event Manager during periods of leave

Role Overview
We're looking for a proactive and technically confident Assistant Site Manager to support the day-to-day running of our immersive VR experience in a high-footfall Bristol venue. Working closely with the Event Manager, you'll help keep the visitor experience running smoothly, staff well supported, and systems fully
operational. 

This role also acts as key holiday and absence cover for the Event Manager (Site Manager), stepping up to take full responsibility for the venue — technical, operational, and people management — whenever they are away. You'll need the confidence to run the site independently at short notice, alongside your regular assistant duties.

Key Responsibilities

🔧 Technical & Operational Delivery
● Support daily setup and shutdown of the VR experience, ensuring all systems, hardware, and software are fully operational.
● Carry out pre-opening checks (hardware calibration, environment readiness, content testing) alongside or in place of the Event Manager.
● Troubleshoot first-line IT and technical issues on-site (VR headsets, PCs, networking, displays), escalating to tech support partners where needed.
● Monitor experience performance throughout the day, resolving disruptions or resets promptly.
● Maintain stock of consumables (e.g., sanitisation wipes, headset liners) and uphold hygiene protocols.
● Assist in keeping technical documentation up to date and support training of team members on troubleshooting procedures.

🏛 Venue Operations (Ground Floor)
● Help ensure the ground floor VR experience space is clean, safe, and visitor-ready at all times.
● Coordinate cleaning and reactive maintenance for the VR zone, including public and back-of-house areas.
● Support queue management, timed entry, and visitor flow, particularly during peak periods.

👥 Team Support & Holiday Cover
● Assist in line managing front-of-house staff, including agency team members, day to day.
● Support daily staff briefings, rota coordination, and shift cover.
● Model high standards of customer service and professionalism for the wider team.
● Help train new team members on VR-specific procedures, safety, and technical protocols.
● Take full ownership of team management, rotas, and briefings during any period covering for the Event Manager, ensuring continuity of standards and cover.

🛡 Health & Safety
● Support daily safety and cleanliness walkarounds of the VR area.
● Act as a trained first aider for the venue, leading incident response (first aid, equipment malfunctions, or guest complaints), including full responsibility for this when covering for the Event Manager.
● Help keep risk assessments for the VR zone up to date and log incidents or near misses.
● Ensure staff are trained in relevant H&S procedures, including emergency evacuations and manual handling (if required).

📣 Customer Experience
● Help maintain a welcoming, engaging, and inclusive atmosphere for all guests.
● Act as a point of escalation for visitor queries or complaints, and the main escalation point when covering for the Event Manager.
● Support customer feedback mechanisms and feed insights back to the Producer and Event Manager.

📝 Communication & Reporting
● Provide handovers to the Event Manager (or, during cover periods, directly to the Producer) covering technical issues, visitor numbers, and operational highlights.
● Maintain accurate logs: staff attendance, incident reports, daily checklists, and maintenance tickets.
● Ensure a clean handover back to the Event Manager after any period of holiday cover, flagging anything requiring follow-up.


Ideal Candidate Profile
● Current, valid First Aid at Work certification is required for this role.
● Experience in live event, visitor attraction, or venue operations — preferably in immersive or tech-driven environments.
● Working knowledge of VR hardware/software and basic IT troubleshooting (e.g., Windows PCs, networks, Wi-Fi, device calibration).
● Experience supporting or managing teams, including casual/agency staff, in high-traffic public settings.
● Comfortable stepping up to run a site independently at short notice, with strong organisational skills and a calm, solutions-focused approach under pressure.
● Confident communicator and team player who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
● Working knowledge of health & safety regulations and customer service best practices.

Additional Info
● Flexibility is essential: early starts, late finishes, and public holidays are part of the standard schedule.
● Some Mondays/Tuesdays may be required for maintenance, special events, or staff training.

The Arbitrum Foundation is dedicated to scaling Ethereum through cutting-edge Layer 2 solutions. You will lead initiatives to grow and support a vibrant community of developers, partners, and users, ensuring the seamless integration of Arbitrum across various verticals, including DeFi, Gaming & AI. By building strategic partnerships and leading our Ecosystem Growth efforts, you’ll drive the long-term success of Arbitrum as the leading Ethereum scaling solution.

jobs.lever.co/analogfolk/6474697b-9d1e-4.description_excerpt:
Who We Are
Untold Fable is a global content production company challenging the way things are done to change them for the better. It’s not an easy road, but we’re not here for that. We’re here to make diversity in our industry the norm, not the exception; we’re here to work in completely new ways and to show how purpose and commercial success go hand in hand. This mission, coupled with our creative and production expertise, has cemented relationships with the world’s biggest brands, from Nike and Meta to Stella Artois and Bumble. Our varied projects will immerse you in diverse and fascinating subjects. So far we’ve delved into fitness, female health, film, finance, food, dating, education, music, alcohol.
Everything we want for our industry is reflected in Untold Fable itself. We support and champion each other internally as much as the production talent we commission. We foster an empowered culture where different people and perspectives can thrive at every stage of their careers; open minds are welcome, egos are not. We operate a hybrid, flexible working model, coming together in our amazing office in Clerkenwell, London and Brooklyn, New York, 1-3 days per week.
Our client roster is growing each month working with companies such as: Nike, Bumble, HSBC, Tripadvisor and Meta.
Untold Fable is proud to be part of The AnalogFolk Group, therefore this role will at times collaborate with members of the AnalogFolk team working alongside strategy and creative to deliver brilliant work. Untold Fable has its own client base as well as the work we do in collaboration with AnalogFolk.
The role:
We are looking for a first class Producer to join our rapidly growing team. Reporting to the Head of Production, this role is UK-based, but as Untold Fable is a global content production company, you will have the opportunity to work with a huge range of brands worldwide and facilitate production in multiple countries. You will travel internationally when projects require you to.
You will be responsible for scoping, running and delivering a number of projects for key clients, sometimes working direct to client with support from our Client Services team and also in collaboration with our sister company AnalogFolk.
With a wealth of production knowledge, particularly in the delivery of short-form content, you’ll be an expert in shooting and editing techniques, specific equipment and locations, as well as insurance and taxes. You will ensure that productions are run smoothly and efficiently end to end, with target margins being consistently achieved.
You will work collaboratively with the core team at Untold fable, whilst liaising with the Creative team and ensuring the project stays true to the original vision. You will maintain Untold Fable’s high standard of execution in everything you create.
On large bids, you will lead the search for the right creative talent, specifically pitching and attaching Directors to projects. You will be heavily involved in the use of our talent network, and will use our platform as part of your ongoing search for new and diverse creative talent.
You are an excellent Producer with a positive outlook. You thrive in an environment where collaboration is vital. Your desire to deliver fresh, impactful work is equalled by the joy you take in supporting and championing your colleagues and your passion for making positive change in the production industry.
The ideal candidate will have:
- Experience producing short form video content, with a minimum of 5 years in an agency, production company or similar environment
- Experience scoping out briefs, assembling crews and preparing production schedules
- Experience writing and managing budgets from £10K to £500K
- Excellent project management and organisational skills
- Have a keen visual eye and strong knack for storytelling ensuring all projects are produced at the highest possible spec- Experience in a client facing role
- Excellent written and oral communication skills
- Confidence negotiating with suppliers with a positive collaborative approach
- Calm, yet assertive, you approach problems with a positive solution-orientated attitude
- Someone that fits in a very ‘can do’ and solutions orientated team
- Culturally aware of current industry trends and forecasts, with a love of video content- Commercial acumen and entrepreneurial thinking and be excited by our model

jobs.lever.co/analogfolk/a598defe-fc9f-4.description_excerpt:
Who we are
AnalogFolk is a global next generation creative group that is purpose-built to help brands thrive in the post-digital age. We are proud to be a strategic partner to brands such as HSBC, L’Oréal, Galderma, Meta, Guinness and Costa Coffee and to have been awarded both Campaign Magazine’s Global Innovation Agency of the Year and a Contagious Magazine Pioneer.
We combine strategy, creativity and technology to help brands grow in a fragmented, fast-moving world. At the heart of our approach is a belief that brands must not only be seen, but felt, shared and experienced in ways that are culturally relevant, personally meaningful and consistently delivered.
We’re growing our London team and looking for people who don’t just follow culture, but interrogate it, question it, and help brands meaningfully participate in it.
OVERVIEW
As a Social Strategist, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic social media plansto enhance brand awareness, engagement, and overall digital presence for our clients.
You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including delivery, content creators and creative, to develop and implement social media campaigns that align with our clients goals and objectives.
Your role will involve analyzing social media data, identifying trends, and utilizing industry best practices to optimize social media content and strategies.
WHAT YOU’LL DO / Roles & Responsibilities
Social Media Strategy Development
- Develop comprehensive social media strategies that align with the our clients overall marketing and communication objectives. This includes setting goals, defining target audience, selecting appropriate social media platforms, and determining content themes and messaging strategies.
Content Creation and Curation
- Collaborate with content creators and graphic designers to develop engaging and impactful social media content, including text, images, videos, and other multimedia assets. Ensure the content is aligned with the brand voice and resonates with the target audience.
Campaign Planning and Execution
- Plan and execute social media campaigns across various platforms, including but not limited to Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Monitor campaign performance, make data-driven adjustments, and optimize campaigns for maximum impact
Social Listening and Trend Analysis
- Monitor social media channels to identify trends, insights, and opportunities. Utilize social listening tools to gather customer feedback, monitor brand sentiment, and gain insights into industry trends and competitor activities. Translate data into actionable recommendations to improve social media strategies.
Analytics and Reporting
- Utilize social media analytics tools to track and measure the effectiveness of social media campaigns. Generate regular reports that highlight key performance indicators (KPIs), provide insights, and make data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement.
Up-to-Date with Industry Trends
- Stay informed about emerging social media trends, platform updates, and industry best practices. Continuously explore new opportunities and technologies to enhance social media strategies and drive innovation.
WHAT YOU’VE DONE / Skills & Experience
- 3–5 years’ experience in a social media or digital strategy role, ideally within a creative or integrated agency.
- Strong understanding of social-first thinking, with the ability to develop platform-native ideas across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and emerging channels.
- Proven experience contributing to and owning elements of social strategies, from insight gathering through to execution and optimisation.
- Confident translating brand positioning into engaging, culturally relevant social content.
- Good understanding of internet culture, trends, and audience behaviours, with the ability to identify opportunities for brands to show up meaningfully.
- Experience supporting and delivering organic and paid social campaigns, with a clear understanding of how they work together.
- Comfortable working collaboratively with creative, design, and production teams to bring ideas to life.
- Ability to analyse performance data and extract actionable insights, with a working knowledge of key social and digital metrics.
- Familiarity with key tools (e.g. Meta Business Suite, Sprout, Google Analytics, TikTok Analytics).
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Clear and confident communication skills, with some experience presenting ideas internally or to clients.
- A proactive and curious mindset, with a genuine interest in creativity, culture, and evolving digital platforms.
- Some experience working with influencers or creators, or an understanding of how creator partnerships fit into broader strategy.

As we evolve into Social Wellness Clubs, we are creating spaces and experiences that support every aspect of our members’ physical, mental, nutritional and social wellbeing. By bringing together expert guidance, genuine community, personalised experiences and innovative technology, we make wellness feel accessible, welcoming and easy to navigate. Virgin Active is committed to recruiting the finest people who share our passion for creating exceptional experiences and delivering world-class service every day. We are looking for 1 New Member & Sales Host to join our Acquisitions team.

Role Type: Full time

Number of Hours: 40

In this role, you will play a part in being responsible for inspiring people to begin their wellness journey, delivering an exceptional sales and onboarding experience, and ensuring every new member feels welcomed, valued and supported through their first 90 days. You are the first impression of the club and a core part of building long-term member relationships.

The Role

  • Take ownership of individual membership sales targets, contributing to overall club growth and retention.
  • Engage prospects with empathy and curiosity, delivering value-led tours based on their goals and motivations.
  • Drive self-generated leads and maintain consistent follow-up using CRM systems.
  • Personally welcome new members and deliver a tailored onboarding experience.
  • Guide members through their first 90 days, ensuring regular engagement and a sense of belonging.
  • Create moments of generosity that surprise and delight, bringing Unreasonable Hospitality to life.
  • Encourage participation across classes, PT, recovery, and club services.
  • Collaborate with instructors, trainers, and club teams to ensure a seamless experience.
  • Maintain high standards of administration, time management, and communication.
  • Support the smooth operation of the club and uphold all Virgin Active brand standards.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Previous experience in sales, hospitality, wellness, or customer-facing environments (desirable).
  • A strong passion for people, wellness, and meaningful connection.
  • The ability to meet and exceed targets while delivering a premium experience.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills – warm, confident, and engaging.
  • Strong organisational skills with attention to detail and follow-through.
  • A proactive, positive attitude and a natural sense of care and hospitality.
  • Flexibility to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, and club events.

What You’ll Get

  • The opportunity to be part of a brand redefining the future of wellness
  • A premium environment with industry-leading facilities
  • Development and progression opportunities aligned to your level
  • Access to a vibrant, engaged member community
  • The platform to build your career, reputation and impact

The Perks

  • 30 days (including bank holidays) annual leave, plus a Celebration Day – and we want you take them
  • Access to The Peoples Pension, with our contributions at 3%.
  • Complimentary Virgin Active membership for you and a buddy. You can also get free membership for your children too, ability to take advantage of our Club V.
  • We want you to love Virgin Active like we do, so you get discounts across Virgin active – everything from guest passes to 50% off PT sessions.
  • You will join Virgin Family - where not only can you  communicate with your colleagues across Virgin Group, but also many discounts (including Virgin Atlantic, Virgin Holidays and Virgin Media/O2) 
  • Maintaining a healthy diet while at work can be hard, so we offer all our team members 20% off food and drink at our KAUAI branches located in clubs.
  • Managing finances can be difficult, so we offer access to Salary Finance. They can support you with loans and savings plans, as well as help you become a personal finance expert.
  • Mental health is a cornerstone of wellbeing. Our Health Heroes employer assistance programme is there when you need a helping hand with 6 free counselling sessions.
  • We know finding a new home to rent can be stressful. We partner with Dexters who offer complimentary corporate letting services – meaning no tenant charges.
  • Access to ePoints, offering loads of online discounts to retailers.
Pay Range
£26,000—£29,000 GBP

You will own the regional revenue target, build the pipeline from the ground up, and also explore on pan-European accounts. You will report to the Director of Business Development, work closely with the CEO, and partner with Compliance, Product, Legal, and Operations to get customers live quickly and safely.

About Caliza
Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.
Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.
Our backers
Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.
About the role
Caliza moves money across fiat payment rails in the Americas, Europe and Asia, including Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA and CNAPS, as well as blockchains. Most payments flow through automatically. When one doesn't, our customers need someone who can work out exactly what happened, explain it clearly, and get it resolved.
That's this role. When a customer asks "where's my payment?", you'll own the answer. You'll follow the payment from their API call, through our internal systems and ledger, out to our partner banks, the payment rail or the blockchain, and back. Then you'll explain what you found to the customer, push the bank for answers when needed, and hand our engineers a precise problem when something is genuinely broken.
You don't need to be an expert in every system a payment touches, but you need to be able to follow one through all of them. You're comfortable reading logs, querying a database and decoding a bank message, and equally comfortable explaining what you found to a customer, a bank or an engineer. You'll build a deep understanding of how our rails really behave over time; we'll teach you the Caliza-specific parts.
Location: Europe, Africa, or Asia. You'll be based there so customers get help during their working hours, but the role covers every rail we operate, not just the ones in your region. Professional English required.
In your first six months, you'll
•
Learn how payments flow through Caliza end to end, across fiat rails and stablecoins.
•
Within three months, understand all of our rails well enough to handle most customer payment issues on your own, whichever rail they're on.
•
Own customer payment investigations during your hours, across every rail, keeping customers informed from first message to resolution.
•
Write runbooks for the issues you see most, so the rest of the team can rely on them.
•
Build at least one tool or automation that measurably reduces manual work.
What you'll be doing
•
Be the technical point of contact for customers with payment problems, especially when the answer isn't obvious.
•
Answer technical API questions from live customers, such as failed webhooks, error codes or unexpected payment statuses. Helping new customers integrate before launch is handled separately by engineering.
•
Trace payments across our API, internal systems, ledger, partner banks, rails and blockchain to find where things stand and what happens next.
•
Tell expected behavior from a real bug, and escalate to engineering with clear evidence when it's a bug.
•
Work with partner banks and providers on investigations, returns and recalls.
•
Support compliance with information requests about specific payments.
•
Tag the root cause of each issue so we can fix the most common ones for good.
•
Review new rails and corridors before launch, bringing an operational view of how they'll fail.
•
Write SQL queries and scripts to automate repetitive work.
What we're looking for
•
3+ years in a technical, customer-facing role at a fintech, payments company, bank or API-first business, such as technical support, payment operations or implementation.
•
A solid understanding of how payments work: statuses, settlement, cutoffs, finality, returns and recalls. Experience with any major rail is fine; we'll teach you ours.
•
Comfort reading JSON API requests, logs and webhooks.
•
Working SQL, and some scripting in Python or similar.
•
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, for scripting, investigation or documentation, with the judgment to check what they produce.
•
A methodical approach to investigations: you form hypotheses and check them, rather than guessing.
•
Clear, calm communication with customers, especially when the full answer isn't known yet.
•
Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.
Nice to have
•
Hands-on experience with any of our rails: Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst) or CNAPS. Experience across more than one region is a strong plus.
•
Familiarity with ISO 20022 payment messages (e.g. pacs.002, pacs.004, camt.053, camt.056).
•
Experience with stablecoins, crypto wallets or block explorers.
•
Experience working with partner or sponsor banks on investigations.
•
Familiarity with double-entry accounting and reconciliation.
How we work
We use AI tools every day and expect you to as well, for scripting, investigation and documentation alike. You own what you produce with them: you check it, understand it, and stand behind it. Because we handle customer and payment data, we follow clear rules about which data can go into which tools.
Benefits
Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.
Equal opportunity and other disclosures

We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Company Overview:
At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. Panopto is looking for a Senior Project Manager to own the execution behind our product initiatives — from the moment we commit to something through the day customers can use it.
Position Summary
In this role, you will have the opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.
As the Senior Project Manager, you'll report to the Program Manager and sit inside the Product team on the R&D side, which means the job runs in both directions. Upstream, you're working with Product Managers, Engineering, and Design to keep committed work moving, dependencies visible, and slippage caught early. Downstream, you're making sure Marketing has positioning, Support knows what's changing, Sales can sell it, and customers hear about it the day it goes live.
Most project management roles are one or the other. This one is deliberately both, because the handoffs between them are where things fall apart.
You'll take initiatives that start as a paragraph and a target quarter, break them into a plan people can act on, and keep a distributed group of teams moving in the same direction until it's out the door. This role is for someone energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity — you'll frequently be the person who turns "we're doing this next quarter" into a sequenced plan with owners and dates, and then holds everyone to it.
You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.
How You’ll Contribute
In this role, you will have the opportunity to
Own the end-to-end plan for assigned initiatives — scope, sequence, dependencies, milestones, and readiness criteria from commitment through release.
Break large, ambiguous initiatives into discrete workstreams with clear owners, and keep the group aligned as things shift.
Work alongside Product Managers and Engineering Leads to track delivery against commitments, surface slippage early, and keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved.
Facilitate the sessions that move work forward — dependency reviews, cross-team planning, release readiness — and make sure they end in decisions.
Translate engineering blockers and technical trade-offs into clear, honest updates for Product leadership and commercial stakeholders.
Drive go-to-market readiness with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Support, and Customer Success so enablement lands with the release, not after it.
Coordinate internal and customer-facing release communications, including release notes.
Build the templates, checklists, and repeatable processes that make the next release easier than the last one — using AI tooling to cut the manual overhead.
What Success Looks Like
Within 3 months: You've built working relationships across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support, and you own end-to-end coordination for two or more active initiatives — running the delivery cadence with the dev teams and producing status reporting people actually read.
Within 6 months: You're anticipating blockers rather than reporting them, and releases you coordinate go out with GTM readiness in place on day one.
Within 1 year: You run our most complex, multi-team initiatives with minimal oversight, and the delivery and launch process you've built is what the rest of the team uses by default.
Your legacy: Panopto ships predictably, and every team knows what's coming and what they need to do about it — because you built the system that makes that true.
Values in Action
Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.
Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.
Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.
Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.
Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.
How We Thrive
You'll join a team where we challenge ideas, not people. The Product organization exists to ideate, define, and deliver best-in-class products to our customers — assessing market trends, running competitive and customer research, and ruthlessly prioritizing the opportunities with the highest return. We hold ourselves accountable to outcomes, not activity.
The Foundation for Success
6+ years of project or program management experience, with at least 4+ years specifically embedded within a B2B SaaS Product or R&D organization.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
Demonstrated experience running delivery with software engineering teams and coordinating the go-to-market side of a product launch. This role does both.
Proven experience driving delivery for complex SaaS architectures (e.g., API integrations, multi-tenant cloud platforms, feature flags, continuous deployment release models).
Working understanding of the SaaS product lifecycle and agile delivery practices, with the judgment to adapt the process to the situation rather than apply it by the book.
Enough technical fluency to hold a credible conversation with engineers about dependencies, trade-offs, and blockers — you don't need to write code, but you can't be a passenger in the discussion.
Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for planning, tracking, and documentation.
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to push back constructively on scope creep.
Experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones.
Demonstrated track record of designing, implementing, or improving cross-functional delivery and GTM release frameworks, rather than just executing within existing ones.
What Sets You Apart
Experience coordinating GTM launch activities with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, or Customer Success.
Experience presenting, reporting delivery health, and managing trade-offs directly with VP and C-level stakeholders.
Experience sitting inside a Product or R&D organization rather than a central PMO.
Active PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification.
Hands-on experience leveraging modern PM stacks…

jobs.lever.co/nium/57c4c34e-0516-4c48-93.description_excerpt:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
About the Role
As the Global Vertical Head of Regulatory Compliance for the Financial Institutions segment, you will be working as part of Nium’s global, dynamic compliance team. This role will lead the compliance strategy for Financial Institution businesses and is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the compliance framework. You will ensure that product innovation and commercial expansion are supported by robust, scalable compliance controls.

Great question! Conveyancing is all we do! 'We specialise in, what you specialise in' - perfect match! We are growing our Consultant Conveyancer network and are looking for experienced residential conveyancers who want greater control over how and when they work.

Manage your own caseload and clients
Work remotely with full flexibility over your diary
Build and develop your own network
Earn up to 80% of your billings (subject to fee structure)
Operate under the umbrella of a fully regulated and insured firm

A dedicated onboarding and post-completion administration team
Compliance and regulatory support when required
Professional indemnity insurance covered

Business development support in the early months

A collaborative consultant community for knowledge sharing and support
